<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB IMPLEMENTATION irm-entity-owner — DATA CHANGING. DRY RUN unless DRY_RUN = false. Prints counts and record sys_ids only.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var DRY_RUN = true;   // set to false only after the dry-run output is approved
var STATS = {checked: 0, would_change: 0, changed: 0, skipped: [], changed_ids: []};
// Set FIELD on records in TABLE matched by KEY_FIELD, using MAP {keyValue: newValue}. Reference values are resolved by display value in REF_TABLE (optional).
function backfill(TABLE, KEY_FIELD, FIELD, MAP, REF_TABLE, EXTRA_QUERY){
  var refCache = {};
  Object.keys(MAP).forEach(function(k){
    var v = MAP[k];
    if (REF_TABLE) { if (refCache[v] === undefined) { var r = new GlideRecord(REF_TABLE); refCache[v] = r.get(r.getDisplayName(), v) ? r.getUniqueValue() : null; } if (!refCache[v]) { STATS.skipped.push('reference not found for key ' + k); return; } v = refCache[v]; }
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); gr.addQuery(KEY_FIELD, k); if (EXTRA_QUERY) gr.addEncodedQuery(EXTRA_QUERY); gr.setLimit(MAX_ROWS); gr.query();
    while (gr.next()) { STATS.checked++; if (gr.getValue(FIELD) == v) continue; STATS.would_change++;
      if (!DRY_RUN) { gr.setValue(FIELD, v); gr.update(); STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(gr.getUniqueValue()); } }
  });
}
// Insert ROWS into TABLE when no record matches all MATCH_FIELDS.
function seed(TABLE, MATCH_FIELDS, ROWS){
  ROWS.forEach(function(row){
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); MATCH_FIELDS.forEach(function(f){ gr.addQuery(f, row[f]); }); gr.setLimit(1); gr.query();
    STATS.checked++; if (gr.hasNext()) return; STATS.would_change++;
    if (!DRY_RUN) { var n = new GlideRecord(TABLE); n.initialize(); Object.keys(row).forEach(function(f){ n.setValue(f, row[f]); }); var id = n.insert(); if (id) { STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(id); } }
  });
}
function report(name){ gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL ' + name + (DRY_RUN ? ' [DRY RUN]' : '') + ' ===\n' + JSON.stringify(STATS, null, 2)); }
var SOURCE_TABLE = 'cmdb_ci_business_app';   // <confirm> entity class table
var SOURCE_OWNER = 'it_application_owner';     // <confirm>
var e = new GlideRecord('sn_grc_profile'); e.addEncodedQuery('active=true^ownerISEMPTY^table=' + SOURCE_TABLE); e.setLimit(MAX_ROWS); e.query();   // <confirm> 'table' / 'applies_to' field names
while (e.next()) {
  STATS.checked++;
  var src = new GlideRecord(SOURCE_TABLE); if (!src.get(e.getValue('applies_to')) || !src.getValue(SOURCE_OWNER)) { STATS.skipped.push(e.getUniqueValue()); continue; }
  STATS.would_change++;
  if (!DRY_RUN) { e.setValue('owner', src.getValue(SOURCE_OWNER)); e.update(); STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(e.getUniqueValue()); }
}
report('irm-entity-owner');</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Sets the owner on IRM entities with no owner, copying the owner of the business application the entity applies to.", "prereqs": "Sub-production first. Fill the map/list from the client-approved source. Review the dry-run counts before switching DRY_RUN off.", "rollback": "The output lists changed_ids; reverse from an XML export taken beforehand or by re-running with the previous values."}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>true</modifies_data><pattern display_value="IRM / GRC policy, risk and compliance foundation">4b16aa07c3c5429a93a6f33c5ef138c0</pattern><seq>3</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:05</sys_created_on><sys_id>81406ef38f994495b3824bd14446860a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:05</sys_updated_on><title>Entity owner backfill from the source record (DRY RUN by default)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

var STATS = {checked: 0, would_change: 0, changed: 0, skipped: [], changed_ids: []};
// Set FIELD on records in TABLE matched by KEY_FIELD, using MAP {keyValue: newValue}. Reference values are resolved by display value in REF_TABLE (optional).
function backfill(TABLE, KEY_FIELD, FIELD, MAP, REF_TABLE, EXTRA_QUERY){
  var refCache = {};

    var v = MAP[k];
    if (REF_TABLE) { if (refCache[v] === undefined) { var r = new GlideRecord(REF_TABLE); refCache[v] = r.get(r.getDisplayName(), v) ? r.getUniqueValue() : null; } if (!refCache[v]) { STATS.skipped.push('reference not found for key ' + k); return; } v = refCache[v]; }
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); gr.addQuery(KEY_FIELD, k); if (EXTRA_QUERY) gr.addEncodedQuery(EXTRA_QUERY); gr.setLimit(MAX_ROWS); gr.query();

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB PVT verify s2p — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var W = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@30';
gs.print('=== DSB-PVT s2p ===\n' + JSON.stringify({
  procurement_ritms_30d: count('sc_req_item', W + '^cat_item.categoryLIKEprocure'),
  outbound_errors_30d: count('sys_outbound_http_log', W + '^response_status>=400'),
  vendors: count('core_company', 'vendor=true'),
  ran: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue()}, null, 2));</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Checks requests flow to the ERP and exceptions are routed.", "prereqs": null, "rollback": null}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Source-to-pay and procurement operations">8d626f620b62477fb3d9517346e13cf8</pattern><seq>1</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:07</sys_created_on><sys_id>8f1cc1a5c8ce439daf17990a54e0e2e9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:07</sys_updated_on><title>Post-implementation verification — S2P (READ ONLY)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

var FIELDS = ['employment_start_date','location','work_country'];   // <confirm> field names
var base = 'user.active=true';
var gaps = {active_users_with_employee_number: 0, without_profile: 0, profile_missing: {}, by_department_without_profile: {}};
var ga = new GlideAggregate('sys_user'); ga.addActiveQuery(); ga.addNotNullQuery('employee_number'); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query();
gaps.active_users_with_employee_number = ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0;
var pa = new GlideAggregate('sn_hr_core_profile'); pa.addEncodedQuery(base + '^user.employee_numberISNOTEMPTY'); pa.addAggregate('COUNT'); pa.query();
gaps.without_profile = gaps.active_users_with_employee_number - (pa.next() ? parseInt(pa.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0);
FIELDS.forEach(function(f){ var p = new GlideRecord('sn_hr_core_profile'); if (!p.isValidField(f)) { gaps.profile_missing[f] = 'field not found'; return; } var c = new GlideAggregate('sn_hr_core_profile'); c.addEncodedQuery(base + '^' + f + 'ISEMPTY'); c.addAggregate('COUNT'); c.query(); gaps.profile_missing[f] = c.next() ? parseInt(c.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; });
gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL hr-profile-gaps ===\n' + JSON.stringify(gaps, null, 2));</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Counts active employees without an HR profile and profiles missing lifecycle-critical fields. <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_diag_script"><x_1577958_dsb_diag_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description>Discovers installed applications, plugins, scopes, modules and custom tables without reading customer records.</description><kind>extract</kind><safety>Read-only metadata collection</safety><script_id>EXT-000</script_id><source>/*
 * EXT-000 - Installed application and module discovery
 * Run as a Global Background Script with an administrator who can read platform metadata.
 * Read-only: this script never changes instance configuration or customer records.
 * Output: servicenow-instance-manifest/1 JSON attached to the current sys_user record.
 *
 * CUSTOMER TEMPLATE - REQUIRED CONFIGURATION
 * Replace CUSTOMER_NAME and CUSTOMER_INSTANCE in CUSTOMER_PROFILE once, or paste the profile
 * generated by Diagnostic Workbench. Keep INCLUDE_INACTIVE false for the first run.
 */
(function () {
  var CUSTOMER_PROFILE = {
    schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-profile/1",
    customerName: "CUSTOMER_NAME",
    approvedInstance: "CUSTOMER_INSTANCE",
    includeInactive: false,
    maxRowsPerTable: 20000
  };

  var started = new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal();
  var result = {
    schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-result/1",
    scriptId: "EXT-000",
    version: "1.0.0",
    mode: "READ_ONLY",
    startedAt: started,
    profile: CUSTOMER_PROFILE,
    manifest: {
      schema: "servicenow-instance-manifest/1",
      generatedAt: started,
      instance: {
        name: gs.getProperty("instance_name", ""),
        url: gs.getProperty("glide.servlet.uri", ""),
        release: gs.getProperty("glide.product.description", "")
      },
      applications: [],
      storeApplications: [],
      scopes: [],
      plugins: [],
      applicationModules: [],
      customTables: [],
      warnings: [],
      errors: []
    },
    counts: {},
    warnings: [],
    errors: []
  };

  function text(gr, field) {
    return gr.isValidField(field) ? String(gr.getValue(field) || "") : "";
  }

  function display(gr, field) {
    return gr.isValidField(field) ? String(gr.getDisplayValue(field) || "") : "";
  }

  function collect(table, target, fields, query) {
    try {
      var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
      if (!gr.isValid()) {
        result.manifest.warnings.push("Table unavailable: " + table);
        return;
      }
      if (query) gr.addEncodedQuery(query);
      gr.setLimit(CUSTOMER_PROFILE.maxRowsPerTable);
      gr.query();
      while (gr.next()) {
        var row = { sys_id: text(gr, "sys_id") };
        for (var i = 0; i < fields.length; i += 1) {
          row[fields[i]] = text(gr, fields[i]);
        }
        if (gr.isValidField("application")) row.application_display = display(gr, "application");
        target.push(row);
      }
      result.counts[table] = target.length;
    } catch (error) {
      result.manifest.errors.push(table + ": " + String(error.message || error));
    }
  }

  collect("sys_app", result.manifest.applications, ["name", "scope", "version", "active", "vendor", "source"], CUSTOMER_PROFILE.includeInactive ? "" : "active=true");
  collect("sys_store_app", result.manifest.storeApplications, ["name", "scope", "version", "latest_version", "active", "vendor", "source"], CUSTOMER_PROFILE.includeInactive ? "" : "active=true");
  collect("sys_scope", result.manifest.scopes, ["name", "scope", "active", "vendor", "source"], CUSTOMER_PROFILE.includeInactive ? "" : "active=true");
  collect("v_plugin", result.manifest.plugins, ["id", "name", "version", "active", "description"], CUSTOMER_PROFILE.includeInactive ? "" : "active=true");
  collect("sys_app_module", result.manifest.applicationModules, ["title", "application", "active", "link_type", "name", "order"], CUSTOMER_PROFILE.includeInactive ? "" : "active=true");
  collect("sys_db_object", result.manifest.customTables, ["name", "label", "super_class", "sys_scope", "is_extendable"], "nameSTARTSWITHx_^ORnameSTARTSWITHu_");

  result.completedAt = new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal();
  result.ok = result.errors.length === 0 && result.manifest.errors.length === 0;
  var json = JSON.stringify(result, null, 2);
  var currentUser = new GlideRecord("sys_user");
  if (!currentUser.get(gs.getUserID())) {
    gs.error("EXT-000 could not resolve the current sys_user; printing JSON instead.");
    gs.print(json);
    return;
  }
  try {
    var attachment = new GlideSysAttachment();
    var fileName = "EXT-000_instance_module_manifest_" + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() + ".json";
    var attachmentSysId = attachment.write(currentUser, fileName, "application/json", json);
    gs.print("WORKBENCH_RESULT=" + JSON.stringify({ schema: result.schema, scriptId: result.scriptId, ok: result.ok, attachmentSysId: String(attachmentSysId), fileName: fileName, counts: result.counts }));
  } catch (attachmentError) {
    result.errors.push("Attachment write failed: " + String(attachmentError.message || attachmentError));
    gs.print(JSON.stringify(result));
  }
}());
</source><stage>2</stage><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>02f5556354a44f3fa04a8d334fd847a4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:44</sys_updated_on><title>Instance and module discovery</title><writes>false</writes></x_1577958_dsb_diag_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_diag_script"><x_1577958_dsb_diag_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description>Reusable acl state snapshot pattern from the remediation library.</description><kind>fix</kind><safety>Read-only audit</safety><script_id>FIX-19</script_id><source>/**
 * FIX-19 - ACL state snapshot
 * Reusable acl state snapshot pattern from the authoritative remediation library.
 *
 * CUSTOMER TEMPLATE - REQUIRED CONFIGURATION
 * Generate the customer profile in Diagnostic Workbench and replace every CUSTOMER_* value.
 * Review targets, encoded queries, fields and limits. Run read-only/PLAN first and import the
 * generated servicenow-diagnostic-result/1 JSON attachment back into the Workbench.
 */
(function () {
  var CUSTOMER_PROFILE = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-profile/1", customerName: "CUSTOMER_NAME", applicationName: "CUSTOMER_APP", approvedInstance: "CUSTOMER_INSTANCE", scopes: ["CUSTOMER_SCOPE"], tablePrefixes: ["CUSTOMER_TABLE_PREFIX"] };
  var CONFIGURATION = {
  "maxRowsPerTarget": 5000,
  "targets": [
    {
      "table": "sys_security_acl",
      "query": "active=true",
      "fields": [
        "name",
        "operation",
        "type",
        "admin_overrides",
        "condition",
        "script",
        "sys_updated_on"
      ],
      "limit": 5000
    }
  ]
};
  var result = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-result/1", scriptId: "FIX-19", version: "2.0.0", mode: "READ_ONLY", startedAt: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(), profile: CUSTOMER_PROFILE, records: [], counts: {}, warnings: [], errors: [] };
  function value(gr, field) { return gr.isValidField(field) ? String(gr.getValue(field) || "") : ""; }
  function emit() {
    result.completedAt = new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(); result.ok = result.errors.length === 0;
    var json = JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), user = new GlideRecord("sys_user");
    if (user.get(gs.getUserID())) { try { var name = "FIX-19_result_" + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() + ".json"; var id = new GlideSysAttachment().write(user, name, "application/json", json); gs.print("WORKBENCH_RESULT=" + JSON.stringify({ schema: result.schema, scriptId: result.scriptId, ok: result.ok, attachmentSysId: String(id), fileName: name, counts: result.counts })); return; } catch (e) { result.errors.push(String(e.message || e)); } }
    gs.print(JSON.stringify(result));
  }
  for (var i = 0; i < CONFIGURATION.targets.length; i += 1) {
    var target = CONFIGURATION.targets[i];
    try {
      if (/CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(target))) { result.warnings.push("Skipped unconfigured target " + target.table); continue; }
      var gr = new GlideRecord(target.table);
      if (!gr.isValid()) { result.warnings.push("Table unavailable: " + target.table); continue; }
      if (target.query) gr.addEncodedQuery(target.query);
      gr.setLimit(Math.min(Number(target.limit || CONFIGURATION.maxRowsPerTarget), CONFIGURATION.maxRowsPerTarget));
      gr.query(); var count = 0;
      while (gr.next()) { var row = { table: target.table, sys_id: value(gr, "sys_id"), values: {} }; for (var f = 0; f < target.fields.length; f += 1) row.values[target.fields[f]] = value(gr, target.fields[f]); result.records.push(row); count += 1; }
      result.counts[target.table] = (result.counts[target.table] || 0) + count;
    } catch (error) { result.errors.push(target.table + ": " + String(error.message || error)); }
  }
  emit();
}());
</source><stage>8</stage><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>0bcbb6e422084c76a63cf9e46bb7c886</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:44</sys_updated_on><title>ACL state snapshot</title><writes>false</writes></x_1577958_dsb_diag_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_diag_script"><x_1577958_dsb_diag_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description>Reusable monthly budget duplicates pattern from the remediation library.</description><kind>fix</kind><safety>Read-only audit</safety><script_id>FIX-13</script_id><source>/**
 * FIX-13 - Monthly budget duplicates
 * Reusable monthly budget duplicates pattern from the authoritative remediation library.
 *
 * CUSTOMER TEMPLATE - REQUIRED CONFIGURATION
 * Generate the customer profile in Diagnostic Workbench and replace every CUSTOMER_* value.
 * Review targets, encoded queries, fields and limits. Run read-only/PLAN first and import the
 * generated servicenow-diagnostic-result/1 JSON attachment back into the Workbench.
 */
(function () {
  var CUSTOMER_PROFILE = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-profile/1", customerName: "CUSTOMER_NAME", applicationName: "CUSTOMER_APP", approvedInstance: "CUSTOMER_INSTANCE", scopes: ["CUSTOMER_SCOPE"], tablePrefixes: ["CUSTOMER_TABLE_PREFIX"] };
  var CONFIGURATION = {
  "maxRowsPerTarget": 5000,
  "targets": []
};
  var result = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-result/1", scriptId: "FIX-13", version: "2.0.0", mode: "READ_ONLY", startedAt: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(), profile: CUSTOMER_PROFILE, records: [], counts: {}, warnings: [], errors: [] };
  function value(gr, field) { return gr.isValidField(field) ? String(gr.getValue(field) || "") : ""; }
  function emit() {
    result.completedAt = new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(); result.ok = result.errors.length === 0;
    var json = JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), user = new GlideRecord("sys_user");
    if (user.get(gs.getUserID())) { try { var name = "FIX-13_result_" + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() + ".json"; var id = new GlideSysAttachment().write(user, name, "application/json", json); gs.print("WORKBENCH_RESULT=" + JSON.stringify({ schema: result.schema, scriptId: result.scriptId, ok: result.ok, attachmentSysId: String(id), fileName: name, counts: result.counts })); return; } catch (e) { result.errors.push(String(e.message || e)); } }
    gs.print(JSON.stringify(result));
  }
  for (var i = 0; i < CONFIGURATION.targets.length; i += 1) {
    var target = CONFIGURATION.targets[i];
    try {
      if (/CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(target))) { result.warnings.push("Skipped unconfigured target " + target.table); continue; }
      var gr = new GlideRecord(target.table);
      if (!gr.isValid()) { result.warnings.push("Table unavailable: " + target.table); continue; }
      if (target.query) gr.addEncodedQuery(target.query);
      gr.setLimit(Math.min(Number(target.limit || CONFIGURATION.maxRowsPerTarget), CONFIGURATION.maxRowsPerTarget));
      gr.query(); var count = 0;
      while (gr.next()) { var row = { table: target.table, sys_id: value(gr, "sys_id"), values: {} }; for (var f = 0; f < target.fields.length; f += 1) row.values[target.fields[f]] = value(gr, target.fields[f]); result.records.push(row); count += 1; }
      result.counts[target.table] = (result.counts[target.table] || 0) + count;
    } catch (error) { result.errors.push(target.table + ": " + String(error.message || error)); }
  }
  emit();
}());
</source><stage>7</stage><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>564404d2bc80444682c9446691fafab6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:45</sys_updated_on><title>Monthly budget duplicates</title><writes>false</writes></x_1577958_dsb_diag_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_diag_script"><x_1577958_dsb_diag_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description>Reusable scheduled-job service account pattern from the remediation library.</description><kind>fix</kind><safety>PLAN first; APPLY needs instance, change and update-set preflight</safety><script_id>FIX-06</script_id><source>/**
 * FIX-06 - Scheduled-job service account
 * Reusable scheduled-job service account pattern from the authoritative remediation library.
 *
 * CUSTOMER TEMPLATE - REQUIRED CONFIGURATION
 * Generate the customer profile in Diagnostic Workbench and replace every CUSTOMER_* value.
 * Review targets, encoded queries, fields and limits. Run read-only/PLAN first and import the
 * generated servicenow-diagnostic-result/1 JSON attachment back into the Workbench.
 */
(function () {
  var CUSTOMER_PROFILE = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-profile/1", customerName: "CUSTOMER_NAME", applicationName: "CUSTOMER_APP", approvedInstance: "CUSTOMER_INSTANCE", changeReference: "CUSTOMER_CHANGE_REFERENCE" };
  var CONFIGURATION = { runMode: "PLAN", maxWrites: 25, requireNamedUpdateSet: true, actions: [] };
  var result = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-result/1", scriptId: "FIX-06", version: "2.0.0", mode: CONFIGURATION.runMode, startedAt: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(), profile: CUSTOMER_PROFILE, records: [], snapshots: [], rollback: [], counts: { planned: 0, applied: 0, skipped: 0 }, warnings: [], errors: [] };
  function value(gr, field) { return gr.isValidField(field) ? String(gr.getValue(field) || "") : ""; }
  function stop(message) { result.errors.push(message); gs.error("FIX-06 STOPPED: " + message); }
  function preflight() {
    if (CONFIGURATION.runMode !== "APPLY") return true;
    if (/CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(CUSTOMER_PROFILE)) || /CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(CONFIGURATION.actions))) { stop("Unresolved CUSTOMER_* placeholder."); return false; }
    var actual = String(gs.getProperty("glide.servlet.uri", "")).replace(/\/$/, "").toLowerCase();
    var approved = String(CUSTOMER_PROFILE.approvedInstance || "").replace(/\/$/, "").toLowerCase();
    if (!approved || actual.indexOf(approved) < 0) { stop("Instance does not match the approved customer profile."); return false; }
    if (!CUSTOMER_PROFILE.changeReference || /^CUSTOMER_/.test(CUSTOMER_PROFILE.changeReference)) { stop("A change reference is required."); return false; }
    if (!CONFIGURATION.actions.length || CONFIGURATION.actions.length > CONFIGURATION.maxWrites) { stop("Action count is zero or exceeds maxWrites."); return false; }
    if (CONFIGURATION.requireNamedUpdateSet) { var pref = String(gs.getPreference("sys_update_set") || ""); var us = new GlideRecord("sys_update_set"); if (!pref || !us.get(pref) || value(us, "name") === "Default") { stop("Select a named update set before APPLY."); return false; } }
    return true;
  }
  function emit() { result.completedAt = new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(); result.ok = result.errors.length === 0; var json = JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), user = new GlideRecord("sys_user"); if (user.get(gs.getUserID())) { try { var name = "FIX-06_snapshot_" + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() + ".json"; var id = new GlideSysAttachment().write(user, name, "application/json", json); gs.print("WORKBENCH_RESULT=" + JSON.stringify({ schema: result.schema, scriptId: result.scriptId, mode: result.mode, ok: result.ok, attachmentSysId: String(id), fileName: name, counts: result.counts })); return; } catch (e) { result.errors.push(String(e.message || e)); } } gs.print(JSON.stringify(result)); }
  if (!preflight()) { emit(); return; }
  for (var i = 0; i < CONFIGURATION.actions.length; i += 1) {
    var action = CONFIGURATION.actions[i]; result.counts.planned += 1;
    try {
      var gr = new GlideRecord(action.table); if (!gr.isValid() || !gr.get(action.sys_id)) { result.warnings.push("Record not found: " + action.table + "/" + action.sys_id); result.counts.skipped += 1; continue; }
      var before = {}, mismatch = false, key;
      for (key in action.changes) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(action.changes, key)) before[key] = value(gr, key);
      for (key in (action.expected || {})) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(action.expected, key) && value(gr, key) !== String(action.expected[key])) mismatch = true;
      result.snapshots.push({ table: action.table, sys_id: action.sys_id, before: before, intended: action.changes });
      if (mismatch) { result.warnings.push("Expected-state mismatch: " + action.table + "/" + action.sys_id); result.counts.skipped += 1; continue; }
      result.rollback.push({ table: action.table, sys_id: action.sys_id, changes: before });
      if (CONFIGURATION.runMode === "APPLY") { for (key in action.changes) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(action.changes, key) && gr.isValidField(key)) gr.setValue(key, String(action.changes[key])); gr.update(); result.counts.applied += 1; }
    } catch (error) { result.errors.push(action.table + "/" + action.sys_id + ": " + String(error.message || error)); }
  }
  emit();
}());

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_diag_script"><x_1577958_dsb_diag_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description>Reusable skipped-record disposition pattern from the remediation library.</description><kind>fix</kind><safety>PLAN first; APPLY needs instance, change and update-set preflight</safety><script_id>FIX-09</script_id><source>/**
 * FIX-09 - Skipped-record disposition
 * Reusable skipped-record disposition pattern from the authoritative remediation library.
 *
 * CUSTOMER TEMPLATE - REQUIRED CONFIGURATION
 * Generate the customer profile in Diagnostic Workbench and replace every CUSTOMER_* value.
 * Review targets, encoded queries, fields and limits. Run read-only/PLAN first and import the
 * generated servicenow-diagnostic-result/1 JSON attachment back into the Workbench.
 */
(function () {
  var CUSTOMER_PROFILE = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-profile/1", customerName: "CUSTOMER_NAME", applicationName: "CUSTOMER_APP", approvedInstance: "CUSTOMER_INSTANCE", changeReference: "CUSTOMER_CHANGE_REFERENCE" };
  var CONFIGURATION = { runMode: "PLAN", maxWrites: 25, requireNamedUpdateSet: true, actions: [] };
  var result = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-result/1", scriptId: "FIX-09", version: "2.0.0", mode: CONFIGURATION.runMode, startedAt: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(), profile: CUSTOMER_PROFILE, records: [], snapshots: [], rollback: [], counts: { planned: 0, applied: 0, skipped: 0 }, warnings: [], errors: [] };
  function value(gr, field) { return gr.isValidField(field) ? String(gr.getValue(field) || "") : ""; }
  function stop(message) { result.errors.push(message); gs.error("FIX-09 STOPPED: " + message); }
  function preflight() {
    if (CONFIGURATION.runMode !== "APPLY") return true;
    if (/CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(CUSTOMER_PROFILE)) || /CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(CONFIGURATION.actions))) { stop("Unresolved CUSTOMER_* placeholder."); return false; }
    var actual = String(gs.getProperty("glide.servlet.uri", "")).replace(/\/$/, "").toLowerCase();
    var approved = String(CUSTOMER_PROFILE.approvedInstance || "").replace(/\/$/, "").toLowerCase();
    if (!approved || actual.indexOf(approved) < 0) { stop("Instance does not match the approved customer profile."); return false; }
    if (!CUSTOMER_PROFILE.changeReference || /^CUSTOMER_/.test(CUSTOMER_PROFILE.changeReference)) { stop("A change reference is required."); return false; }
    if (!CONFIGURATION.actions.length || CONFIGURATION.actions.length > CONFIGURATION.maxWrites) { stop("Action count is zero or exceeds maxWrites."); return false; }
    if (CONFIGURATION.requireNamedUpdateSet) { var pref = String(gs.getPreference("sys_update_set") || ""); var us = new GlideRecord("sys_update_set"); if (!pref || !us.get(pref) || value(us, "name") === "Default") { stop("Select a named update set before APPLY."); return false; } }
    return true;
  }
  function emit() { result.completedAt = new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(); result.ok = result.errors.length === 0; var json = JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), user = new GlideRecord("sys_user"); if (user.get(gs.getUserID())) { try { var name = "FIX-09_snapshot_" + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() + ".json"; var id = new GlideSysAttachment().write(user, name, "application/json", json); gs.print("WORKBENCH_RESULT=" + JSON.stringify({ schema: result.schema, scriptId: result.scriptId, mode: result.mode, ok: result.ok, attachmentSysId: String(id), fileName: name, counts: result.counts })); return; } catch (e) { result.errors.push(String(e.message || e)); } } gs.print(JSON.stringify(result)); }
  if (!preflight()) { emit(); return; }
  for (var i = 0; i < CONFIGURATION.actions.length; i += 1) {
    var action = CONFIGURATION.actions[i]; result.counts.planned += 1;
    try {
      var gr = new GlideRecord(action.table); if (!gr.isValid() || !gr.get(action.sys_id)) { result.warnings.push("Record not found: " + action.table + "/" + action.sys_id); result.counts.skipped += 1; continue; }
      var before = {}, mismatch = false, key;
      for (key in action.changes) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(action.changes, key)) before[key] = value(gr, key);
      for (key in (action.expected || {})) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(action.expected, key) && value(gr, key) !== String(action.expected[key])) mismatch = true;
      result.snapshots.push({ table: action.table, sys_id: action.sys_id, before: before, intended: action.changes });
      if (mismatch) { result.warnings.push("Expected-state mismatch: " + action.table + "/" + action.sys_id); result.counts.skipped += 1; continue; }
      result.rollback.push({ table: action.table, sys_id: action.sys_id, changes: before });
      if (CONFIGURATION.runMode === "APPLY") { for (key in action.changes) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(action.changes, key) && gr.isValidField(key)) gr.setValue(key, String(action.changes[key])); gr.update(); result.counts.applied += 1; }
    } catch (error) { result.errors.push(action.table + "/" + action.sys_id + ": " + String(error.message || error)); }
  }
  emit();
}());

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_diag_script"><x_1577958_dsb_diag_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description>Reusable hardcoded values scan pattern from the remediation library.</description><kind>fix</kind><safety>Read-only audit</safety><script_id>FIX-10</script_id><source>/**
 * FIX-10 - Hardcoded values scan
 * Reusable hardcoded values scan pattern from the authoritative remediation library.
 *
 * CUSTOMER TEMPLATE - REQUIRED CONFIGURATION
 * Generate the customer profile in Diagnostic Workbench and replace every CUSTOMER_* value.
 * Review targets, encoded queries, fields and limits. Run read-only/PLAN first and import the
 * generated servicenow-diagnostic-result/1 JSON attachment back into the Workbench.
 */
(function () {
  var CUSTOMER_PROFILE = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-profile/1", customerName: "CUSTOMER_NAME", applicationName: "CUSTOMER_APP", approvedInstance: "CUSTOMER_INSTANCE", scopes: ["CUSTOMER_SCOPE"], tablePrefixes: ["CUSTOMER_TABLE_PREFIX"] };
  var CONFIGURATION = {
  "maxRowsPerTarget": 5000,
  "targets": [
    {
      "table": "sys_script",
      "query": "active=true",
      "fields": [
        "name",
        "collection",
        "script"
      ],
      "limit": 5000
    },
    {
      "table": "sys_script_include",
      "query": "active=true",
      "fields": [
        "name",
        "api_name",
        "script"
      ],
      "limit": 5000
    },
    {
      "table": "sys_properties",
      "query": "",
      "fields": [
        "name",
        "type",
        "description"
      ],
      "limit": 5000
    }
  ]
};
  var result = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-result/1", scriptId: "FIX-10", version: "2.0.0", mode: "READ_ONLY", startedAt: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(), profile: CUSTOMER_PROFILE, records: [], counts: {}, warnings: [], errors: [] };
  function value(gr, field) { return gr.isValidField(field) ? String(gr.getValue(field) || "") : ""; }
  function emit() {
    result.completedAt = new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(); result.ok = result.errors.length === 0;
    var json = JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), user = new GlideRecord("sys_user");
    if (user.get(gs.getUserID())) { try { var name = "FIX-10_result_" + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() + ".json"; var id = new GlideSysAttachment().write(user, name, "application/json", json); gs.print("WORKBENCH_RESULT=" + JSON.stringify({ schema: result.schema, scriptId: result.scriptId, ok: result.ok, attachmentSysId: String(id), fileName: name, counts: result.counts })); return; } catch (e) { result.errors.push(String(e.message || e)); } }
    gs.print(JSON.stringify(result));
  }
  for (var i = 0; i < CONFIGURATION.targets.length; i += 1) {
    var target = CONFIGURATION.targets[i];
    try {
      if (/CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(target))) { result.warnings.push("Skipped unconfigured target " + target.table); continue; }
      var gr = new GlideRecord(target.table);
      if (!gr.isValid()) { result.warnings.push("Table unavailable: " + target.table); continue; }
      if (target.query) gr.addEncodedQuery(target.query);
      gr.setLimit(Math.min(Number(target.limit || CONFIGURATION.maxRowsPerTarget), CONFIGURATION.maxRowsPerTarget));
      gr.query(); var count = 0;
      while (gr.next()) { var row = { table: target.table, sys_id: value(gr, "sys_id"), values: {} }; for (var f = 0; f < target.fields.length; f += 1) row.values[target.fields[f]] = value(gr, target.fields[f]); result.records.push(row); count += 1; }
      result.counts[target.table] = (result.counts[target.table] || 0) + count;
    } catch (error) { result.errors.push(target.table + ": " + String(error.message || error)); }
  }
  emit();
}());

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_diag_script"><x_1577958_dsb_diag_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description>Reusable web-service access audit pattern from the remediation library.</description><kind>fix</kind><safety>PLAN first; APPLY needs instance, change and update-set preflight</safety><script_id>FIX-03</script_id><source>/**
 * FIX-03 - Web-service access audit
 * Reusable web-service access audit pattern from the authoritative remediation library.
 *
 * CUSTOMER TEMPLATE - REQUIRED CONFIGURATION
 * Generate the customer profile in Diagnostic Workbench and replace every CUSTOMER_* value.
 * Review targets, encoded queries, fields and limits. Run read-only/PLAN first and import the
 * generated servicenow-diagnostic-result/1 JSON attachment back into the Workbench.
 */
(function () {
  var CUSTOMER_PROFILE = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-profile/1", customerName: "CUSTOMER_NAME", applicationName: "CUSTOMER_APP", approvedInstance: "CUSTOMER_INSTANCE", changeReference: "CUSTOMER_CHANGE_REFERENCE" };
  var CONFIGURATION = { runMode: "PLAN", maxWrites: 25, requireNamedUpdateSet: true, actions: [] };
  var result = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-result/1", scriptId: "FIX-03", version: "2.0.0", mode: CONFIGURATION.runMode, startedAt: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(), profile: CUSTOMER_PROFILE, records: [], snapshots: [], rollback: [], counts: { planned: 0, applied: 0, skipped: 0 }, warnings: [], errors: [] };
  function value(gr, field) { return gr.isValidField(field) ? String(gr.getValue(field) || "") : ""; }
  function stop(message) { result.errors.push(message); gs.error("FIX-03 STOPPED: " + message); }
  function preflight() {
    if (CONFIGURATION.runMode !== "APPLY") return true;
    if (/CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(CUSTOMER_PROFILE)) || /CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(CONFIGURATION.actions))) { stop("Unresolved CUSTOMER_* placeholder."); return false; }
    var actual = String(gs.getProperty("glide.servlet.uri", "")).replace(/\/$/, "").toLowerCase();
    var approved = String(CUSTOMER_PROFILE.approvedInstance || "").replace(/\/$/, "").toLowerCase();
    if (!approved || actual.indexOf(approved) < 0) { stop("Instance does not match the approved customer profile."); return false; }
    if (!CUSTOMER_PROFILE.changeReference || /^CUSTOMER_/.test(CUSTOMER_PROFILE.changeReference)) { stop("A change reference is required."); return false; }
    if (!CONFIGURATION.actions.length || CONFIGURATION.actions.length > CONFIGURATION.maxWrites) { stop("Action count is zero or exceeds maxWrites."); return false; }
    if (CONFIGURATION.requireNamedUpdateSet) { var pref = String(gs.getPreference("sys_update_set") || ""); var us = new GlideRecord("sys_update_set"); if (!pref || !us.get(pref) || value(us, "name") === "Default") { stop("Select a named update set before APPLY."); return false; } }
    return true;
  }
  function emit() { result.completedAt = new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(); result.ok = result.errors.length === 0; var json = JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), user = new GlideRecord("sys_user"); if (user.get(gs.getUserID())) { try { var name = "FIX-03_snapshot_" + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() + ".json"; var id = new GlideSysAttachment().write(user, name, "application/json", json); gs.print("WORKBENCH_RESULT=" + JSON.stringify({ schema: result.schema, scriptId: result.scriptId, mode: result.mode, ok: result.ok, attachmentSysId: String(id), fileName: name, counts: result.counts })); return; } catch (e) { result.errors.push(String(e.message || e)); } } gs.print(JSON.stringify(result)); }
  if (!preflight()) { emit(); return; }
  for (var i = 0; i < CONFIGURATION.actions.length; i += 1) {
    var action = CONFIGURATION.actions[i]; result.counts.planned += 1;
    try {
      var gr = new GlideRecord(action.table); if (!gr.isValid() || !gr.get(action.sys_id)) { result.warnings.push("Record not found: " + action.table + "/" + action.sys_id); result.counts.skipped += 1; continue; }
      var before = {}, mismatch = false, key;
      for (key in action.changes) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(action.changes, key)) before[key] = value(gr, key);

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_diag_script"><x_1577958_dsb_diag_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description>Collects named components that do not carry application tokens.</description><kind>extract</kind><safety>Read-only metadata collection</safety><script_id>EXT-103</script_id><source>/**
 * EXT-103 - Targeted top-up
 * Collects named components that do not carry application tokens.
 *
 * CUSTOMER TEMPLATE - REQUIRED CONFIGURATION
 * Generate the customer profile in Diagnostic Workbench and replace every CUSTOMER_* value.
 * Review targets, encoded queries, fields and limits. Run read-only/PLAN first and import the
 * generated servicenow-diagnostic-result/1 JSON attachment back into the Workbench.
 */
(function () {
  var CUSTOMER_PROFILE = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-profile/1", customerName: "CUSTOMER_NAME", applicationName: "CUSTOMER_APP", approvedInstance: "CUSTOMER_INSTANCE", scopes: ["CUSTOMER_SCOPE"], tablePrefixes: ["CUSTOMER_TABLE_PREFIX"] };
  var CONFIGURATION = {
  "maxRowsPerTarget": 5000,
  "targets": []
};
  var result = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-result/1", scriptId: "EXT-103", version: "2.0.0", mode: "READ_ONLY", startedAt: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(), profile: CUSTOMER_PROFILE, records: [], counts: {}, warnings: [], errors: [] };
  function value(gr, field) { return gr.isValidField(field) ? String(gr.getValue(field) || "") : ""; }
  function emit() {
    result.completedAt = new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(); result.ok = result.errors.length === 0;
    var json = JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), user = new GlideRecord("sys_user");
    if (user.get(gs.getUserID())) { try { var name = "EXT-103_result_" + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() + ".json"; var id = new GlideSysAttachment().write(user, name, "application/json", json); gs.print("WORKBENCH_RESULT=" + JSON.stringify({ schema: result.schema, scriptId: result.scriptId, ok: result.ok, attachmentSysId: String(id), fileName: name, counts: result.counts })); return; } catch (e) { result.errors.push(String(e.message || e)); } }
    gs.print(JSON.stringify(result));
  }
  for (var i = 0; i < CONFIGURATION.targets.length; i += 1) {
    var target = CONFIGURATION.targets[i];
    try {
      if (/CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(target))) { result.warnings.push("Skipped unconfigured target " + target.table); continue; }
      var gr = new GlideRecord(target.table);
      if (!gr.isValid()) { result.warnings.push("Table unavailable: " + target.table); continue; }
      if (target.query) gr.addEncodedQuery(target.query);
      gr.setLimit(Math.min(Number(target.limit || CONFIGURATION.maxRowsPerTarget), CONFIGURATION.maxRowsPerTarget));
      gr.query(); var count = 0;
      while (gr.next()) { var row = { table: target.table, sys_id: value(gr, "sys_id"), values: {} }; for (var f = 0; f < target.fields.length; f += 1) row.values[target.fields[f]] = value(gr, target.fields[f]); result.records.push(row); count += 1; }
      result.counts[target.table] = (result.counts[target.table] || 0) + count;
    } catch (error) { result.errors.push(target.table + ": " + String(error.message || error)); }
  }
  emit();
}());

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_diag_script"><x_1577958_dsb_diag_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description>Reusable audit enablement pattern from the remediation library.</description><kind>fix</kind><safety>PLAN first; APPLY needs instance, change and update-set preflight</safety><script_id>FIX-04</script_id><source>/**
 * FIX-04 - Audit enablement
 * Reusable audit enablement pattern from the authoritative remediation library.
 *
 * CUSTOMER TEMPLATE - REQUIRED CONFIGURATION
 * Generate the customer profile in Diagnostic Workbench and replace every CUSTOMER_* value.
 * Review targets, encoded queries, fields and limits. Run read-only/PLAN first and import the
 * generated servicenow-diagnostic-result/1 JSON attachment back into the Workbench.
 */
(function () {
  var CUSTOMER_PROFILE = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-profile/1", customerName: "CUSTOMER_NAME", applicationName: "CUSTOMER_APP", approvedInstance: "CUSTOMER_INSTANCE", changeReference: "CUSTOMER_CHANGE_REFERENCE" };
  var CONFIGURATION = { runMode: "PLAN", maxWrites: 25, requireNamedUpdateSet: true, actions: [] };
  var result = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-result/1", scriptId: "FIX-04", version: "2.0.0", mode: CONFIGURATION.runMode, startedAt: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(), profile: CUSTOMER_PROFILE, records: [], snapshots: [], rollback: [], counts: { planned: 0, applied: 0, skipped: 0 }, warnings: [], errors: [] };
  function value(gr, field) { return gr.isValidField(field) ? String(gr.getValue(field) || "") : ""; }
  function stop(message) { result.errors.push(message); gs.error("FIX-04 STOPPED: " + message); }
  function preflight() {
    if (CONFIGURATION.runMode !== "APPLY") return true;
    if (/CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(CUSTOMER_PROFILE)) || /CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(CONFIGURATION.actions))) { stop("Unresolved CUSTOMER_* placeholder."); return false; }
    var actual = String(gs.getProperty("glide.servlet.uri", "")).replace(/\/$/, "").toLowerCase();
    var approved = String(CUSTOMER_PROFILE.approvedInstance || "").replace(/\/$/, "").toLowerCase();
    if (!approved || actual.indexOf(approved) < 0) { stop("Instance does not match the approved customer profile."); return false; }
    if (!CUSTOMER_PROFILE.changeReference || /^CUSTOMER_/.test(CUSTOMER_PROFILE.changeReference)) { stop("A change reference is required."); return false; }
    if (!CONFIGURATION.actions.length || CONFIGURATION.actions.length > CONFIGURATION.maxWrites) { stop("Action count is zero or exceeds maxWrites."); return false; }
    if (CONFIGURATION.requireNamedUpdateSet) { var pref = String(gs.getPreference("sys_update_set") || ""); var us = new GlideRecord("sys_update_set"); if (!pref || !us.get(pref) || value(us, "name") === "Default") { stop("Select a named update set before APPLY."); return false; } }
    return true;
  }
  function emit() { result.completedAt = new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(); result.ok = result.errors.length === 0; var json = JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), user = new GlideRecord("sys_user"); if (user.get(gs.getUserID())) { try { var name = "FIX-04_snapshot_" + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() + ".json"; var id = new GlideSysAttachment().write(user, name, "application/json", json); gs.print("WORKBENCH_RESULT=" + JSON.stringify({ schema: result.schema, scriptId: result.scriptId, mode: result.mode, ok: result.ok, attachmentSysId: String(id), fileName: name, counts: result.counts })); return; } catch (e) { result.errors.push(String(e.message || e)); } } gs.print(JSON.stringify(result)); }
  if (!preflight()) { emit(); return; }
  for (var i = 0; i < CONFIGURATION.actions.length; i += 1) {
    var action = CONFIGURATION.actions[i]; result.counts.planned += 1;
    try {
      var gr = new GlideRecord(action.table); if (!gr.isValid() || !gr.get(action.sys_id)) { result.warnings.push("Record not found: " + action.table + "/" + action.sys_id); result.counts.skipped += 1; continue; }
      var before = {}, mismatch = false, key;
      for (key in action.changes) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(action.changes, key)) before[key] = value(gr, key);
      for (key in (action.expected || {})) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(action.expected, key) && value(gr, key) !== String(action.expected[key])) mismatch = true;
      result.snapshots.push({ table: action.table, sys_id: action.sys_id, before: before, intended: action.changes });
      if (mismatch) { result.warnings.push("Expected-state mismatch: " + action.table + "/" + action.sys_id); result.counts.skipped += 1; continue; }
      result.rollback.push({ table: action.table, sys_id: action.sys_id, changes: before });
      if (CONFIGURATION.runMode === "APPLY") { for (key in action.changes) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(action.changes, key) && gr.isValidField(key)) gr.setValue(key, String(action.changes[key])); gr.update(); result.counts.applied += 1; }
    } catch (error) { result.errors.push(action.table + "/" + action.sys_id + ": " + String(error.message || error)); }
  }
  emit();
}());

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_diag_script"><x_1577958_dsb_diag_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description>Reusable notification matrix pattern from the remediation library.</description><kind>fix</kind><safety>Read-only audit</safety><script_id>FIX-16</script_id><source>/**
 * FIX-16 - Notification matrix
 * Reusable notification matrix pattern from the authoritative remediation library.
 *
 * CUSTOMER TEMPLATE - REQUIRED CONFIGURATION
 * Generate the customer profile in Diagnostic Workbench and replace every CUSTOMER_* value.
 * Review targets, encoded queries, fields and limits. Run read-only/PLAN first and import the
 * generated servicenow-diagnostic-result/1 JSON attachment back into the Workbench.
 */
(function () {
  var CUSTOMER_PROFILE = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-profile/1", customerName: "CUSTOMER_NAME", applicationName: "CUSTOMER_APP", approvedInstance: "CUSTOMER_INSTANCE", scopes: ["CUSTOMER_SCOPE"], tablePrefixes: ["CUSTOMER_TABLE_PREFIX"] };
  var CONFIGURATION = {
  "maxRowsPerTarget": 5000,
  "targets": [
    {
      "table": "sysevent_register",
      "query": "",
      "fields": [
        "event_name",
        "table",
        "fired_by"
      ],
      "limit": 5000
    },
    {
      "table": "sysevent_email_action",
      "query": "active=true",
      "fields": [
        "name",
        "event_name",
        "collection",
        "recipient_users",
        "recipient_groups"
      ],
      "limit": 5000
    }
  ]
};
  var result = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-result/1", scriptId: "FIX-16", version: "2.0.0", mode: "READ_ONLY", startedAt: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(), profile: CUSTOMER_PROFILE, records: [], counts: {}, warnings: [], errors: [] };
  function value(gr, field) { return gr.isValidField(field) ? String(gr.getValue(field) || "") : ""; }
  function emit() {
    result.completedAt = new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(); result.ok = result.errors.length === 0;
    var json = JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), user = new GlideRecord("sys_user");
    if (user.get(gs.getUserID())) { try { var name = "FIX-16_result_" + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() + ".json"; var id = new GlideSysAttachment().write(user, name, "application/json", json); gs.print("WORKBENCH_RESULT=" + JSON.stringify({ schema: result.schema, scriptId: result.scriptId, ok: result.ok, attachmentSysId: String(id), fileName: name, counts: result.counts })); return; } catch (e) { result.errors.push(String(e.message || e)); } }
    gs.print(JSON.stringify(result));
  }
  for (var i = 0; i < CONFIGURATION.targets.length; i += 1) {
    var target = CONFIGURATION.targets[i];
    try {
      if (/CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(target))) { result.warnings.push("Skipped unconfigured target " + target.table); continue; }
      var gr = new GlideRecord(target.table);
      if (!gr.isValid()) { result.warnings.push("Table unavailable: " + target.table); continue; }
      if (target.query) gr.addEncodedQuery(target.query);
      gr.setLimit(Math.min(Number(target.limit || CONFIGURATION.maxRowsPerTarget), CONFIGURATION.maxRowsPerTarget));
      gr.query(); var count = 0;
      while (gr.next()) { var row = { table: target.table, sys_id: value(gr, "sys_id"), values: {} }; for (var f = 0; f < target.fields.length; f += 1) row.values[target.fields[f]] = value(gr, target.fields[f]); result.records.push(row); count += 1; }
      result.counts[target.table] = (result.counts[target.table] || 0) + count;
    } catch (error) { result.errors.push(target.table + ": " + String(error.message || error)); }
  }
  emit();
}());

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_diag_script"><x_1577958_dsb_diag_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description>Reusable client-callable acl generator pattern from the remediation library.</description><kind>fix</kind><safety>PLAN first; APPLY needs instance, change and update-set preflight</safety><script_id>FIX-02</script_id><source>/**
 * FIX-02 - Client-callable ACL generator
 * Reusable client-callable acl generator pattern from the authoritative remediation library.
 *
 * CUSTOMER TEMPLATE - REQUIRED CONFIGURATION
 * Generate the customer profile in Diagnostic Workbench and replace every CUSTOMER_* value.
 * Review targets, encoded queries, fields and limits. Run read-only/PLAN first and import the
 * generated servicenow-diagnostic-result/1 JSON attachment back into the Workbench.
 */
(function () {
  var CUSTOMER_PROFILE = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-profile/1", customerName: "CUSTOMER_NAME", applicationName: "CUSTOMER_APP", approvedInstance: "CUSTOMER_INSTANCE", changeReference: "CUSTOMER_CHANGE_REFERENCE" };
  var CONFIGURATION = { runMode: "PLAN", maxWrites: 25, requireNamedUpdateSet: true, actions: [] };
  var result = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-result/1", scriptId: "FIX-02", version: "2.0.0", mode: CONFIGURATION.runMode, startedAt: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(), profile: CUSTOMER_PROFILE, records: [], snapshots: [], rollback: [], counts: { planned: 0, applied: 0, skipped: 0 }, warnings: [], errors: [] };
  function value(gr, field) { return gr.isValidField(field) ? String(gr.getValue(field) || "") : ""; }
  function stop(message) { result.errors.push(message); gs.error("FIX-02 STOPPED: " + message); }
  function preflight() {
    if (CONFIGURATION.runMode !== "APPLY") return true;
    if (/CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(CUSTOMER_PROFILE)) || /CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(CONFIGURATION.actions))) { stop("Unresolved CUSTOMER_* placeholder."); return false; }
    var actual = String(gs.getProperty("glide.servlet.uri", "")).replace(/\/$/, "").toLowerCase();
    var approved = String(CUSTOMER_PROFILE.approvedInstance || "").replace(/\/$/, "").toLowerCase();
    if (!approved || actual.indexOf(approved) < 0) { stop("Instance does not match the approved customer profile."); return false; }
    if (!CUSTOMER_PROFILE.changeReference || /^CUSTOMER_/.test(CUSTOMER_PROFILE.changeReference)) { stop("A change reference is required."); return false; }
    if (!CONFIGURATION.actions.length || CONFIGURATION.actions.length > CONFIGURATION.maxWrites) { stop("Action count is zero or exceeds maxWrites."); return false; }
    if (CONFIGURATION.requireNamedUpdateSet) { var pref = String(gs.getPreference("sys_update_set") || ""); var us = new GlideRecord("sys_update_set"); if (!pref || !us.get(pref) || value(us, "name") === "Default") { stop("Select a named update set before APPLY."); return false; } }
    return true;
  }
  function emit() { result.completedAt = new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(); result.ok = result.errors.length === 0; var json = JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), user = new GlideRecord("sys_user"); if (user.get(gs.getUserID())) { try { var name = "FIX-02_snapshot_" + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() + ".json"; var id = new GlideSysAttachment().write(user, name, "application/json", json); gs.print("WORKBENCH_RESULT=" + JSON.stringify({ schema: result.schema, scriptId: result.scriptId, mode: result.mode, ok: result.ok, attachmentSysId: String(id), fileName: name, counts: result.counts })); return; } catch (e) { result.errors.push(String(e.message || e)); } } gs.print(JSON.stringify(result)); }
  if (!preflight()) { emit(); return; }
  for (var i = 0; i < CONFIGURATION.actions.length; i += 1) {
    var action = CONFIGURATION.actions[i]; result.counts.planned += 1;
    try {
      var gr = new GlideRecord(action.table); if (!gr.isValid() || !gr.get(action.sys_id)) { result.warnings.push("Record not found: " + action.table + "/" + action.sys_id); result.counts.skipped += 1; continue; }
      var before = {}, mismatch = false, key;
      for (key in action.changes) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(action.changes, key)) before[key] = value(gr, key);
      for (key in (action.expected || {})) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(action.expected, key) && value(gr, key) !== String(action.expected[key])) mismatch = true;
      result.snapshots.push({ table: action.table, sys_id: action.sys_id, before: before, intended: action.changes });
      if (mismatch) { result.warnings.push("Expected-state mismatch: " + action.table + "/" + action.sys_id); result.counts.skipped += 1; continue; }
      result.rollback.push({ table: action.table, sys_id: action.sys_id, changes: before });
      if (CONFIGURATION.runMode === "APPLY") { for (key in action.changes) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(action.changes, key) && gr.isValidField(key)) gr.setValue(key, String(action.changes[key])); gr.update(); result.counts.applied += 1; }
    } catch (error) { result.errors.push(action.table + "/" + action.sys_id + ": " + String(error.message || error)); }
  }
  emit();
}());

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_diag_script"><x_1577958_dsb_diag_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description>Read-only, count-first inventory and full source extraction.</description><kind>extract</kind><safety>Read-only metadata collection</safety><script_id>EXT-100</script_id><source>/**
 * EXT-100 - Artefact extract
 * Read-only, count-first inventory and full source extraction.
 *
 * CUSTOMER TEMPLATE - REQUIRED CONFIGURATION
 * Generate the customer profile in Diagnostic Workbench and replace every CUSTOMER_* value.
 * Review targets, encoded queries, fields and limits. Run read-only/PLAN first and import the
 * generated servicenow-diagnostic-result/1 JSON attachment back into the Workbench.
 */
(function () {
  var CUSTOMER_PROFILE = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-profile/1", customerName: "CUSTOMER_NAME", applicationName: "CUSTOMER_APP", approvedInstance: "CUSTOMER_INSTANCE", scopes: ["CUSTOMER_SCOPE"], tablePrefixes: ["CUSTOMER_TABLE_PREFIX"] };
  var CONFIGURATION = {
  "maxRowsPerTarget": 5000,
  "targets": [
    {
      "table": "sys_app",
      "query": "active=true",
      "fields": [
        "name",
        "scope",
        "version",
        "vendor",
        "source"
      ],
      "limit": 5000
    },
    {
      "table": "sys_scope",
      "query": "active=true",
      "fields": [
        "name",
        "scope",
        "vendor",
        "source"
      ],
      "limit": 5000
    },
    {
      "table": "sys_db_object",
      "query": "nameSTARTSWITHCUSTOMER_TABLE_PREFIX",
      "fields": [
        "name",
        "label",
        "super_class",
        "sys_scope"
      ],
      "limit": 5000
    },
    {
      "table": "sys_script",
      "query": "sys_scope.scopeINCUSTOMER_SCOPES",
      "fields": [
        "name",
        "collection",
        "active",
        "order",
        "when",
        "script"
      ],
      "limit": 5000
    },
    {
      "table": "sys_script_include",
      "query": "sys_scope.scopeINCUSTOMER_SCOPES",
      "fields": [
        "name",
        "api_name",
        "active",
        "client_callable",
        "script"
      ],
      "limit": 5000
    },
    {
      "table": "sys_security_acl",
      "query": "sys_scope.scopeINCUSTOMER_SCOPES",
      "fields": [
        "name",
        "operation",
        "type",
        "active",
        "script"
      ],
      "limit": 5000
    },
    {
      "table": "sys_hub_flow",
      "query": "sys_scope.scopeINCUSTOMER_SCOPES",
      "fields": [
        "name",
        "active",
        "status",
        "internal_name"
      ],
      "limit": 5000
    }
  ]
};
  var result = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-result/1", scriptId: "EXT-100", version: "2.0.0", mode: "READ_ONLY", startedAt: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(), profile: CUSTOMER_PROFILE, records: [], counts: {}, warnings: [], errors: [] };
  function value(gr, field) { return gr.isValidField(field) ? String(gr.getValue(field) || "") : ""; }
  function emit() {
    result.completedAt = new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(); result.ok = result.errors.length === 0;
    var json = JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), user = new GlideRecord("sys_user");
    if (user.get(gs.getUserID())) { try { var name = "EXT-100_result_" + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() + ".json"; var id = new GlideSysAttachment().write(user, name, "application/json", json); gs.print("WORKBENCH_RESULT=" + JSON.stringify({ schema: result.schema, scriptId: result.scriptId, ok: result.ok, attachmentSysId: String(id), fileName: name, counts: result.counts })); return; } catch (e) { result.errors.push(String(e.message || e)); } }
    gs.print(JSON.stringify(result));
  }
  for (var i = 0; i < CONFIGURATION.targets.length; i += 1) {
    var target = CONFIGURATION.targets[i];
    try {
      if (/CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(target))) { result.warnings.push("Skipped unconfigured target " + target.table); continue; }
      var gr = new GlideRecord(target.table);
      if (!gr.isValid()) { result.warnings.push("Table unavailable: " + target.table); continue; }
      if (target.query) gr.addEncodedQuery(target.query);
      gr.setLimit(Math.min(Number(target.limit || CONFIGURATION.maxRowsPerTarget), CONFIGURATION.maxRowsPerTarget));
      gr.query(); var count = 0;
      while (gr.next()) { var row = { table: target.table, sys_id: value(gr, "sys_id"), values: {} }; for (var f = 0; f < target.fields.length; f += 1) row.values[target.fields[f]] = value(gr, target.fields[f]); result.records.push(row); count += 1; }
      result.counts[target.table] = (result.counts[target.table] || 0) + count;
    } catch (error) { result.errors.push(target.table + ": " + String(error.message || error)); }
  }
  emit();
}());

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_diag_script"><x_1577958_dsb_diag_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description>Read-only fallback when JSON attachment download is blocked.</description><kind>extract</kind><safety>Read-only metadata collection</safety><script_id>EXT-104</script_id><source>/**
 * EXT-104 - Attachment log fallback
 * Read-only fallback when JSON attachment download is blocked.
 *
 * CUSTOMER TEMPLATE - REQUIRED CONFIGURATION
 * Generate the customer profile in Diagnostic Workbench and replace every CUSTOMER_* value.
 * Review targets, encoded queries, fields and limits. Run read-only/PLAN first and import the
 * generated servicenow-diagnostic-result/1 JSON attachment back into the Workbench.
 */
(function () {
  var CUSTOMER_PROFILE = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-profile/1", customerName: "CUSTOMER_NAME", applicationName: "CUSTOMER_APP", approvedInstance: "CUSTOMER_INSTANCE", scopes: ["CUSTOMER_SCOPE"], tablePrefixes: ["CUSTOMER_TABLE_PREFIX"] };
  var CONFIGURATION = {
  "maxRowsPerTarget": 5000,
  "targets": []
};
  var result = { schema: "servicenow-diagnostic-result/1", scriptId: "EXT-104", version: "2.0.0", mode: "READ_ONLY", startedAt: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(), profile: CUSTOMER_PROFILE, records: [], counts: {}, warnings: [], errors: [] };
  function value(gr, field) { return gr.isValidField(field) ? String(gr.getValue(field) || "") : ""; }
  function emit() {
    result.completedAt = new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValueInternal(); result.ok = result.errors.length === 0;
    var json = JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), user = new GlideRecord("sys_user");
    if (user.get(gs.getUserID())) { try { var name = "EXT-104_result_" + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() + ".json"; var id = new GlideSysAttachment().write(user, name, "application/json", json); gs.print("WORKBENCH_RESULT=" + JSON.stringify({ schema: result.schema, scriptId: result.scriptId, ok: result.ok, attachmentSysId: String(id), fileName: name, counts: result.counts })); return; } catch (e) { result.errors.push(String(e.message || e)); } }
    gs.print(JSON.stringify(result));
  }
  for (var i = 0; i < CONFIGURATION.targets.length; i += 1) {
    var target = CONFIGURATION.targets[i];
    try {
      if (/CUSTOMER_/.test(JSON.stringify(target))) { result.warnings.push("Skipped unconfigured target " + target.table); continue; }
      var gr = new GlideRecord(target.table);
      if (!gr.isValid()) { result.warnings.push("Table unavailable: " + target.table); continue; }
      if (target.query) gr.addEncodedQuery(target.query);
      gr.setLimit(Math.min(Number(target.limit || CONFIGURATION.maxRowsPerTarget), CONFIGURATION.maxRowsPerTarget));
      gr.query(); var count = 0;
      while (gr.next()) { var row = { table: target.table, sys_id: value(gr, "sys_id"), values: {} }; for (var f = 0; f < target.fields.length; f += 1) row.values[target.fields[f]] = value(gr, target.fields[f]); result.records.push(row); count += 1; }
      result.counts[target.table] = (result.counts[target.table] || 0) + count;
    } catch (error) { result.errors.push(target.table + ": " + String(error.message || error)); }
  }
  emit();
}());

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl"><x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><applies_to>all</applies_to><how>System Applications > All Available Applications > All, or export of sys_plugins (active=true)</how><item>Active plugin list</item><key>ev.plugins</key><script>// DSB EVIDENCE ev.plugins - READ ONLY. Prints counts, sys_ids and configuration names; no personal information.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
// --- DSB template helpers (read only) ---
function prop(n){ var v = gs.getProperty(n); return v === null || v === undefined ? 'not set' : String(v); }
function listRows(t, q, fields, lim, order){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ok = fields.filter(function(f){ return _fieldOk(t, f); }); if (ok.length < fields.length) DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': skipped missing field(s) ' + fields.filter(function(f){ return ok.indexOf(f) < 0; }).join(',')); var rows = []; var gr = new GlideRecord(t); if (q) gr.addEncodedQuery(q); if (order) { if (order.charAt(0) === '-') gr.orderByDesc(order.slice(1)); else gr.orderBy(order); } gr.setLimit(lim || 200); gr.query(); while (gr.next()) { var r = {}; ok.forEach(function(f){ r[f] = gr.getElement(f).getDisplayValue() || gr.getValue(f) || ''; }); rows.push(r); } return rows; }
function ages(t, q){ return {total: count(t, q), last_30d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@30'), last_90d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + LAST90), last_365d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@365')}; }
function pluginActive(id){ try { if (new GlidePluginManager().isActive(id)) return 1; } catch (e) {} if (_tbl('sys_plugins')) { var p = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins'); p.addQuery('source', id); p.addQuery('active', true); p.query(); if (p.hasNext()) return 1; } var a = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); if (a.isValid()) { a.addQuery('scope', id); a.addQuery('active', true); a.query(); if (a.hasNext()) return 1; } return 0; }
function userHasRole(name){ return count('sys_user_has_role', 'user=' + gs.getUserID() + '^role.name=' + name) > 0; }
var out = {key: 'ev.plugins'};
out.plugins_active = count('sys_plugins', 'active=true');
out.store_apps_active = count('sys_store_app', 'active=true');
out.active_plugin_ids = [];
if (_tbl('sys_plugins')) { var p = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins'); p.addQuery('active', true); p.orderBy('source'); p.setLimit(MAX_ROWS); p.query(); while (p.next()) out.active_plugin_ids.push(p.getValue('source')); }
out.key_capabilities = {
  integrationhub: pluginActive('com.glide.hub.integration.runtime'),
  flow_designer: pluginActive('com.glide.hub.flow_engine'),

};
out.note = 'key_capabilities: 1 = active, 0 = not active or not installed. Plugin IDs vary by release; confirm any 0 in System Applications.';
