<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl"><x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><applies_to>all</applies_to><how>Export of sys_script, sys_script_include, sys_ui_policy filtered by table / scope</how><item>Existing customisations in the affected area</item><key>ev.customisations</key><script>// DSB EVIDENCE ev.customisations - READ ONLY. Prints counts, sys_ids and configuration names; no personal information.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
// --- DSB template helpers (read only) ---
function prop(n){ var v = gs.getProperty(n); return v === null || v === undefined ? 'not set' : String(v); }
function listRows(t, q, fields, lim, order){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ok = fields.filter(function(f){ return _fieldOk(t, f); }); if (ok.length < fields.length) DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': skipped missing field(s) ' + fields.filter(function(f){ return ok.indexOf(f) < 0; }).join(',')); var rows = []; var gr = new GlideRecord(t); if (q) gr.addEncodedQuery(q); if (order) { if (order.charAt(0) === '-') gr.orderByDesc(order.slice(1)); else gr.orderBy(order); } gr.setLimit(lim || 200); gr.query(); while (gr.next()) { var r = {}; ok.forEach(function(f){ r[f] = gr.getElement(f).getDisplayValue() || gr.getValue(f) || ''; }); rows.push(r); } return rows; }
function ages(t, q){ return {total: count(t, q), last_30d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@30'), last_90d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + LAST90), last_365d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@365')}; }
function pluginActive(id){ try { if (new GlidePluginManager().isActive(id)) return 1; } catch (e) {} if (_tbl('sys_plugins')) { var p = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins'); p.addQuery('source', id); p.addQuery('active', true); p.query(); if (p.hasNext()) return 1; } var a = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); if (a.isValid()) { a.addQuery('scope', id); a.addQuery('active', true); a.query(); if (a.hasNext()) return 1; } return 0; }
function userHasRole(name){ return count('sys_user_has_role', 'user=' + gs.getUserID() + '^role.name=' + name) > 0; }
// Optional: the tables in scope, e.g. ['incident', 'task']. Leave empty for platform-wide counts.
var AREA_TABLES = [];
var out = {key: 'ev.customisations'};
function perArea(t, field, extra){ if (!AREA_TABLES.length) return count(t, extra || ''); var o = {}; AREA_TABLES.forEach(function(x){ o[x] = count(t, field + '=' + x + (extra ? '^' + extra : '')); }); return o; }
out.business_rules_active = perArea('sys_script', 'collection', 'active=true');
out.business_rules_by_table_top = groupCount('sys_script', 'collection', 'active=true', 30);
out.client_scripts_active = perArea('sys_script_client', 'table', 'active=true');
out.ui_policies_active = perArea('sys_ui_policy', 'table', 'active=true');
out.ui_actions_active = perArea('sys_ui_action', 'table', 'active=true');
out.data_policies_active = perArea('sys_data_policy2', 'model_table', 'active=true');
out.acls_active = count('sys_security_acl', 'active=true');
out.script_includes_by_scope = groupCount('sys_script_include', 'sys_scope', 'active=true', 30);
out.custom_fields_u = perArea('sys_dictionary', 'name', 'elementSTARTSWITHu_');
out.global_custom_fields_total = count('sys_dictionary', 'elementSTARTSWITHu_^nameNOT LIKEu_');
out.risk_setworkflow_false = count('sys_script', 'active=true^scriptLIKEsetWorkflow(false)');
out.risk_current_update_in_before_rule = count('sys_script', 'active=true^when=before^scriptLIKEcurrent.update()');
out.risk_gs_sleep = count('sys_script', 'active=true^scriptLIKEgs.sleep');
out.risk_dom_manipulation_client = count('sys_script_client', 'active=true^scriptLIKEdocument.getElement');
out.risk_client_getreference_calls = count('sys_script_client', 'active=true^scriptLIKEg_form.getReference(');
out.risk_hardcoded_sys_ids_in_rules = count('sys_script', 'active=true^scriptLIKEsys_id=');
out.instance_scan_findings_unmuted = count('scan_finding', 'muted=false');
out.note = 'risk_* are indicators for review, not defects. Run Instance Scan for a full health check.';
dsbPrint('ev.customisations', out);
</script><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>0ea58b24045b45b1aceb89fe0b4be4a1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:45</sys_updated_on><unblocks>Fit-gap, risk</unblocks><why>Global business rules, client scripts and script includes can conflict with new behaviour</why></x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl"><x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><applies_to>all</applies_to><how>Export of sys_update_set (state = in progress), release calendar</how><item>Update sets in progress and recent releases</item><key>ev.updatesets</key><script>// DSB EVIDENCE ev.updatesets - READ ONLY. Prints counts, sys_ids and configuration names; no personal information.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
// --- DSB template helpers (read only) ---
function prop(n){ var v = gs.getProperty(n); return v === null || v === undefined ? 'not set' : String(v); }
function listRows(t, q, fields, lim, order){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ok = fields.filter(function(f){ return _fieldOk(t, f); }); if (ok.length < fields.length) DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': skipped missing field(s) ' + fields.filter(function(f){ return ok.indexOf(f) < 0; }).join(',')); var rows = []; var gr = new GlideRecord(t); if (q) gr.addEncodedQuery(q); if (order) { if (order.charAt(0) === '-') gr.orderByDesc(order.slice(1)); else gr.orderBy(order); } gr.setLimit(lim || 200); gr.query(); while (gr.next()) { var r = {}; ok.forEach(function(f){ r[f] = gr.getElement(f).getDisplayValue() || gr.getValue(f) || ''; }); rows.push(r); } return rows; }
function ages(t, q){ return {total: count(t, q), last_30d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@30'), last_90d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + LAST90), last_365d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@365')}; }
function pluginActive(id){ try { if (new GlidePluginManager().isActive(id)) return 1; } catch (e) {} if (_tbl('sys_plugins')) { var p = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins'); p.addQuery('source', id); p.addQuery('active', true); p.query(); if (p.hasNext()) return 1; } var a = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); if (a.isValid()) { a.addQuery('scope', id); a.addQuery('active', true); a.query(); if (a.hasNext()) return 1; } return 0; }
function userHasRole(name){ return count('sys_user_has_role', 'user=' + gs.getUserID() + '^role.name=' + name) > 0; }
var out = {key: 'ev.updatesets'};
out.local_in_progress = count('sys_update_set', 'state=in progress');
out.local_in_progress_by_application = groupCount('sys_update_set', 'application', 'state=in progress', 40);
out.local_in_progress_older_90d = count('sys_update_set', 'state=in progress^sys_created_onRELATIVELT@dayofweek@ago@90');
out.local_completed_last_90d = count('sys_update_set', 'state=complete^' + LAST90);
out.remote_by_state = groupCount('sys_remote_update_set', 'state');
out.remote_committed_last_90d = count('sys_remote_update_set', 'state=committed^' + LAST90);
out.remote_preview_problems_open = count('sys_update_preview_problem', 'status=');
out.in_progress_sets = [];
var us = new GlideRecord('sys_update_set'); us.addQuery('state', 'in progress'); us.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on'); us.setLimit(100); us.query();
while (us.next()) { var ga = new GlideAggregate('sys_update_xml'); ga.addQuery('update_set', us.getUniqueValue()); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); out.in_progress_sets.push({sys_id: us.getUniqueValue(), application: us.application.getDisplayValue(), updates: ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0, updated: us.getValue('sys_updated_on')}); }
out.note = 'Names are not printed; open a set by sys_id. Ask the client for the release calendar.';
dsbPrint('ev.updatesets', out);
</script><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>255a2143a883467fac0227e80e3b2114</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:46</sys_updated_on><unblocks>Build plan</unblocks><why>Concurrent work can conflict with the build</why></x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl"><x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><applies_to>greenfield</applies_to><how>Design decision with the client platform owner</how><item>Decision: does the primary table extend Task?</item><key>gf.extendtask</key><script>// DSB EVIDENCE gf.extendtask - READ ONLY. Prints counts, sys_ids and configuration names; no personal information.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
// --- DSB template helpers (read only) ---
function prop(n){ var v = gs.getProperty(n); return v === null || v === undefined ? 'not set' : String(v); }
function listRows(t, q, fields, lim, order){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ok = fields.filter(function(f){ return _fieldOk(t, f); }); if (ok.length < fields.length) DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': skipped missing field(s) ' + fields.filter(function(f){ return ok.indexOf(f) < 0; }).join(',')); var rows = []; var gr = new GlideRecord(t); if (q) gr.addEncodedQuery(q); if (order) { if (order.charAt(0) === '-') gr.orderByDesc(order.slice(1)); else gr.orderBy(order); } gr.setLimit(lim || 200); gr.query(); while (gr.next()) { var r = {}; ok.forEach(function(f){ r[f] = gr.getElement(f).getDisplayValue() || gr.getValue(f) || ''; }); rows.push(r); } return rows; }
function ages(t, q){ return {total: count(t, q), last_30d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@30'), last_90d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + LAST90), last_365d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@365')}; }
function pluginActive(id){ try { if (new GlidePluginManager().isActive(id)) return 1; } catch (e) {} if (_tbl('sys_plugins')) { var p = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins'); p.addQuery('source', id); p.addQuery('active', true); p.query(); if (p.hasNext()) return 1; } var a = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); if (a.isValid()) { a.addQuery('scope', id); a.addQuery('active', true); a.query(); if (a.hasNext()) return 1; } return 0; }
function userHasRole(name){ return count('sys_user_has_role', 'user=' + gs.getUserID() + '^role.name=' + name) > 0; }
var out = {key: 'gf.extendtask'};
out.task_rows = count('task');
out.task_children_total = count('sys_db_object', 'super_class.name=task');
out.task_children_custom = listRows('sys_db_object', 'super_class.name=task^nameSTARTSWITHx_^ORnameSTARTSWITHu_', ['name', 'label', 'sys_scope'], 100, 'name');
out.custom_tables_not_extending = count('sys_db_object', 'nameSTARTSWITHx_^ORnameSTARTSWITHu_^super_classISEMPTY');
out.task_sla_definitions = count('contract_sla', 'active=true');
out.task_business_rules_global = count('sys_script', 'collection=task^active=true');
out.note = 'Extending task brings SLAs, assignment, approvals and workspace support, plus every rule on task. Record the decision as an ADR.';
dsbPrint('gf.extendtask', out);
</script><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>8a7217022b724133b01c2a6dcf216e10</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:46</sys_updated_on><unblocks>Table design</unblocks><why>Extending task reuses approvals, SLAs, assignment and activity stream but inherits global task behaviour</why></x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl"><x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><applies_to>all</applies_to><how>Client platform owner</how><item>Environment landscape and clone/refresh cadence</item><key>ev.envs</key><script>// DSB EVIDENCE ev.envs - READ ONLY. Prints counts, sys_ids and configuration names; no personal information.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
// --- DSB template helpers (read only) ---
function prop(n){ var v = gs.getProperty(n); return v === null || v === undefined ? 'not set' : String(v); }
function listRows(t, q, fields, lim, order){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ok = fields.filter(function(f){ return _fieldOk(t, f); }); if (ok.length < fields.length) DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': skipped missing field(s) ' + fields.filter(function(f){ return ok.indexOf(f) < 0; }).join(',')); var rows = []; var gr = new GlideRecord(t); if (q) gr.addEncodedQuery(q); if (order) { if (order.charAt(0) === '-') gr.orderByDesc(order.slice(1)); else gr.orderBy(order); } gr.setLimit(lim || 200); gr.query(); while (gr.next()) { var r = {}; ok.forEach(function(f){ r[f] = gr.getElement(f).getDisplayValue() || gr.getValue(f) || ''; }); rows.push(r); } return rows; }
function ages(t, q){ return {total: count(t, q), last_30d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@30'), last_90d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + LAST90), last_365d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@365')}; }
function pluginActive(id){ try { if (new GlidePluginManager().isActive(id)) return 1; } catch (e) {} if (_tbl('sys_plugins')) { var p = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins'); p.addQuery('source', id); p.addQuery('active', true); p.query(); if (p.hasNext()) return 1; } var a = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); if (a.isValid()) { a.addQuery('scope', id); a.addQuery('active', true); a.query(); if (a.hasNext()) return 1; } return 0; }
function userHasRole(name){ return count('sys_user_has_role', 'user=' + gs.getUserID() + '^role.name=' + name) > 0; }
var out = {key: 'ev.envs'};
out.instance_name = prop('instance_name');
out.clone_requests_365d = count('clone_instance', 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@365');
out.clone_requests_by_state = groupCount('clone_instance', 'state');
out.last_clones = listRows('clone_instance', '', ['target_instance', 'state', 'scheduled', 'completed'], 5, '-sys_created_on');
out.clone_targets = listRows('instance', '', ['instance_name', 'instance_url'], 20, 'instance_name');
out.clone_exclusions = count('clone_data_exclude', 'include_in_system_clone=true');
out.clone_data_preservers = count('clone_data_preserver', 'include_in_system_clone=true');
out.remote_instances = listRows('sys_update_set_source', 'active=true', ['name', 'url', 'type'], 20, 'name');
out.note = 'Confirm the full environment list, refresh cadence and code-freeze windows with the platform owner.';
dsbPrint('ev.envs', out);
</script><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>9b60442db47141cbab4ff2b80635bd61</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:46</sys_updated_on><unblocks>Build plan, PVT</unblocks><why>Determines build, test and cutover sequencing</why></x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl"><x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><applies_to>greenfield</applies_to><how>Confirm sys_properties: glide.appcreator.company.code, agree app name with the platform owner</how><item>Approved application name and scope prefix</item><key>gf.name</key><script>// DSB EVIDENCE gf.name - READ ONLY. Prints counts, sys_ids and configuration names; no personal information.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
// --- DSB template helpers (read only) ---
function prop(n){ var v = gs.getProperty(n); return v === null || v === undefined ? 'not set' : String(v); }
function listRows(t, q, fields, lim, order){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ok = fields.filter(function(f){ return _fieldOk(t, f); }); if (ok.length < fields.length) DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': skipped missing field(s) ' + fields.filter(function(f){ return ok.indexOf(f) < 0; }).join(',')); var rows = []; var gr = new GlideRecord(t); if (q) gr.addEncodedQuery(q); if (order) { if (order.charAt(0) === '-') gr.orderByDesc(order.slice(1)); else gr.orderBy(order); } gr.setLimit(lim || 200); gr.query(); while (gr.next()) { var r = {}; ok.forEach(function(f){ r[f] = gr.getElement(f).getDisplayValue() || gr.getValue(f) || ''; }); rows.push(r); } return rows; }
function ages(t, q){ return {total: count(t, q), last_30d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@30'), last_90d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + LAST90), last_365d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@365')}; }
function pluginActive(id){ try { if (new GlidePluginManager().isActive(id)) return 1; } catch (e) {} if (_tbl('sys_plugins')) { var p = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins'); p.addQuery('source', id); p.addQuery('active', true); p.query(); if (p.hasNext()) return 1; } var a = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); if (a.isValid()) { a.addQuery('scope', id); a.addQuery('active', true); a.query(); if (a.hasNext()) return 1; } return 0; }
function userHasRole(name){ return count('sys_user_has_role', 'user=' + gs.getUserID() + '^role.name=' + name) > 0; }
// Optional: the proposed scope, e.g. 'x_acme_widget'. Leave blank to list what exists.
var PROPOSED_SCOPE = '';
var out = {key: 'gf.name'};
out.company_code = prop('glide.appcreator.company.code');
out.scopes_with_company_prefix = count('sys_scope', 'scopeSTARTSWITHx_' + out.company_code + '_');
out.custom_scopes = listRows('sys_app', '', ['scope', 'name', 'version'], 300, 'scope');
if (PROPOSED_SCOPE) { out.proposed_scope = PROPOSED_SCOPE; out.proposed_scope_already_exists = count('sys_scope', 'scope=' + PROPOSED_SCOPE); out.proposed_scope_length = PROPOSED_SCOPE.length; out.proposed_scope_too_long_error = PROPOSED_SCOPE.length > 18 ? 1 : 0; }
out.note = 'Scoped table names are limited to 30 characters in total, so keep the scope short.';
dsbPrint('gf.name', out);
</script><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>a4a501fdc1d345a98addbdf1595b2600</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:46</sys_updated_on><unblocks>App creation</unblocks><why>Scope name cannot be changed after creation; company code drives the x_ prefix</why></x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl"><x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><applies_to>greenfield</applies_to><how>Client process owner</how><item>Personas, expected user counts and role model</item><key>gf.personas</key><script>// DSB EVIDENCE gf.personas - READ ONLY. Prints counts, sys_ids and configuration names; no personal information.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
// --- DSB template helpers (read only) ---
function prop(n){ var v = gs.getProperty(n); return v === null || v === undefined ? 'not set' : String(v); }
function listRows(t, q, fields, lim, order){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ok = fields.filter(function(f){ return _fieldOk(t, f); }); if (ok.length < fields.length) DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': skipped missing field(s) ' + fields.filter(function(f){ return ok.indexOf(f) < 0; }).join(',')); var rows = []; var gr = new GlideRecord(t); if (q) gr.addEncodedQuery(q); if (order) { if (order.charAt(0) === '-') gr.orderByDesc(order.slice(1)); else gr.orderBy(order); } gr.setLimit(lim || 200); gr.query(); while (gr.next()) { var r = {}; ok.forEach(function(f){ r[f] = gr.getElement(f).getDisplayValue() || gr.getValue(f) || ''; }); rows.push(r); } return rows; }
function ages(t, q){ return {total: count(t, q), last_30d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@30'), last_90d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + LAST90), last_365d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@365')}; }
function pluginActive(id){ try { if (new GlidePluginManager().isActive(id)) return 1; } catch (e) {} if (_tbl('sys_plugins')) { var p = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins'); p.addQuery('source', id); p.addQuery('active', true); p.query(); if (p.hasNext()) return 1; } var a = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); if (a.isValid()) { a.addQuery('scope', id); a.addQuery('active', true); a.query(); if (a.hasNext()) return 1; } return 0; }
function userHasRole(name){ return count('sys_user_has_role', 'user=' + gs.getUserID() + '^role.name=' + name) > 0; }
var out = {key: 'gf.personas'};
out.active_users = count('sys_user', 'active=true');
out.active_users_with_roles_by_role_top = groupCount('sys_user_has_role', 'role', 'user.active=true', 30);
out.groups_by_type = groupCount('sys_user_group', 'type', 'active=true', 20);
out.departments = count('cmn_department');
out.locations = count('cmn_location');
out.self_service_only_users_estimate = diff(out.active_users, count('sys_user_has_role', 'user.active=true^role.name=itil'));
out.note = 'Personas, user counts per persona and the target role model come from the process owner. Counts here are a sanity check.';
dsbPrint('gf.personas', out);
</script><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>b7391a4ef3a947059e377fdc1d523824</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:46</sys_updated_on><unblocks>Security design</unblocks><why>Drives roles, ACLs and licensing (fulfiller vs requester)</why></x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl"><x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><applies_to>all</applies_to><how>Client platform owner</how><item>Developer access to sub-production (admin or scoped developer) and source-control access</item><key>ev.access</key><script>// DSB EVIDENCE ev.access - READ ONLY. Prints counts, sys_ids and configuration names; no personal information.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
// --- DSB template helpers (read only) ---
function prop(n){ var v = gs.getProperty(n); return v === null || v === undefined ? 'not set' : String(v); }
function listRows(t, q, fields, lim, order){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ok = fields.filter(function(f){ return _fieldOk(t, f); }); if (ok.length < fields.length) DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': skipped missing field(s) ' + fields.filter(function(f){ return ok.indexOf(f) < 0; }).join(',')); var rows = []; var gr = new GlideRecord(t); if (q) gr.addEncodedQuery(q); if (order) { if (order.charAt(0) === '-') gr.orderByDesc(order.slice(1)); else gr.orderBy(order); } gr.setLimit(lim || 200); gr.query(); while (gr.next()) { var r = {}; ok.forEach(function(f){ r[f] = gr.getElement(f).getDisplayValue() || gr.getValue(f) || ''; }); rows.push(r); } return rows; }
function ages(t, q){ return {total: count(t, q), last_30d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@30'), last_90d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + LAST90), last_365d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@365')}; }
function pluginActive(id){ try { if (new GlidePluginManager().isActive(id)) return 1; } catch (e) {} if (_tbl('sys_plugins')) { var p = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins'); p.addQuery('source', id); p.addQuery('active', true); p.query(); if (p.hasNext()) return 1; } var a = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); if (a.isValid()) { a.addQuery('scope', id); a.addQuery('active', true); a.query(); if (a.hasNext()) return 1; } return 0; }
function userHasRole(name){ return count('sys_user_has_role', 'user=' + gs.getUserID() + '^role.name=' + name) > 0; }
// Run as the consultant account that will build. Prints true/false for this account only.
var out = {key: 'ev.access'};
out.instance_name = prop('instance_name');
// Explicit grants only: gs.hasRole() is true for every role when the user is admin.
out.running_user_granted = {admin: userHasRole('admin'), security_admin: userHasRole('security_admin'), delegated_developer: userHasRole('delegated_developer'), app_creator: userHasRole('sn_g_app_creator.app_creator'), import_admin: userHasRole('import_admin'), atf_test_designer: userHasRole('atf_test_designer')};
out.company_code = prop('glide.appcreator.company.code');
out.source_control_repos = count('sys_repo_config');
out.cicd_plugin_active = pluginActive('com.glide.continuousdelivery');
out.studio_or_app_engine_studio = {studio: pluginActive('com.glide.sn-studio'), app_engine_studio: pluginActive('sn_app_eng_studio')};
out.ip_access_control_rules = count('ip_access', 'active=true');
out.note = 'Confirm sub-production admin or scoped developer access and Git access for the whole build window.';
dsbPrint('ev.access', out);
</script><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>c140bb2129ee468aac0609e1317ef231</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:46</sys_updated_on><unblocks>Build start</unblocks><why>Build cannot start without it</why></x_1577958_dsb_evidence_tmpl></record_update>

function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }

function pluginActive(id){ try { if (new GlidePluginManager().isActive(id)) return 1; } catch (e) {} if (_tbl('sys_plugins')) { var p = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins'); p.addQuery('source', id); p.addQuery('active', true); p.query(); if (p.hasNext()) return 1; } var a = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); if (a.isValid()) { a.addQuery('scope', id); a.addQuery('active', true); a.query(); if (a.hasNext()) return 1; } return 0; }
function userHasRole(name){ return count('sys_user_has_role', 'user=' + gs.getUserID() + '^role.name=' + name) > 0; }

var AREA_ROLE_PREFIXES = [];
var out = {key: 'ev.roles'};
out.roles_total = count('sys_user_role');
out.roles_custom_global = count('sys_user_role', 'nameSTARTSWITHu_');
out.roles_elevated = count('sys_user_role', 'elevated_privilege=true');
out.groups_active = count('sys_user_group', 'active=true');
out.groups_by_type = groupCount('sys_user_group', 'type', 'active=true', 20);
var withMembers = groupSet('sys_user_grmember', 'group', 'user.active=true');
out.groups_without_active_members = 0;
var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group'); g.addQuery('active', true); g.setLimit(MAX_ROWS); g.query(); while (g.next()) { if (!withMembers[g.getUniqueValue()]) out.groups_without_active_members++; }
out.groups_without_manager = count('sys_user_group', 'active=true^managerISEMPTY');
out.active_users_by_role_top = groupCount('sys_user_has_role', 'role', 'user.active=true', 40);
out.admins_active = count('sys_user_has_role', 'role.name=admin^user.active=true');
out.roles_granted_directly_not_via_group = count('sys_user_has_role', 'inherited=false^user.active=true');
if (AREA_ROLE_PREFIXES.length) { out.area_roles = {}; AREA_ROLE_PREFIXES.forEach(function(p){ out.area_roles[p] = {roles: count('sys_user_role', 'nameSTARTSWITH' + p), active_users: count('sys_user_has_role', 'role.nameSTARTSWITH' + p + '^user.active=true')}; }); }
out.note = 'Counts only; no user names are printed.';
dsbPrint('ev.roles', out);

App Engine, IntegrationHub, Workspace)</item><key>ev.licence</key><script>// DSB EVIDENCE ev.licence - READ ONLY. Prints counts, sys_ids and configuration names; no personal information.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
// --- DSB template helpers (read only) ---
function prop(n){ var v = gs.getProperty(n); return v === null || v === undefined ? 'not set' : String(v); }
function listRows(t, q, fields, lim, order){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ok = fields.filter(function(f){ return _fieldOk(t, f); }); if (ok.length < fields.length) DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': skipped missing field(s) ' + fields.filter(function(f){ return ok.indexOf(f) < 0; }).join(',')); var rows = []; var gr = new GlideRecord(t); if (q) gr.addEncodedQuery(q); if (order) { if (order.charAt(0) === '-') gr.orderByDesc(order.slice(1)); else gr.orderBy(order); } gr.setLimit(lim || 200); gr.query(); while (gr.next()) { var r = {}; ok.forEach(function(f){ r[f] = gr.getElement(f).getDisplayValue() || gr.getValue(f) || ''; }); rows.push(r); } return rows; }
function ages(t, q){ return {total: count(t, q), last_30d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@30'), last_90d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + LAST90), last_365d: count(t, (q ? q + '^' : '') + 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@365')}; }
function pluginActive(id){ try { if (new GlidePluginManager().isActive(id)) return 1; } catch (e) {} if (_tbl('sys_plugins')) { var p = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins'); p.addQuery('source', id); p.addQuery('active', true); p.query(); if (p.hasNext()) return 1; } var a = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); if (a.isValid()) { a.addQuery('scope', id); a.addQuery('active', true); a.query(); if (a.hasNext()) return 1; } return 0; }
function userHasRole(name){ return count('sys_user_has_role', 'user=' + gs.getUserID() + '^role.name=' + name) > 0; }
// Subscription data is only as good as Subscription Management on this instance. Written confirmation from the account team is still required.
var out = {key: 'ev.licence'};
out.licence_records = count('license_details');
out.subscription_entitlements = count('subscription_entitlement');
out.licences = listRows('license_details', '', ['name', 'count', 'allocated', 'start_date', 'end_date'], 200, 'name');
out.custom_tables_scoped = count('sys_db_object', 'nameSTARTSWITHx_');
out.custom_tables_global = count('sys_db_object', 'nameSTARTSWITHu_');
out.integrationhub_spokes_installed = count('sys_store_app', 'active=true^nameLIKESpoke');
out.workspaces_configured = count('sys_ux_page_registry', 'active=true');
out.note = 'An empty licence list is normal on a PDI or when Subscription Management is not set up. Licensing is contractual: technical availability here does not prove entitlement. Record the account team confirmation on the engagement.';
dsbPrint('ev.licence', out);

sys_update_xml.name: x_1577958_dsb_pattern_009e981159a14b74a82d20a26b9752a8
sys_update_xml.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><exclude_terms>[]</exclude_terms><indicative_cases>23</indicative_cases><key>spm-portfolio</key><library_version>1.5</library_version><licence_products>spm</licence_products><min_hits>2</min_hits><name>Strategic Portfolio Management (demand, project, portfolio)</name><overview>Intake, decide, deliver, measure. (1) One intake: Idea/Demand record producer in the portal; demand assessment and scoring using OOB assessments. (2) Portfolio structure (portfolio → programme → planning items) with owners and fiscal periods; Portfolio Planning Workspace for prioritisation and funding scenarios where licensed. (3) Demand to project/epic conversion using OOB actions — no re-keying. (4) Project delivery on OOB Project Workspace: plans, baselines, status reports, RAID. (5) Resource management on OOB resource plans with group capacity; time cards feeding actuals and cost plans. (6) Agile (Enterprise Agile Planning) linked to planning items where teams already work in sprints; integrate with Jira rather than force a move if that is the decision. (7) Goals and targets for alignment; executive dashboards. Configure OOB states and forms; avoid custom fields on pm_project unless reporting demands them.</overview><pain>Demand arrives through many channels; no consistent assessment or prioritisation Project status reported manually in slide decks Resource over-allocation discovered late No link between funded work and strategic objectives Project, agile and financial data in separate tools</pain><phase>2</phase><requires/><strong_terms>[{"re": "\\bSPM\\b|\\bPPM\\b|portfolio", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "demand (management|intake)", "flags": "i"}]</strong_terms><summary>Work enters IT through email and meetings, projects are tracked in separate tools and spreadsheets, and leaders cannot see what is being funded, who is working on it or whether it delivers strategic goals. The pattern converges on OOB SPM: a single demand intake with scoring, portfolios and programmes with planning items, project and agile delivery on the platform, resource plans and time cards feeding cost, and portfolio dashboards tied to goals.</summary><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:47</sys_created_on><sys_id>009e981159a14b74a82d20a26b9752a8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:47</sys_updated_on><triggers>[{"re": "\\bSPM\\b|\\bPPM\\b|strategic portfolio|project portfolio", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "demand|intake|idea", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "project|programme|program", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "portfolio|investment|funding|budget", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "resource (plan|management|capacity)|timesheet|time card", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "agile|scrum|SAFe|epic|story|sprint", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "roadmap|\\bOKR\\b|goal|alignment", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "projects?", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "budget|funding", "flags": "i"}]</triggers><verification_notes/><verified>false</verified><verified_on/><verified_release/></x_1577958_dsb_pattern></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: x_1577958_dsb_pattern_031fd78c2b3742d38dc20450125b3992
sys_update_xml.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><exclude_terms>[]</exclude_terms><indicative_cases>60</indicative_cases><key>cmdb-csdm-foundation</key><library_version>1.5</library_version><licence_products>itom_visibility</licence_products><min_hits>2</min_hits><name>CMDB and CSDM foundation with Discovery / Service Graph</name><overview>Govern first, populate second, model third. (1) Agree governance: CMDB owner, class owners, data stewards, and a change process for the data model. (2) Scope CSDM to "Foundation" and "Crawl" first — foundation data, business applications, business services, offerings — with named owners. (3) Replace direct transforms with Service Graph Connectors, Discovery or IntegrationHub ETL so every write goes through the IRE; set identification rules per class (serial / object ID before name) and reconciliation precedence per attribute. (4) Model application services (manual, tag-based or Service Mapping) and relate business applications to them. (5) Turn on CMDB Health with agreed thresholds and CMDB Data Manager policies for stale CI retirement and attestation; de-duplicate through tasks. (6) Wire ITSM to the model: service offerings on incidents/changes, impact and conflict detection. (7) Report monthly to the governance forum. No custom CI tables unless a CSDM class genuinely does not exist.</overview><pain>Duplicate and stale CIs; nobody knows which source is right Services and applications are not modelled, so impact and change risk are guesswork Import sets write directly to CMDB tables, bypassing the IRE CIs have no owner or support group, so incidents and changes cannot be routed CMDB programmes stall because governance and ownership were never agreed</pain><phase>1</phase><requires/><strong_terms>[{"re": "\\bCMDB\\b", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "\\bCSDM\\b", "flags": "i"}]</strong_terms><summary>The CMDB exists but is not trusted: CIs are loaded from spreadsheets or several tools without identification rules, services and applications are not modelled to CSDM, ownership is missing, and nobody governs data quality. Incident, change and risk processes cannot use CI context. The pattern converges on a governed CMDB: agreed CSDM scope, authoritative sources via Discovery or Service Graph Connectors through the IRE, reconciliation precedence, CMDB Health thresholds with CMDB Data Manager policies, and a service model that ITSM uses.</summary><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:47</sys_created_on><sys_id>031fd78c2b3742d38dc20450125b3992</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:47</sys_updated_on><triggers>[{"re": "\\bCMDB\\b", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "\\bCSDM\\b", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "discovery|service graph|\\bSGC\\b", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "service mapping|application service", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "configuration item|\\bCIs?\\b", "flags": ""}, {"re": "duplicate|stale|data quality|health", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "business (service|application)", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "impact|dependency", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "asset data|data quality", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "services? (map|model)", "flags": "i"}]</triggers><verification_notes/><verified>false</verified><verified_on/><verified_release/></x_1577958_dsb_pattern></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: x_1577958_dsb_pattern_034d05e2e2bc499f95be7ad7aa17f020
sys_update_xml.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><exclude_terms>[]</exclude_terms><indicative_cases>80</indicative_cases><key>integration-hub</key><library_version>1.5</library_version><licence_products>integrationhub</licence_products><min_hits>2</min_hits><name>Enterprise integrations (IntegrationHub, SAP, Workday, Salesforce)</name><overview>Register, standardise, secure, monitor. (1) Build the integration register from evidence int.inventory and interviews: owner, direction, system of record, objects, volume, SLA, method. (2) Standard: spoke first; custom IntegrationHub action with connection alias second; scripted REST only with justification. (3) Credentials in credential/connection aliases (or external vault); OAuth for inbound; IP access control. (4) Standard error handling subflow: retry with back-off, dead-letter record, incident to owner. (5) Refactor high-risk scripts (int.risk) in priority order. (6) Monitoring dashboard and alerts; IntegrationHub transaction consumption reviewed monthly. (7) Contract tests in ATF for critical integrations using mock responses where possible.</overview><pain>Point-to-point scripts with hard-coded endpoints and credentials Failures discovered by users days later No inventory or owner for integrations Upgrades break custom SOAP/REST scripts Duplicate data because system-of-record boundaries are unclear</pain><phase>3</phase><requires/><strong_terms>[{"re": "integrat|point.to.point|IntegrationHub", "flags": "i"}]</strong_terms><summary>Integrations have grown point-to-point: scripted REST calls with hard-coded endpoints and credentials, silent failures, no retry, and no owner. Upgrades break them and nobody knows which are still used. The pattern converges on a governed integration layer: an integration inventory with owners, IntegrationHub spokes and Flow Designer actions in preference to scripts, connection and credential aliases, standard error handling and retry, monitoring and alerting, and a contract per integration (direction, system of record, volume, SLA).</summary><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:47</sys_created_on><sys_id>034d05e2e2bc499f95be7ad7aa17f020</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:47</sys_updated_on><triggers>[{"re": "integrat", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "IntegrationHub|spoke|Flow Designer action", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "\\bAPI\\b|\\bREST\\b|\\bSOAP\\b|webhook|MuleSoft|middleware|Boomi|Azure (Logic|Integration)", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "\\bSAP\\b|Workday|Salesforce|Jira|Teams|Slack|ServiceNow to ServiceNow|eBonding", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "sync|interface|data flow|point.to.point", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "MID server|credential|OAuth", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "connect(ed|ion)? (to|with)", "flags": "i"}]</triggers><verification_notes/><verified>false</verified><verified_on/><verified_release/></x_1577958_dsb_pattern></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: x_1577958_dsb_pattern_0516e578c5dd4dfda26e406e0d0f601d
sys_update_xml.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><exclude_terms>[]</exclude_terms><indicative_cases>67</indicative_cases><key>ai-service-delivery</key><library_version>1.5</library_version><licence_products>now_assist</licence_products><min_hits>2</min_hits><name>Now Assist, Virtual Agent and AI-assisted service delivery</name><overview>Readiness, then a few skills done well, then scale. (1) Baseline: contact drivers, handle time, knowledge health and ticket text quality (evidence ai.*). (2) Confirm entitlement in writing (Pro Plus / Enterprise Plus and Now Assist assist packs) — installed is not licensed. (3) Governance: an AI use-case register, guardrails (sensitive data masking, human review, role scoping), and a named owner per skill; use AI Control Tower where available. (4) Enable OOB Now Assist skills for the agent persona first — summarisation, resolution notes, knowledge generation — because humans review every output. (5) Fix knowledge before exposing AI Search Q&A and Virtual Agent to users; build VA topics for the top drivers using OOB topic blocks and flows. (6) Consider Predictive Intelligence routing only where ai.pi and ai.ticketdata show enough clean history. (7) Measure acceptance, deflection and assist consumption monthly; add AI agents only after the first wave is proven. No custom LLM integrations while an OOB skill fits.</overview><pain>Leadership expects AI value but no use case is sized or measured Knowledge base is small, duplicated or out of date, so AI answers are weak Ticket descriptions and resolution notes are poor quality — models learn little Licensing (Pro Plus / Now Assist packs, assist consumption) is unclear Risk, privacy and security teams have not agreed AI guardrails</pain><phase>1</phase><requires/><strong_terms>[{"re": "now assist", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "virtual agent|chatbot", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "\\bAI\\b|gen ?AI|generative", "flags": "i"}]</strong_terms><summary>The client has a working ServiceNow investment and wants practical AI value: fewer contacts, faster agent handling and better routing. Typical blockers are thin or stale knowledge, poor ticket data (empty descriptions, missing categories), unclear licensing and no AI governance. The pattern converges on a data-readiness baseline, a small set of OOB Now Assist skills (case/incident summarisation, resolution notes, knowledge generation, AI Search Q&A) and Virtual Agent topics for the top contact drivers, with guardrails, human review and measured outcomes before scaling to AI agents.</summary><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:47</sys_created_on><sys_id>0516e578c5dd4dfda26e406e0d0f601d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:47</sys_updated_on><triggers>[{"re": "now assist", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "virtual agent|chatbot|conversational", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "\\bAI\\b|gen ?AI|generative|\\bLLM\\b|agentic|AI agent", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "predictive intelligence|auto.?(route|categor)", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "deflect|self.?service", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "summari[sz]", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "knowledge", "flags": "i"}]</triggers><verification_notes/><verified>false</verified><verified_on/><verified_release/></x_1577958_dsb_pattern></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: x_1577958_dsb_pattern_0e998cd6afca4efe958b07af4c028893
sys_update_xml.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><exclude_terms>[]</exclude_terms><indicative_cases>42</indicative_cases><key>healthcare-clinical</key><library_version>1.5</library_version><licence_products>hls,itam_ham</licence_products><min_hits>2</min_hits><name>Healthcare clinical device and service operations</name><overview>Device register first, then maintenance, recall and security. (1) Model medical devices as hardware assets (and CIs where connected) with model categories, clinical risk class and department/ward location — use Clinical Device Management where licensed. (2) Load the biomed register with serials and maintenance history. (3) Maintenance and calibration plans generating work orders (FSM or CDM work management). (4) Recall management: recall records matched on model and serial range; remediation tasks. (5) Connected devices discovered (or imported from medical device security tools) into the CMDB and included in Vulnerability Response with clinical risk in scoring. (6) Clinician channel: simple portal/QR-code request and phone intake. (7) Compliance and availability dashboards. Patient data is out of scope; no clinical records are stored.</overview><pain>Device inventory and maintenance history in biomed spreadsheets Recall notices matched to devices manually Connected medical devices missing from vulnerability management Clinicians wait on phone queues for equipment issues Equipment program allocations tracked outside the system</pain><phase>3</phase><requires>itam-ham-sam</requires><strong_terms>[{"re": "hospital|clinical|medical device|biomed", "flags": "i"}]</strong_terms><summary>Health organisations manage clinical devices, equipment programs and clinical support services across biomedical engineering spreadsheets, ITSM and supplier portals. Device recalls, preventive maintenance and security vulnerabilities on connected medical devices are hard to track, and clinicians cannot easily request help. The pattern converges on OOB Healthcare and Life Sciences capabilities where licensed (Clinical Device Management) or HAM + FSM + ITSM otherwise: a medical device asset model, maintenance and calibration plans, recall management, connected-device security (with VR), and a clinician-friendly request channel.</summary><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:47</sys_created_on><sys_id>0e998cd6afca4efe958b07af4c028893</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:47</sys_updated_on><triggers>[{"re": "health(care)?|hospital|clinical|patient|ward|aged care|medical", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "medical device|biomedical|biomed|clinical (device|engineering|equipment)", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "recall|\\bTGA\\b|\\bFDA\\b|alert", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "preventive maintenance|calibration|inspection", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "equipment (loan|program|allocation)|consumer|client equipment", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "\\bEMR\\b|\\bEHR\\b|Epic|Cerner|HL7|\\bFHIR\\b", "flags": "i"}]</triggers><verification_notes/><verified>false</verified><verified_on/><verified_release/></x_1577958_dsb_pattern></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: x_1577958_dsb_pattern_1a261fc057734397b446de21b49dcf22
sys_update_xml.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><exclude_terms>[]</exclude_terms><indicative_cases>79</indicative_cases><key>hrsd-foundation</key><library_version>1.5</library_version><licence_products>hrsd</licence_products><min_hits>2</min_hits><name>HR Service Delivery foundation and employee lifecycle</name><overview>Secure foundation, then services, then lifecycle. (1) Design contextual security first: HR roles by tier and COE, sensitive services restricted, no platform admin access to case data without an HR role; separation of duties documented. (2) Integrate the HR system of record (Workday, SuccessFactors or Oracle via the OOB spokes / Service Graph Connector) to populate users and HR profiles; employee number is the key. (3) Build the HR service catalogue from the OOB COE → topic category → topic detail → HR service model; configure, don't clone, case tables. (4) Route with matching rules and assignment by HR service and HR criteria (country, entity), with tiered transfer and SLAs. (5) Employee Center as the single front door: taxonomy, HR knowledge targeted with HR criteria, and to-dos. (6) Lifecycle Events for onboarding and offboarding, with IT/facilities fulfilment delegated to ITSM catalogue items, not re-created in HR. (7) Document templates and e-signature only where needed. (8) Report on volume, SLA, deflection and CSAT.</overview><pain>Employees email or phone HR because there is no single front door HR advisors triage from shared inboxes with no SLA or visibility Onboarding tasks across HR, IT, facilities and managers are chased manually; day-one readiness is inconsistent Sensitive employee matters are stored in email and spreadsheets HR data re-keyed between the HR system of record and service tools</pain><phase>1</phase><requires/><strong_terms>[{"re": "\\bHR\\b", "flags": ""}, {"re": "\\bHRSD\\b|HR service|human resources", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "onboard", "flags": "i"}]</strong_terms><summary>HR enquiries and employee lifecycle work run through email, shared inboxes and spreadsheets. Employees do not know where to go, HR advisors re-key data between the HR system of record and other tools, onboarding tasks for IT, facilities and managers are chased manually, and sensitive case data sits in insecure places. The pattern converges on OOB HR Service Delivery: an HR service catalogue with case and knowledge management, Employee Center as the single front door, Lifecycle Events for onboarding and offboarding, and HR profile data fed from the HR system of record — with contextual security designed first.</summary><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:47</sys_created_on><sys_id>1a261fc057734397b446de21b49dcf22</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:47</sys_updated_on><triggers>[{"re": "\\bHR\\b|human resources", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "\\bHRSD\\b|HR service", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "employee (center|centre|experience|portal)", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "onboard|offboard|lifecycle|transfer|parental leave", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "payroll|benefits|leave", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "people (operations|team)", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "sensitive|confidential", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "\\bportal\\b", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "employee", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "\\brequests?\\b", "flags": "i"}, {"re": "new (starter|hire)s?", "flags": "i"}]</triggers><verification_notes/><verified>false</verified><verified_on/><verified_release/></x_1577958_dsb_pattern></record_update>
