<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE int.risk — READ ONLY. Counts only; review matches in the list view.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var T = ['sys_script_include','sys_script','sysauto_script'];
var P = {http_url: 'scriptLIKEhttp://^ORscriptLIKEhttps://', set_basic_auth: 'scriptLIKEsetBasicAuth', password_literal: 'scriptLIKEpassword', soap_message_v1: 'scriptLIKESOAPMessage(', rest_message_v1: 'scriptLIKERESTMessage(', xmlhttp: 'scriptLIKEXMLHttpRequest'};
var out = {key:'int.risk', results: {}};
T.forEach(function(t){ out.results[t] = {}; Object.keys(P).forEach(function(k){ out.results[t][k] = count(t, 'active=true^' + P[k]); }); });
// Scripted REST resources keep their code in operation_script, not script.
out.results.sys_ws_operation = {}; Object.keys(P).forEach(function(k){ out.results.sys_ws_operation[k] = count('sys_ws_operation', 'active=true^' + P[k].split('script').join('operation_script')); });
dsbPrint('int.risk', out);</body><data>{"key": "int.risk", "why": "Security and upgrade risk", "unblocks": "Refactor backlog"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Enterprise integrations (IntegrationHub, SAP, Workday, Salesforce)">034d05e2e2bc499f95be7ad7aa17f020</pattern><seq>2</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:49</sys_created_on><sys_id>0834c57d28084a9fb98128555cccb7d3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:49</sys_updated_on><title>Hard-coded endpoints/credentials and legacy patterns in scripts</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE upg.release — READ ONLY. Field names on sys_upgrade_history vary; each is checked.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var out = {key:'upg.release', build: gs.getProperty('glide.buildname', '(not set)'), war: gs.getProperty('glide.war', '(not set)'), upgrades: []};
var h = new GlideRecord('sys_upgrade_history'); h.orderByDesc('sys_created_on'); h.setLimit(5); h.query();
while (h.next()) {
  var u = {sys_id: h.getUniqueValue(), created: h.getValue('sys_created_on')};
  ['from_version','to_version','started','upgrade_started','finished','state'].forEach(function(f){ if (h.isValidField(f)) u[f] = h.getDisplayValue(f); });
  u.log_by_disposition = groupCount('sys_upgrade_history_log', 'disposition', 'upgrade_history=' + h.getUniqueValue());
  u.log_by_resolution = hasField('sys_upgrade_history_log','resolution_status') ? groupCount('sys_upgrade_history_log', 'resolution_status', 'upgrade_history=' + h.getUniqueValue()) : 'n/a';
  out.upgrades.push(u);
}
dsbPrint('upg.release', out);</body><data>{"key": "upg.release", "why": "Baseline of release currency and unresolved upgrade debt", "unblocks": "Upgrade plan and triage scope"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Platform upgrade, customisation and technical-debt remediation">93dbb3f9c9374c8b88cbf9fbbc6dee11</pattern><seq>0</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:49</sys_created_on><sys_id>0d67afc48f674b68b8ef212af928e634</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:49</sys_updated_on><title>Release, upgrade history and skipped-record dispositions from recent upgrades</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE itam.hardware — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var t = 'alm_hardware', base = 'install_status!=7';
var out = {key:'itam.hardware', total: count(t), active: count(t, base), by_state: groupCount(t, 'install_status'), by_substate: groupCount(t, 'substatus'),
  by_model_category: groupCount(t, 'model_category', base, 30), stockrooms: count('alm_stockroom'), by_stockroom_in_stock: groupCount(t, 'stockroom', 'install_status=6', 30)};
['serial_number','asset_tag','model','assigned_to','location','cost_center','cost','warranty_expiration','ci','po_number','owned_by'].forEach(function(f){ if (hasField(t, f)) out['pct_' + f] = pct(t, f + 'ISNOTEMPTY', base); });
out.in_use_no_assigned_to = count(t, 'install_status=1^assigned_toISEMPTY');
out.warranty_expired_in_use = hasField(t,'warranty_expiration') ? count(t, 'install_status=1^warranty_expiration<javascript:gs.daysAgoStart(0)') : 'n/a';
out.all_assets_by_class = groupCount('alm_asset', 'sys_class_name', base);
dsbPrint('itam.hardware', out);</body><data>{"key": "itam.hardware", "why": "Baseline for lifecycle and data-quality remediation", "unblocks": "Lifecycle and stockroom design"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Hardware and software asset management (HAM / SAM)">f0c40ed7d7ac4c1a957aafe864f1f114</pattern><seq>1</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>10e063d5d17445c18be6c2d71046de0f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:50</sys_updated_on><title>Hardware assets by class, state, substate, stockroom; key-field completeness</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE tel.inventory — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE tel.inventory ===\n' + JSON.stringify({key:'tel.inventory',
  network_classes: groupCount('cmdb_ci', 'sys_class_name', 'sys_class_nameLIKEnetwork^ORsys_class_nameLIKEnetgear^ORsys_class_nameLIKEtelco^ORsys_class_nameLIKEip_', 40),
  service_instances: groupCount('cmdb_ci', 'sys_class_name', 'sys_class_nameLIKEservice_instance^ORsys_class_nameLIKEcustomer_service', 20),
  sites: count('cmn_location'), accounts: count('customer_account'),
  relationships_on_network_cis: count('cmdb_rel_ci', 'parent.sys_class_nameLIKEnetgear^ORchild.sys_class_nameLIKEnetgear'),
  sold_products: count('sn_install_base_sold_product'), install_base: count('sn_install_base_item')}, null, 2));</body><data>{"key": "tel.inventory", "why": "Service impact depends on inventory and relationships", "unblocks": "Inventory model"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Telecommunications service and order management">e96633990a4b4bd0a7aa9de3d4f7fa00</pattern><seq>1</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>12cf67d4caf6406e81c93e031a77f477</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:50</sys_updated_on><title>Network and service inventory in the CMDB: network classes, sites, service instances and relationships</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>1. <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE hc.apps — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
function appInventory(scopes, names, tablePrefixes){
  var o = {release: gs.getProperty('glide.buildname', '(not set)'), store_apps: [], tables: {}};
  var q = []; scopes.forEach(function(s){ q.push('scopeSTARTSWITH' + s); }); names.forEach(function(n){ q.push('nameLIKE' + n); });
  if (q.length) { var sa = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); sa.addEncodedQuery(q.join('^OR')); sa.query(); while (sa.next()) o.store_apps.push(sa.getValue('name') + ' ' + sa.getValue('version') + (sa.getValue('active') == '1' || sa.getValue('active') == 'true' ? '' : ' (inactive)')); }
  var tq = []; tablePrefixes.forEach(function(p){ tq.push('nameSTARTSWITH' + p); });
  if (tq.length) { var t = new GlideRecord('sys_db_object'); t.addEncodedQuery(tq.join('^OR')); t.orderBy('name'); t.setLimit(150); t.query();
    while (t.next()) { var n = t.getValue('name'); var c = count(n); if (c !== 0) o.tables[n] = c; } }
  return o;
}
var out = appInventory(['sn_hcls','sn_cdm','sn_hls','sn_clin','sn_med'], ['Healthcare','Clinical','Medical Device','Life Sciences'], ['sn_hcls_','sn_cdm_','sn_hls_','sn_clin_']);
out.key = 'hc.apps';
dsbPrint('hc.apps', out);</body><data>{"key": "hc.apps", "why": "Confirms HLS/Clinical Device Management presence", "unblocks": "Licensing check, app vs HAM/FSM approach"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Healthcare clinical device and service operations">0e998cd6afca4efe958b07af4c028893</pattern><seq>0</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:51</sys_created_on><sys_id>1981f10bff4a4c3a9c43722f20adab8c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:51</sys_updated_on><title>Healthcare / clinical device applications and tables with data</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

});

function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var out = {key:'ai.ticketdata', sampled: 0, empty_description: 0, short_description_only: 0, close_notes_under_20_chars: 0, avg_description_len: 0, avg_work_notes_entries: 0};
var totalLen = 0, totalWn = 0;
var wn = groupSet('sys_journal_field', 'element_id', 'name=incident^element=work_notes^sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@120');
var g = new GlideRecord('incident'); g.addEncodedQuery('stateIN6,7^' + LAST90); g.orderByDesc('sys_created_on'); g.setLimit(500); g.query();
while (g.next()) {
  out.sampled++;
  var d = g.getValue('description') || ''; totalLen += d.length;
  if (!d) out.empty_description++;
  if (d && d === g.getValue('short_description')) out.short_description_only++;
  if ((g.getValue('close_notes') || '').length < 20) out.close_notes_under_20_chars++;
  totalWn += wn[g.getUniqueValue()] || 0;
}
if (out.sampled) { out.avg_description_len = Math.round(totalLen / out.sampled); out.avg_work_notes_entries = Math.round(10 * totalWn / out.sampled) / 10; }
out.pct_with_category = pct('incident', 'categoryISNOTEMPTY', LAST90);
out.distinct_categories_90d = Object.keys(groupCount('incident', 'category', LAST90, 500)).length;
dsbPrint('ai.ticketdata', out);</body><data>{"key": "ai.ticketdata", "why": "Summarisation, resolution notes and Predictive Intelligence depend on ticket text", "unblocks": "Data-readiness verdict per use case"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Now Assist, Virtual Agent and AI-assisted service delivery">0516e578c5dd4dfda26e406e0d0f601d</pattern><seq>2</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:52</sys_created_on><sys_id>1c71377b4d9944bfbc39fb87af1de594</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:52</sys_updated_on><title>Ticket text quality: description and close-note completeness and length (sampled)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }

var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var Y = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@month@ago@12';
gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE hc.demand ===\n' + JSON.stringify({key:'hc.demand',
  biomed_groups: groupCount('sys_user_group', 'name', 'active=true^nameLIKEbiomed^ORnameLIKEclinical^ORnameLIKEmedical'),
  incidents_to_biomed_12m: count('incident', Y + '^assignment_group.nameLIKEbiomed^ORassignment_group.nameLIKEclinical'),
  ritms_medical_12m: count('sc_req_item', Y + '^cat_item.nameLIKEmedical^ORcat_item.nameLIKEequipment'),

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB IMPLEMENTATION hr-profile-create — DATA CHANGING. DRY RUN unless DRY_RUN = false. Prints counts and record sys_ids only.
var DRY_RUN = true;
var LIMIT = 500;
var stats = {would_create: 0, created: 0, created_profile_ids: []};
var have = {}; var pa = new GlideAggregate('sn_hr_core_profile'); pa.addAggregate('COUNT'); pa.groupBy('user'); pa.query(); while (pa.next()) have[pa.getValue('user')] = true;
var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user'); u.addActiveQuery(); u.addNotNullQuery('employee_number'); u.query();
while (u.next() && stats.would_create < LIMIT) {
  if (have[u.getUniqueValue()]) continue;
  stats.would_create++;
  if (!DRY_RUN) { var n = new GlideRecord('sn_hr_core_profile'); n.initialize(); n.setValue('user', u.getUniqueValue()); var id = n.insert(); if (id) { stats.created++; stats.created_profile_ids.push(id); } }
}
gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL hr-profile-create ' + (DRY_RUN ? '[DRY RUN]' : '') + ' ===\n' + JSON.stringify(stats, null, 2));</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Fallback only when the HR integration cannot create profiles for existing users at go-live. Creates sn_hr_core_profile records linked to the user.", "prereqs": "Prefer the OOB HR profile creation from the HR integration. Sub-prod first; HR data owner approval.", "rollback": "Output lists created profile sys_ids (no personal identifiers); delete those records only if created in error (sub-prod)."}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>true</modifies_data><pattern display_value="HR Service Delivery foundation and employee lifecycle">1a261fc057734397b446de21b49dcf22</pattern><seq>2</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:53</sys_created_on><sys_id>1e71d602160545e8a9677bc0bf360021</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:53</sys_updated_on><title>Create HR profiles for active employees (DRY RUN by default)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }

var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var out = {key:'em.apps', release: gs.getProperty('glide.buildname', '(not set)'), plugins:[], store_apps:[], mid_servers:[]};
var pl = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins'); pl.addEncodedQuery('active=true^idLIKEem^ORidLIKEevent_management^ORidLIKEsa_^ORidLIKEitom'); pl.query();
while (pl.next()) out.plugins.push(pl.getValue('id'));
var sa = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); sa.addEncodedQuery('nameLIKEEvent Management^ORnameLIKEAIOps^ORnameLIKEHealth Log^ORnameLIKEOperator Workspace^ORnameLIKEMetric Intelligence^ORnameLIKEConnector'); sa.query();
while (sa.next()) out.store_apps.push(sa.getValue('name') + ' ' + sa.getValue('version'));
var m = new GlideRecord('ecc_agent'); m.query();
while (m.next()) out.mid_servers.push({name: m.getValue('name'), status: m.getValue('status'), validated: m.getValue('validated')});
out.em_tables = []; var t = new GlideRecord('sys_db_object'); t.addEncodedQuery('nameSTARTSWITHem_'); t.setLimit(80); t.query(); while (t.next()) out.em_tables.push(t.getValue('name'));
dsbPrint('em.apps', out);</body><data>{"key": "em.apps", "why": "Confirms technical availability (ITOM Health / AIOps entitlements are separate)", "unblocks": "Licensing check, connector choice"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="ITOM Health: event management, AIOps and observability">27017c1f692149c79a16726ca19e8c2b</pattern><seq>0</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:53</sys_created_on><sys_id>243d721bfebb45548c9659b5c7dd704c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:53</sys_updated_on><title>Event Management / AIOps / Health Log Analytics apps, plugins and MID servers</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

// Set FIELD on records in TABLE matched by KEY_FIELD, using MAP {keyValue: newValue}. Reference values are resolved by display value in REF_TABLE (optional).
function backfill(TABLE, KEY_FIELD, FIELD, MAP, REF_TABLE, EXTRA_QUERY){

    var v = MAP[k];

    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); MATCH_FIELDS.forEach(function(f){ gr.addQuery(f, row[f]); }); gr.setLimit(1); gr.query();
    STATS.checked++; if (gr.hasNext()) return; STATS.would_change++;
    if (!DRY_RUN) { var n = new GlideRecord(TABLE); n.initialize(); Object.keys(row).forEach(function(f){ n.setValue(f, row[f]); }); var id = n.insert(); if (id) { STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(id); } }
  });
}
function report(name){ gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL ' + name + (DRY_RUN ? ' [DRY RUN]' : '') + ' ===\n' + JSON.stringify(STATS, null, 2)); }
var MAP = { /* 'Supplier Pty Ltd': 'true' */ };   // company name : true
backfill('core_company', 'name', 'vendor', MAP);
report('s2p-vendor-flag');</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Sets vendor = true on companies listed in the approved supplier list.", "prereqs": "Sub-production first. Fill the map/list from the client-approved source. Review the dry-run counts before switching DRY_RUN off.", "rollback": "The output lists changed_ids; reverse from an XML export taken beforehand or by re-running with the previous values."}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>true</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Source-to-pay and procurement operations">8d626f620b62477fb3d9517346e13cf8</pattern><seq>2</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:53</sys_created_on><sys_id>25e815fe1aa34830932512314333d8c7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:53</sys_updated_on><title>Flag supplier companies as vendors (DRY RUN by default)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE itam.assetci — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var out = {key:'itam.assetci'};
out.hw_assets_without_ci = count('alm_hardware', 'install_status!=7^ciISEMPTY');
out.computers_without_asset = count('cmdb_ci_computer', 'install_status!=7^assetISEMPTY');
var d = new GlideAggregate('alm_hardware'); d.addNotNullQuery('ci'); d.addAggregate('COUNT'); d.groupBy('ci'); d.addHaving('COUNT', '>', 1); d.query();
out.cis_with_multiple_assets = 0; while (d.next()) out.cis_with_multiple_assets++;
out.retired_asset_active_ci = count('alm_hardware', 'install_status=7^ci.install_status!=7');
out.serial_duplicates = 0; var s = new GlideAggregate('alm_hardware'); s.addNotNullQuery('serial_number'); s.addEncodedQuery('install_status!=7'); s.addAggregate('COUNT'); s.groupBy('serial_number'); s.addHaving('COUNT', '>', 1); s.query(); while (s.next()) out.serial_duplicates++;
out.models_total = count('cmdb_hardware_product_model');
out.model_categories_without_asset_class = count('cmdb_model_category', 'asset_classISEMPTY^cmdb_ci_classISNOTEMPTY');
out.manufacturers = count('core_company', 'manufacturer=true');
out.hw_models_by_status = hasField('cmdb_hardware_product_model','status') ? groupCount('cmdb_hardware_product_model', 'status') : 'n/a';
dsbPrint('itam.assetci', out);</body><data>{"key": "itam.assetci", "why": "Asset–CI drift is the most common HAM defect", "unblocks": "Synchronisation and normalisation design"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Hardware and software asset management (HAM / SAM)">f0c40ed7d7ac4c1a957aafe864f1f114</pattern><seq>2</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:54</sys_created_on><sys_id>2866faaa4a764205819ca39855121a7d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:54</sys_updated_on><title>Asset–CI linkage: one-to-one integrity, status mismatch, model normalisation</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item_325958bddf124d07a79ffd7a8bbb2b1c
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB PVT verify sir — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }

function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }

out.admins = count('sys_user_has_role', 'role.name=admin^user.active=true');

var h = new GlideRecord('sys_upgrade_history'); h.orderByDesc('sys_created_on'); h.setLimit(1); h.query();
if (!h.next()) { gs.print('no upgrade history'); }
else {
  var SK = []; var ch = new GlideRecord('sys_choice'); ch.addQuery('name', 'sys_upgrade_history_log'); ch.addQuery('element', 'disposition'); ch.addQuery('label', 'CONTAINS', 'kip'); ch.query(); while (ch.next()) if (SK.indexOf(ch.getValue('value')) < 0) SK.push(ch.getValue('value'));
  var l = new GlideRecord('sys_upgrade_history_log'); l.addQuery('upgrade_history', h.getUniqueValue()); l.addQuery('disposition', 'IN', SK.join(','));
  l.orderBy('file_name'); l.setLimit(10000); l.query();
  gs.print('file_name|type|disposition|resolution_status|sys_id');
  while (l.next()) gs.print([l.getValue('file_name'), l.isValidField('type') ? l.getDisplayValue('type') : '', l.getDisplayValue('disposition'), l.isValidField('resolution_status') ? l.getDisplayValue('resolution_status') : '', l.getUniqueValue()].join('|'));
}</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Prints skipped records from the latest upgrade as CSV-style lines to seed the triage register.", "prereqs": null, "rollback": null}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Platform upgrade, customisation and technical-debt remediation">93dbb3f9c9374c8b88cbf9fbbc6dee11</pattern><seq>1</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:55</sys_created_on><sys_id>399bbe5e450f477abf990588de277b05</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:55</sys_updated_on><title>Skipped-record triage export (READ ONLY)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

  var runs = []; var gr = new GlideRecord('sn_vul_integration_run'); gr.addEncodedQuery('sys_created_onONLast 30 days@javascript:gs.beginningOfLast30Days()@javascript:gs.endOfLast30Days()'); gr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on'); gr.setLimit(30); gr.query();
  while (gr.next()) runs.push({number: gr.getValue('number'), integration: gr.getDisplayValue('integration'), state: gr.getDisplayValue('state'), started: gr.getValue('sys_created_on')});
  out.integration_runs_last30 = runs;
} else out.notes.push('sn_vul_integration_run not found — confirm VR release');
if (gs.tableExists('sn_vul_vulnerable_item')) {
  out.vit_total = count('sn_vul_vulnerable_item');
  out.vit_open = count('sn_vul_vulnerable_item', 'state!=3'); // Closed = 3 on recent releases — confirm
  out.vit_open_no_ci = count('sn_vul_vulnerable_item', 'state!=3^cmdb_ciISEMPTY');
  out.vit_open_unclassed = count('sn_vul_vulnerable_item', 'state!=3^cmdb_ci.sys_class_name=cmdb_ci_unclassed_hardware');
  out.vit_open_no_group = count('sn_vul_vulnerable_item', 'state!=3^assignment_groupISEMPTY');
  var matched = out.vit_open - out.vit_open_no_ci - out.vit_open_unclassed;
  out.ci_match_pct_open = out.vit_open ? Math.round(100 * matched / out.vit_open) : 0;
  var byClass = new GlideAggregate('sn_vul_vulnerable_item'); byClass.addEncodedQuery('state!=3^cmdb_ciISNOTEMPTY'); byClass.addAggregate('COUNT'); byClass.groupBy('cmdb_ci.sys_class_name'); byClass.query();
  out.vit_open_by_ci_class = {}; while (byClass.next()) out.vit_open_by_ci_class[byClass.getDisplayValue('cmdb_ci.sys_class_name') || '(empty)'] = parseInt(byClass.getAggregate('COUNT'),10);
} else out.notes.push('sn_vul_vulnerable_item not found — is Vulnerability Response installed?');
dsbPrint('vr.ingest', out);</body><data>{"key": "vr.ingest", "why": "Establishes the baseline match rate and whether the pipeline itself is healthy", "unblocks": "Problem sizing, target setting"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Tenable vulnerability ingestion without a CMDB foundation">9ad6efafe3d645c1bce9ff6b75af7152</pattern><seq>0</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:55</sys_created_on><sys_id>3b20c889690b4e2facae51bfa968a3d2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:55</sys_updated_on><title>VR ingestion health: integration runs, VIT totals, CI match rate</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }

var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var out = {key:'csm.apps', release: gs.getProperty('glide.buildname', '(not set)'), plugins:[], store_apps:[], portals:[]};
var pl = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins'); pl.addEncodedQuery('active=true^idLIKEcsm^ORidLIKEcustomerservice^ORidLIKEawa^ORidLIKEinteraction'); pl.query();
while (pl.next()) out.plugins.push(pl.getValue('id'));
var sa = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); sa.addEncodedQuery('scopeSTARTSWITHsn_customerservice^ORscopeSTARTSWITHsn_csm^ORnameLIKECustomer Service^ORnameLIKEOpenFrame^ORnameLIKESalesforce'); sa.query();
while (sa.next()) out.store_apps.push(sa.getValue('name') + ' ' + sa.getValue('version'));
var p = new GlideRecord('sp_portal'); p.query(); while (p.next()) out.portals.push(p.getValue('url_suffix'));
out.accounts = count('customer_account'); out.contacts = count('customer_contact'); out.consumers = count('csm_consumer');
out.model_hint = (out.consumers > 0 && out.accounts === 0) ? 'B2C' : (out.accounts > 0 ? 'B2B (check consumers too)' : 'not populated');
dsbPrint('csm.apps', out);</body><data>{"key": "csm.apps", "why": "Confirms what is technically present and which data model the instance uses", "unblocks": "Licensing check, data model decision"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Customer Service Management case and contact-centre foundation">4874dc995cad4b3cb3bda8c29e4e0be8</pattern><seq>0</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>3c4c3a5f808e492fa41cf0bfcefd201b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:56</sys_updated_on><title>CSM applications, plugins and portals installed; B2B vs B2C model in use</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

var used = {}; var ga = new GlideAggregate('sc_req_item'); ga.addEncodedQuery(LAST90); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy('cat_item'); ga.query();

var ci = new GlideRecord('sc_cat_item'); ci.addQuery('active', true); ci.addQuery('sys_class_name', 'sc_cat_item'); ci.query();
while (ci.next()) { var n = used[ci.getUniqueValue()] || 0; if (!n) unused++; else top.push({name: ci.getValue('name'), ritms_90d: n}); }
top.sort(function(a, b){ return b.ritms_90d - a.ritms_90d; });
out.standard_items_unused_last_90d = unused; out.top_items_90d = top.slice(0, 20);

// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }

gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE hc.devices ===\n' + JSON.stringify({key:'hc.devices',
  device_assets: count('alm_hardware', base),

function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }

function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }

  citations: count('sn_compliance_citation'),
  controls: count('sn_compliance_control'), controls_no_owner: count('sn_compliance_control', 'ownerISEMPTY'),
  risks: count('sn_risk_risk'), risks_no_owner: count('sn_risk_risk', 'ownerISEMPTY'),
  controls_by_status: groupCount('sn_compliance_control', 'status'),
  open_issues: count('sn_grc_issue', 'active=true'),
  indicator_results_30d: count('sn_grc_indicator_result', 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@30'),
  ran: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue()}, null, 2));</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "PVT evidence: content loaded, ownership complete, attestations and issues flowing.", "prereqs": null, "rollback": null}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="IRM / GRC policy, risk and compliance foundation">4b16aa07c3c5429a93a6f33c5ef138c0</pattern><seq>2</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>40f6d5926ed94300ab45e529eb4ccb2d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:56</sys_updated_on><title>Post-implementation verification — IRM operating snapshot (READ ONLY)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE hr.security — READ ONLY. Counts only — no names are printed.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var out = {key:'hr.security', roles:{}};
var r = new GlideRecord('sys_user_role'); r.addEncodedQuery('nameSTARTSWITHsn_hr'); r.query();
while (r.next()) { out.roles[r.getValue('name')] = count('sys_user_has_role', 'role=' + r.getUniqueValue() + '^user.active=true'); }
out.active_users_with_hr_admin = count('sys_user_has_role', 'role.name=sn_hr_core.admin^user.active=true');
out.platform_admins_also_hr_admin = count('sys_user_has_role', 'role.name=sn_hr_core.admin^user.active=true^user.roles=admin');
out.acls_on_hr_case = groupCount('sys_security_acl', 'operation', 'nameSTARTSWITHsn_hr_core_case^active=true');
out.users_with_admin_role = count('sys_user_has_role', 'role.name=admin^user.active=true');
dsbPrint('hr.security', out);</body><data>{"key": "hr.security", "why": "Contextual security must be designed before any case data is loaded", "unblocks": "Security design sign-off"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="HR Service Delivery foundation and employee lifecycle">1a261fc057734397b446de21b49dcf22</pattern><seq>2</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>409ebb78e63c44419fd6db359662d6df</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:56</sys_updated_on><title>HR roles, role holders and case ACL posture</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB IMPLEMENTATION fsm-seed-skills — DATA CHANGING. DRY RUN unless DRY_RUN = false. Prints counts and record sys_ids only.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB IMPLEMENTATION migration-reconcile — READ ONLY.
var TABLE = 'incident';                   // <confirm>
var REF_FIELD = 'correlation_id';         // <confirm> field holding the legacy ticket number
var SOURCE_TOTALS = { /* 'New': 120, 'In Progress': 340 */ };   // from the source extract
var out = {table: TABLE, by_state:{}, missing_ref: 0, duplicate_refs: 0, variance:{}};
var ga = new GlideAggregate(TABLE); ga.addNotNullQuery(REF_FIELD); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy('state'); ga.query();
while (ga.next()) out.by_state[ga.getDisplayValue('state')] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10);
Object.keys(SOURCE_TOTALS).forEach(function(s){ out.variance[s] = (out.by_state[s] || 0) - SOURCE_TOTALS[s]; });
var d = new GlideAggregate(TABLE); d.addNotNullQuery(REF_FIELD); d.addAggregate('COUNT'); d.groupBy(REF_FIELD); d.addHaving('COUNT', '>', 1); d.query();
while (d.next()) out.duplicate_refs++;
gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL migration-reconcile ===\n' + JSON.stringify(out, null, 2));</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Run after each migration load. Compares counts by state against the source extract totals you paste in, and lists records missing a source reference.", "prereqs": null, "rollback": null}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="ITSM consolidation and legacy service-desk migration">7663f4d384ef408a8ba3062e8c27a96c</pattern><seq>1</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:57</sys_created_on><sys_id>4ad2c18ce1a541ceb68a3623507e206d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:57</sys_updated_on><title>Open-ticket migration reconciliation (READ ONLY)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE esg.foundation — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
