<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB IMPLEMENTATION ps-seed-categories — DATA CHANGING. DRY RUN unless DRY_RUN = false. Prints counts and record sys_ids only.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var DRY_RUN = true;   // set to false only after the dry-run output is approved
var STATS = {checked: 0, would_change: 0, changed: 0, skipped: [], changed_ids: []};
// Set FIELD on records in TABLE matched by KEY_FIELD, using MAP {keyValue: newValue}. Reference values are resolved by display value in REF_TABLE (optional).
function backfill(TABLE, KEY_FIELD, FIELD, MAP, REF_TABLE, EXTRA_QUERY){
  var refCache = {};
  Object.keys(MAP).forEach(function(k){
    var v = MAP[k];
    if (REF_TABLE) { if (refCache[v] === undefined) { var r = new GlideRecord(REF_TABLE); refCache[v] = r.get(r.getDisplayName(), v) ? r.getUniqueValue() : null; } if (!refCache[v]) { STATS.skipped.push('reference not found for key ' + k); return; } v = refCache[v]; }
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); gr.addQuery(KEY_FIELD, k); if (EXTRA_QUERY) gr.addEncodedQuery(EXTRA_QUERY); gr.setLimit(MAX_ROWS); gr.query();
    while (gr.next()) { STATS.checked++; if (gr.getValue(FIELD) == v) continue; STATS.would_change++;
      if (!DRY_RUN) { gr.setValue(FIELD, v); gr.update(); STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(gr.getUniqueValue()); } }
  });
}
// Insert ROWS into TABLE when no record matches all MATCH_FIELDS.
function seed(TABLE, MATCH_FIELDS, ROWS){
  ROWS.forEach(function(row){
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); MATCH_FIELDS.forEach(function(f){ gr.addQuery(f, row[f]); }); gr.setLimit(1); gr.query();
    STATS.checked++; if (gr.hasNext()) return; STATS.would_change++;
    if (!DRY_RUN) { var n = new GlideRecord(TABLE); n.initialize(); Object.keys(row).forEach(function(f){ n.setValue(f, row[f]); }); var id = n.insert(); if (id) { STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(id); } }
  });
}
function report(name){ gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL ' + name + (DRY_RUN ? ' [DRY RUN]' : '') + ' ===\n' + JSON.stringify(STATS, null, 2)); }
var TABLE = 'sn_customerservice_case';   // <confirm> case table used for the service type
seed('sys_choice', ['name','element','value'], [
  {name: TABLE, element: 'category', value: 'permit_application', label: 'Permit application', sequence: 10, language: 'en'},
  {name: TABLE, element: 'category', value: 'licence_renewal', label: 'Licence renewal', sequence: 20, language: 'en'}
]);
report('ps-seed-categories');</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Creates the agreed category choices on the case table if missing.", "prereqs": "Sub-production first. sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>var SKIP_BUSINESS_RULES = false; // DSB: true also suppresses audit history, notifications and engines. Record the reason in the engagement decision log before changing.
// DSB IMPLEMENTATION ownership-backfill — DATA CHANGING. DRY RUN unless DRY_RUN = false.
var DRY_RUN = true;
var TABLE = 'cmdb_ci_computer';            // <confirm> in-scope class
var MAP = {                                 // serial_number : support group name — from the client ownership register
  // 'ABC123': 'Desktop Support',
};
var stats = {checked:0, would_change:0, changed:0, group_missing:[], ci_missing:[]};
var groups = {};
Object.keys(MAP).forEach(function(sn){ var g = MAP[sn]; if (groups[g] !== undefined) return; var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group'); gr.addQuery('name', g); gr.addQuery('active', true); gr.query(); groups[g] = gr.next() ? gr.getUniqueValue() : null; if (!groups[g]) stats.group_missing.push(g); });
Object.keys(MAP).forEach(function(sn){
  var gid = groups[MAP[sn]]; if (!gid) return;
  var ci = new GlideRecord(TABLE); ci.addQuery('serial_number', sn); ci.query();
  if (!ci.next()) { stats.ci_missing.push(sn); return; }
  stats.checked++;
  if (ci.getValue('support_group') == gid) return;
  gs.print((DRY_RUN ? '[DRY RUN] ' : '') + ci.getValue('name') + ' (' + sn + '): support_group ' + (ci.getDisplayValue('support_group') || '(empty)') + ' -> ' + MAP[sn]);
  stats.would_change++;
  if (!DRY_RUN) { ci.setValue('support_group', gid); if (SKIP_BUSINESS_RULES) { ci.setWorkflow(false); } ci.update(); stats.changed++; }
});
gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL ownership-backfill ===\n' + JSON.stringify(stats, null, 2));</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Fallback when an import set is not practical. Sets support_group on in-scope CIs from a serial→group map. Prints what it would change; only writes when DRY_RUN=false.", "prereqs": "Run in sub-prod first. Group names must exist in sys_user_group. Take a CMDB export of the affected class before running in production.", "rollback": "The script prints old and new values per CI — keep the output; reverse by setting the old value, or restore from the export."}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>true</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Tenable vulnerability ingestion without a CMDB foundation">9ad6efafe3d645c1bce9ff6b75af7152</pattern><seq>1</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:58</sys_created_on><sys_id>4f08006d1a9a4ea7bdef37a5df350609</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:58</sys_updated_on><title>Ownership backfill — support group by serial number (DRY RUN by default)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>
sys_update_xml.target_name: Ownership backfill — support group by serial number (DRY RUN by default)

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE fsm.apps — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
function appInventory(scopes, names, tablePrefixes){
  var o = {release: gs.getProperty('glide.buildname', '(not set)'), store_apps: [], tables: {}};
  var q = []; scopes.forEach(function(s){ q.push('scopeSTARTSWITH' + s); }); names.forEach(function(n){ q.push('nameLIKE' + n); });
  if (q.length) { var sa = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); sa.addEncodedQuery(q.join('^OR')); sa.query(); while (sa.next()) o.store_apps.push(sa.getValue('name') + ' ' + sa.getValue('version') + (sa.getValue('active') == '1' || sa.getValue('active') == 'true' ? '' : ' (inactive)')); }
  var tq = []; tablePrefixes.forEach(function(p){ tq.push('nameSTARTSWITH' + p); });
  if (tq.length) { var t = new GlideRecord('sys_db_object'); t.addEncodedQuery(tq.join('^OR')); t.orderBy('name'); t.setLimit(150); t.query();
    while (t.next()) { var n = t.getValue('name'); var c = count(n); if (c !== 0) o.tables[n] = c; } }
  return o;
}
var out = appInventory(['sn_fsm','sn_wm','sn_fsm_'], ['Field Service','Dynamic Scheduling','Work Management','Planned Maintenance'], ['wm_','sn_fsm_','sm_']);
out.key = 'fsm.apps';
var pl = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins'); pl.addEncodedQuery('active=true^idLIKEwm^ORidLIKEfsm^ORidLIKEfield'); pl.query(); out.plugins = []; while (pl.next()) out.plugins.push(pl.getValue('id'));
dsbPrint('fsm.apps', out);</body><data>{"key": "fsm.apps", "why": "Confirms FSM, scheduling and mobile components installed", "unblocks": "Licensing check, scope"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Field Service Management">5c6ec6aa57e140f986af5947553a8c3e</pattern><seq>0</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:58</sys_created_on><sys_id>4f09d73611ce45b4be434d7462dd9818</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:58</sys_updated_on><title>FSM applications, plugins and tables with data</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB IMPLEMENTATION ae-migration-reconcile — READ ONLY.
var TABLE = 'x_prefix_app_record';     // <confirm>
var REF = 'legacy_reference';          // <confirm>
var SOURCE_TOTAL = 0;                  // from the legacy extract
var ga = new GlideAggregate(TABLE); ga.addNotNullQuery(REF); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query();
var loaded = ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0;
var d = new GlideAggregate(TABLE); d.addNotNullQuery(REF); d.addAggregate('COUNT'); d.groupBy(REF); d.addHaving('COUNT', '>', 1); d.query(); var dup = 0; while (d.next()) dup++;
gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL ae-migration-reconcile ===\n' + JSON.stringify({table: TABLE, loaded: loaded, source_total: SOURCE_TOTAL, variance: loaded - SOURCE_TOTAL, duplicate_refs: dup}, null, 2));</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Compares loaded record counts by state with source totals and finds duplicate legacy references.", "prereqs": null, "rollback": null}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Greenfield scoped application (App Engine)">7b4d65824e3147e0ab19ef6bd011d80c</pattern><seq>1</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:58</sys_created_on><sys_id>4feb3d4b01a647ed99ebbacc5f44fdd3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:58</sys_updated_on><title>Legacy migration reconciliation (READ ONLY)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

var DSB_NOTES = [];
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var out = {key:'vr.apps', store_apps:[], plugins:[], properties:{}};
var sa = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); sa.addEncodedQuery('scopeSTARTSWITHsn_vul^ORscopeSTARTSWITHsn_sec^ORscopeSTARTSWITHsn_cmdb^ORnameLIKEtenable^ORnameLIKEcmdb'); sa.query();
while (sa.next()) out.store_apps.push({name: sa.getValue('name'), scope: sa.getValue('scope'), version: sa.getValue('version'), active: sa.getValue('active')});
var pl = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins'); pl.addEncodedQuery('active=true^idLIKEcmdb^ORidLIKEdiscovery^ORidLIKEservice_graph^ORidLIKEvul'); pl.query();
while (pl.next()) out.plugins.push({id: pl.getValue('id'), name: pl.getValue('name'), version: pl.getValue('version')});
['glide.buildname','glide.war','glide.identification_engine.enabled','glide.cmdb.logger.level'].forEach(function(p){ out.properties[p] = gs.getProperty(p, '(not set)'); });
dsbPrint('vr.apps', out);</body><data>{"key": "vr.apps", "why": "Confirms what is technically present (not what is licensed) and the VR/Tenable app versions", "unblocks": "Licensing check, release-specific design"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Tenable vulnerability ingestion without a CMDB foundation">9ad6efafe3d645c1bce9ff6b75af7152</pattern><seq>4</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:58</sys_created_on><sys_id>50d7cf940d9f4f1a8bd9ba74ec56ef11</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:58</sys_updated_on><title>Installed security and CMDB applications, versions and relevant properties</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB IMPLEMENTATION spm-project-portfolio — DATA CHANGING. DRY RUN unless DRY_RUN = false. Prints counts and record sys_ids only.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var DRY_RUN = true;   // set to false only after the dry-run output is approved
var STATS = {checked: 0, would_change: 0, changed: 0, skipped: [], changed_ids: []};
// Set FIELD on records in TABLE matched by KEY_FIELD, using MAP {keyValue: newValue}. Reference values are resolved by display value in REF_TABLE (optional).
function backfill(TABLE, KEY_FIELD, FIELD, MAP, REF_TABLE, EXTRA_QUERY){
  var refCache = {};
  Object.keys(MAP).forEach(function(k){
    var v = MAP[k];
    if (REF_TABLE) { if (refCache[v] === undefined) { var r = new GlideRecord(REF_TABLE); refCache[v] = r.get(r.getDisplayName(), v) ? r.getUniqueValue() : null; } if (!refCache[v]) { STATS.skipped.push('reference not found for key ' + k); return; } v = refCache[v]; }
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); gr.addQuery(KEY_FIELD, k); if (EXTRA_QUERY) gr.addEncodedQuery(EXTRA_QUERY); gr.setLimit(MAX_ROWS); gr.query();
    while (gr.next()) { STATS.checked++; if (gr.getValue(FIELD) == v) continue; STATS.would_change++;
      if (!DRY_RUN) { gr.setValue(FIELD, v); gr.update(); STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(gr.getUniqueValue()); } }
  });
}
// Insert ROWS into TABLE when no record matches all MATCH_FIELDS.
function seed(TABLE, MATCH_FIELDS, ROWS){
  ROWS.forEach(function(row){
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); MATCH_FIELDS.forEach(function(f){ gr.addQuery(f, row[f]); }); gr.setLimit(1); gr.query();
    STATS.checked++; if (gr.hasNext()) return; STATS.would_change++;
    if (!DRY_RUN) { var n = new GlideRecord(TABLE); n.initialize(); Object.keys(row).forEach(function(f){ n.setValue(f, row[f]); }); var id = n.insert(); if (id) { STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(id); } }
  });
}
function report(name){ gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL ' + name + (DRY_RUN ? ' [DRY RUN]' : '') + ' ===\n' + JSON.stringify(STATS, null, 2)); }
var MAP = { /* 'PRJ0001234': 'Digital Workplace' */ };
backfill('pm_project', 'number', 'primary_portfolio', MAP, 'pm_portfolio', 'active=true');   // <confirm> field name
report('spm-project-portfolio');</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Sets the primary portfolio on projects from an approved project number → portfolio map.", "prereqs": "Sub-production first. Fill the map/list from the client-approved source. Review the dry-run counts before switching DRY_RUN off.", "rollback": "The output lists changed_ids; reverse from an XML export taken beforehand or by re-running with the previous values."}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>true</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Strategic Portfolio Management (demand, project, portfolio)">009e981159a14b74a82d20a26b9752a8</pattern><seq>3</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:58</sys_created_on><sys_id>52376df430a344b9b50f00f1e53c5685</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:58</sys_updated_on><title>Assign projects to portfolios (DRY RUN by default)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE itsm.customisation — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var out = {key:'itsm.customisation', notes:['Counts include OOB records; compare with sys_upgrade_history_log skipped items for true customisation.']};
var tables = 'incident,task,sc_req_item,sc_task,problem,change_request,kb_knowledge';
out.business_rules_active = groupCount('sys_script', 'collection', 'active=true^collectionIN' + tables);
out.client_scripts_active = groupCount('sys_script_client', 'table', 'active=true^tableIN' + tables);
out.ui_policies_active = groupCount('sys_ui_policy', 'table', 'active=true^tableIN' + tables);
out.ui_actions_active = groupCount('sys_ui_action', 'table', 'active=true^tableIN' + tables);
out.custom_fields_u_ = groupCount('sys_dictionary', 'name', 'elementSTARTSWITHu_^nameIN' + tables);
out.legacy_workflows_published = count('wf_workflow_version', 'published=true^active=true');
out.flows_active = count('sys_hub_flow', 'active=true');
// last upgrade: skipped (customised) files by disposition — confirm labels on your release
var last = new GlideRecord('sys_upgrade_history'); last.orderByDesc('sys_created_on'); last.setLimit(1); last.query();
if (last.next()) { out.last_upgrade = {}; ['from_version','to_version','started','upgrade_started','finished','state'].forEach(function(f){ if (last.isValidField(f)) out.last_upgrade[f] = last.getDisplayValue(f); });
  out.last_upgrade_log_by_disposition = groupCount('sys_upgrade_history_log', 'disposition', 'upgrade_history=' + last.getUniqueValue()); }
else out.notes.push('No sys_upgrade_history found');
out.release = gs.getProperty('glide.buildname', '(not set)');
dsbPrint('itsm.customisation', out);</body><data>{"key": "itsm.customisation", "why": "Decides between reuse, remediate or return-to-OOB for each area", "unblocks": "Fit-gap and upgrade-risk assessment"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="ITSM consolidation and legacy service-desk migration">7663f4d384ef408a8ba3062e8c27a96c</pattern><seq>4</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:59</sys_created_on><sys_id>53a2e4668ed1436eb5994cae4df1f8cf</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:59</sys_updated_on><title>Customisation footprint on task tables and skipped records from the last upgrade</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB IMPLEMENTATION asset-ci-link — DATA CHANGING. DRY RUN unless DRY_RUN = false.
var DRY_RUN = true;
var CI_TABLE = 'cmdb_ci_computer';   // <confirm>
var stats = {checked: 0, would_link: 0, linked: 0, ambiguous: 0, no_match: 0};
var a = new GlideRecord('alm_hardware'); a.addEncodedQuery('install_status!=7^ciISEMPTY^serial_numberISNOTEMPTY'); a.setLimit(5000); a.query();
while (a.next()) {
  stats.checked++;
  var c = new GlideRecord(CI_TABLE); c.addQuery('serial_number', a.getValue('serial_number')); c.addQuery('install_status', '!=', 7); c.query();
  if (c.getRowCount() === 0) { stats.no_match++; continue; }
  if (c.getRowCount() > 1) { stats.ambiguous++; continue; }
  c.next();
  if (c.getValue('asset')) { stats.ambiguous++; continue; }
  stats.would_link++;
  gs.print((DRY_RUN ? '[DRY RUN] ' : '') + a.getValue('asset_tag') + ' (' + a.getValue('serial_number') + ') -> ' + c.getValue('name') + ' asset=' + a.getUniqueValue() + ' ci=' + c.getUniqueValue());
  if (!DRY_RUN) { a.setValue('ci', c.getUniqueValue()); a.update(); stats.linked++; }
}
gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL asset-ci-link ===\n' + JSON.stringify(stats, null, 2));</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Links unlinked hardware assets to an existing CI with the same serial where exactly one active match exists and the CI has no asset.", "prereqs": "Asset manager approves the dry-run list. Sub-prod first. Take an export of alm_hardware.", "rollback": "Output lists asset and CI sys_ids; clear the ci/asset references to reverse."}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>true</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Hardware and software asset management (HAM / SAM)">f0c40ed7d7ac4c1a957aafe864f1f114</pattern><seq>1</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:59</sys_created_on><sys_id>54646f18fb5f44a1bc0f137376b274d6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:59</sys_updated_on><title>Link hardware assets to CIs by serial number (DRY RUN by default)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item_55b30f2a3d754cfcb7b8ee22effb0541
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB IMPLEMENTATION kb-retire-stale — DATA CHANGING. DRY RUN unless DRY_RUN = false.
var DRY_RUN = true;
var KB = '';                 // <confirm> kb_knowledge_base sys_id; blank = all KBs
var QUERY = 'workflow_state=published^valid_to<javascript:gs.daysAgoStart(0)';
var stats = {would_retire: 0, retired: 0};
var k = new GlideRecord('kb_knowledge'); k.addEncodedQuery(QUERY); if (KB) k.addQuery('kb_knowledge_base', KB); k.setLimit(1000); k.query();
while (k.next()) {
  stats.would_retire++;
  gs.print((DRY_RUN ? '[DRY RUN] ' : '') + k.getValue('number') + ' (valid_to ' + k.getValue('valid_to') + ')');
  if (!DRY_RUN) { k.setValue('workflow_state', 'retired'); k.update(); stats.retired++; }
}
gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL kb-retire-stale ===\n' + JSON.stringify(stats, null, 2));</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Moves published articles past their valid-to date (or not updated in N days, if chosen) to retired, for owner-approved lists only.", "prereqs": "Knowledge owner approves the dry-run list. Use the KB workflow in production if your KB requires approval to retire.", "rollback": "Output lists sys_ids; republish via the knowledge workflow."}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>true</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Now Assist, Virtual Agent and AI-assisted service delivery">0516e578c5dd4dfda26e406e0d0f601d</pattern><seq>1</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:59</sys_created_on><sys_id>55b30f2a3d754cfcb7b8ee22effb0541</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:59</sys_updated_on><title>Stale knowledge retirement (DRY RUN by default)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>
sys_update_xml.target_name: Stale knowledge retirement (DRY RUN by default)

sys_update_xml.name: x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item_5805a91ace834acd9fe8adf7135b7777
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB IMPLEMENTATION ownership-ire — DATA CHANGING. DRY RUN unless DRY_RUN = false.
var DRY_RUN = true;
var SOURCE = 'DSB_Ownership';                 // <confirm> registered discovery_source value
var CLASS = 'cmdb_ci_linux_server';           // <confirm>
var MAP = { /* 'hostname': 'Support group name' */ };
Object.keys(MAP).forEach(function(host){
  var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group'); if (!g.get('name', MAP[host])) { gs.print('group missing: ' + MAP[host]); return; }
  var ci = new GlideRecord(CLASS); if (!ci.get('name', host)) { gs.print('ci missing: ' + host); return; }
  gs.print((DRY_RUN ? '[DRY RUN] ' : '') + host + ': ' + (ci.getDisplayValue('support_group') || '(empty)') + ' -> ' + MAP[host]);
  if (DRY_RUN) return;
  var payload = {items: [{className: CLASS, values: {name: host, serial_number: ci.getValue('serial_number'), support_group: g.getUniqueValue()}}]};
  gs.print(sn_cmdb.IdentificationEngine.createOrUpdateCIEnhanced(SOURCE, JSON.stringify(payload), {}));
});</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Sets support_group on CIs from a name→group map using createOrUpdateCIEnhanced so the change is attributed to a data source and respects reconciliation.", "prereqs": "Register the data source name (sys_choice on discovery_source) and a reconciliation rule that allows it to update support_group. Sub-prod first.", "rollback": "Output lists old/new values; reverse via the same script with old values."}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>true</modifies_data><pattern display_value="CMDB and CSDM foundation with Discovery / Service Graph">031fd78c2b3742d38dc20450125b3992</pattern><seq>2</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:21:59</sys_created_on><sys_id>5805a91ace834acd9fe8adf7135b7777</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:21:59</sys_updated_on><title>Ownership backfill through the IRE (DRY RUN by default)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>
sys_update_xml.target_name: Ownership backfill through the IRE (DRY RUN by default)

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE priv.process — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var Y = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@month@ago@12';
gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE priv.process ===\n' + JSON.stringify({key:'priv.process',
  privacy_catalog_items: count('sc_cat_item', 'active=true^nameLIKEprivacy^ORnameLIKEpersonal information'),
  privacy_ritms_12m: count('sc_req_item', Y + '^cat_item.nameLIKEprivacy'),
  security_incidents_with_privacy_12m: count('sn_si_incident', Y + '^categoryLIKEprivacy^ORcategoryLIKEdata'),
  assessments_privacy_12m: count('asmt_assessment_instance', Y + '^metric_type.nameLIKEprivacy')}, null, 2));</body><data>{"key": "priv.process", "why": "Shows whether privacy work is already partly on-platform", "unblocks": "Process design"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Privacy management and data governance">a828e5429bda4f57b75d7e4a3331f23f</pattern><seq>2</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>5bc75147d46849128cb63a8b9fcfbc3a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:00</sys_updated_on><title>Current privacy process footprint: requests, breaches and assessments recorded on the platform</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE csm.data — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var out = {key:'csm.data'};
out.accounts_active = count('customer_account', 'customer=true');
out.accounts_with_number = pct('customer_account', 'numberISNOTEMPTY');
out.contacts_active = count('customer_contact', 'active=true');
out.pct_contacts_with_email = pct('customer_contact', 'emailISNOTEMPTY', 'active=true');
out.pct_contacts_with_account = pct('customer_contact', 'accountISNOTEMPTY', 'active=true');
out.contact_duplicate_emails = 0;
var d = new GlideAggregate('customer_contact'); d.addEncodedQuery('active=true^emailISNOTEMPTY'); d.addAggregate('COUNT'); d.groupBy('email'); d.addHaving('COUNT', '>', 1); d.query(); while (d.next()) out.contact_duplicate_emails++;
out.consumers = count('csm_consumer');
out.products_models = count('cmdb_model');
out.install_base_items = count('sn_install_base_item');
out.entitlements_active = count('service_entitlement', 'active=true');
out.contracts = count('ast_contract');
out.accounts_by_source = hasField('customer_account','correlation_id') ? {with_correlation_id: count('customer_account', 'correlation_idISNOTEMPTY')} : 'n/a';
dsbPrint('csm.data', out);</body><data>{"key": "csm.data", "why": "Case routing, entitlements and the 360 view depend on this data", "unblocks": "Integration and data load design"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Customer Service Management case and contact-centre foundation">4874dc995cad4b3cb3bda8c29e4e0be8</pattern><seq>1</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>6084bcb9dd104d1f819e87974f0e26d3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:00</sys_updated_on><title>Customer data quality: accounts, contacts, consumers, products, install base, entitlements and source IDs</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE upg.quality — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var out = {key:'upg.quality'};
out.scan_checks_active = count('scan_check', 'active=true');
out.scan_results_90d = count('scan_result', LAST90);
out.scan_findings_open_by_priority = hasField('scan_finding','priority') ? groupCount('scan_finding', 'priority', 'active=true') : count('scan_finding');
out.scan_findings_by_category_top = hasField('scan_finding','check') ? groupCount('scan_finding', 'check.category', 'muted=false', 20) : 'n/a';
out.atf_tests_active = count('sys_atf_test', 'active=true');
out.atf_suites = count('sys_atf_test_suite', 'active=true');
out.atf_results_90d_by_status = groupCount('sys_atf_test_result', 'status', LAST90);
out.clones_12m = count('clone_instance', 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@month@ago@12');
out.plugins_active = count('sys_plugins', 'active=true');
out.store_apps_update_available = hasField('sys_store_app','update_available') ? count('sys_store_app', 'active=true^update_available=true') : 'n/a';
out.legacy_indicators = {service_catalog_legacy_workflow_items: count('sc_cat_item', 'active=true^workflowISNOTEMPTY'), cms_sites: count('content_site'), legacy_reports_public: hasField('sys_report','is_published') ? count('sys_report', 'is_published=true') : 'n/a'};
dsbPrint('upg.quality', out);</body><data>{"key": "upg.quality", "why": "Measures the regression safety net and known deprecations", "unblocks": "ATF scope, deprecation plan"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Platform upgrade, customisation and technical-debt remediation">93dbb3f9c9374c8b88cbf9fbbc6dee11</pattern><seq>3</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>62b3a9b1f48442e88f21465200ac5b85</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:00</sys_updated_on><title>Instance Scan results, ATF coverage, clone history and deprecated plugins</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE upg.custom — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var out = {key:'upg.custom'};
out.custom_tables_u_ = count('sys_db_object', 'nameSTARTSWITHu_');
out.custom_fields_u_on_global_tables = count('sys_dictionary', 'elementSTARTSWITHu_^nameNOT LIKEu_');
out.custom_fields_by_table_top = groupCount('sys_dictionary', 'name', 'elementSTARTSWITHu_^nameNOT LIKEu_', 25);
out.scoped_apps_custom = count('sys_app');
out.business_rules_by_scope = groupCount('sys_script', 'sys_scope', 'active=true', 25);
out.script_includes_by_scope = groupCount('sys_script_include', 'sys_scope', 'active=true', 25);
out.client_scripts_active = count('sys_script_client', 'active=true');
out.ui_scripts_global = count('sys_ui_script', 'active=true^global=true');
out.legacy_workflows_published = count('wf_workflow_version', 'published=true');
out.workflow_contexts_running = count('wf_context', 'state=executing');
out.flows_active = count('sys_hub_flow', 'active=true');
out.update_sets_in_progress = count('sys_update_set', 'state=in progress');
out.customer_update_versions_90d = count('sys_update_version', LAST90);
out.dom_manipulation_client_scripts = count('sys_script_client', 'active=true^scriptLIKEdocument.^ORscriptLIKEgel(^ORscriptLIKEjQuery');
out.gliderecord_in_client_scripts = count('sys_script_client', 'active=true^scriptLIKEnew GlideRecord');
out.current_update_in_before_rules = count('sys_script', 'active=true^when=before^scriptLIKEcurrent.update()');
dsbPrint('upg.custom', out);</body><data>{"key": "upg.custom", "why": "Shows where debt concentrates", "unblocks": "Remediation priorities"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Platform upgrade, customisation and technical-debt remediation">93dbb3f9c9374c8b88cbf9fbbc6dee11</pattern><seq>2</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:01</sys_created_on><sys_id>692848f1100d492d9143d50db8b41077</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:01</sys_updated_on><title>Customisation footprint: customer updates to OOB files, custom tables/fields, scripts and legacy workflows by scope</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB PVT verify tel — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var W = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@30';
gs.print('=== DSB-PVT tel ===\n' + JSON.stringify({cases_30d: count('sn_customerservice_case', W), alerts_30d: count('em_alert', W), orders_30d: count('sn_ind_tmt_orm_order', W), ran: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue()}, null, 2));</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Checks inventory linkage and case/incident flow.", "prereqs": null, "rollback": null}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Telecommunications service and order management">e96633990a4b4bd0a7aa9de3d4f7fa00</pattern><seq>1</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:02</sys_created_on><sys_id>6cbbeee0425c4fd99440b8980409cb6f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:02</sys_updated_on><title>Post-implementation verification — telecom (READ ONLY)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>Update set 1: HRSD_Security_<client>_v1 (Human Resources: Core) - Restricted HR service settings, any justified ACL additions Update set 2: HRSD_Services_<client>_v1 (Human Resources: Core) - COEs/topic categories/topic details/HR services, HR templates - Record producers, matching rules, SLA definitions, HR criteria Update set 3: HRSD_Lifecycle_<client>_v1 (Human Resources: Lifecycle Events) - Activity sets, activities, lifecycle event services Update set 4: HRSD_EmployeeCenter_<client>_v1 (global / Employee Center scope) - Taxonomy, branding, dashboards, survey triggers Data (not update sets): group memberships, HR profiles, knowledge articles. Note: group role grants (sys_group_has_role) are captured in update sets — review them before completing. Tip: use a batch update set parent so the four promote together.</body><data>{"kind": "checklist", "purpose": "HRSD configuration lives in HR application scopes; each scope needs its own update set. function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }

  var q = []; scopes.forEach(function(s){ q.push('scopeSTARTSWITH' + s); }); names.forEach(function(n){ q.push('nameLIKE' + n); });

    while (t.next()) { var n = t.getValue('name'); var c = count(n); if (c !== 0) o.tables[n] = c; } }

var g = new GlideRecord('pm_project'); g.addActiveQuery(); g.setLimit(MAX_ROWS); g.query();
while (g.next()) {
  if (reported[g.getUniqueValue()]) continue;
  var pf = g.isValidField('primary_portfolio') ? (g.getDisplayValue('primary_portfolio') || '(none)') : '(n/a)';
  byPortfolio[pf] = (byPortfolio[pf] || 0) + 1;
  if (out.length < 300) out.push(g.getValue('number'));
}
gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL spm-stale-status ===\n' + JSON.stringify({days: DAYS, count: out.length, by_portfolio: byPortfolio, project_numbers: out}, null, 2));</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Lists active project numbers without a status report in N days, grouped by portfolio, for the PMO cadence. <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE itsm.foundation — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var base = 'active=true';
var out = {key:'itsm.foundation', users_active: count('sys_user', base),
  pct_users_with_manager: pct('sys_user', 'managerISNOTEMPTY', base), pct_users_with_department: pct('sys_user', 'departmentISNOTEMPTY', base),
  pct_users_with_location: pct('sys_user', 'locationISNOTEMPTY', base), pct_users_with_email: pct('sys_user', 'emailISNOTEMPTY', base),
  users_by_source: groupCount('sys_user', 'source', base), duplicate_emails: 0,
  locations: count('cmn_location'), departments: count('cmn_department'), companies: count('core_company'),
  business_services: count('cmdb_ci_service', 'operational_status=1'), service_offerings: count('service_offering')};
var ga = new GlideAggregate('sys_user'); ga.addEncodedQuery(base + '^emailISNOTEMPTY'); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy('email'); ga.addHaving('COUNT', '>', 1); ga.query();
while (ga.next()) out.duplicate_emails++;
out.ldap_servers = count('ldap_server_config', 'active=true'); out.scheduled_imports = count('scheduled_import_set', 'active=true');
dsbPrint('itsm.foundation', out);</body><data>{"key": "itsm.foundation", "why": "Routing, approvals and reporting all depend on it", "unblocks": "Identity/HR import design"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="ITSM consolidation and legacy service-desk migration">7663f4d384ef408a8ba3062e8c27a96c</pattern><seq>5</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:04</sys_created_on><sys_id>7d6b7842b768474bae9341dee7dfc516</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:04</sys_updated_on><title>Foundation data quality: users, managers, departments, locations, companies</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }

out.alerts_table = gs.tableExists('sn_si_alert') ? {total: count('sn_si_alert'), last_30d: count('sn_si_alert', 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@30')} : 'sn_si_alert not found';
out.observables = count('sn_ti_observable');

sys_update_xml.name: x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item_7a20c8ad47924e75bacf04b66756112b
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE cmdb.ire — READ ONLY.
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var out = {key:'cmdb.ire', identification_rules:[], reconciliation_definitions:[], notes:[]};
var ir = new GlideRecord('cmdb_identifier'); ir.addQuery('active', true); ir.query();
while (ir.next()) {
  var rule = {applies_to: ir.getValue('applies_to'), name: ir.getValue('name'), independent: ir.getValue('independent'), entries: []};
  var e = new GlideRecord('cmdb_identifier_entry'); e.addQuery('identifier', ir.getUniqueValue()); e.orderBy('order'); e.query();
  while (e.next()) rule.entries.push({order: e.getValue('order'), attributes: e.getValue('attributes'), table: e.getValue('table'), active: e.getValue('active'), search_on_table: e.getValue('search_on_table')});
  if (/computer|server|hardware|netgear|vm_instance/.test(rule.applies_to)) out.identification_rules.push(rule);
}
if (gs.tableExists('cmdb_reconciliation_definition')) {
  var rd = new GlideRecord('cmdb_reconciliation_definition'); rd.query();
  while (rd.next()) out.reconciliation_definitions.push({applies_to: rd.getValue('applies_to'), source: rd.getDisplayValue('discovery_source'), attributes: rd.getValue('attributes'), active: rd.getValue('active')});
} else out.notes.push('cmdb_reconciliation_definition not found');
function dupes(t, f){ var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); ga.addNotNullQuery(f); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.addHaving('COUNT', '>', 1); ga.query(); var n = 0, sample = []; while (ga.next()) { n++; if (sample.length < 10) sample.push(ga.getValue(f) + ' x' + ga.getAggregate('COUNT')); } return {duplicate_keys: n, sample: sample}; }
out.duplicates_by_serial_computer = dupes('cmdb_ci_computer','serial_number');
out.duplicates_by_name_computer = dupes('cmdb_ci_computer','name');
if (gs.tableExists('reconcile_duplicate_task')) { var dt = new GlideAggregate('reconcile_duplicate_task'); dt.addAggregate('COUNT'); dt.groupBy('state'); dt.query(); out.duplicate_tasks_by_state = {}; while (dt.next()) out.duplicate_tasks_by_state[dt.getDisplayValue('state')] = parseInt(dt.getAggregate('COUNT'),10); }
dsbPrint('cmdb.ire', out);</body><data>{"key": "cmdb.ire", "why": "Determines whether the IRE will merge or duplicate when a second source (or Tenable) presents an asset", "unblocks": "IRE and reconciliation design"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Tenable vulnerability ingestion without a CMDB foundation">9ad6efafe3d645c1bce9ff6b75af7152</pattern><seq>3</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:04</sys_created_on><sys_id>7a20c8ad47924e75bacf04b66756112b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:04</sys_updated_on><title>Identification rules, reconciliation definitions and duplicate exposure</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>
sys_update_xml.target_name: Identification rules, reconciliation definitions and duplicate exposure
