<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB IMPLEMENTATION er-location-coords — DATA CHANGING. DRY RUN unless DRY_RUN = false. Prints counts and record sys_ids only.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var DRY_RUN = true;   // set to false only after the dry-run output is approved
var STATS = {checked: 0, would_change: 0, changed: 0, skipped: [], changed_ids: []};
// Set FIELD on records in TABLE matched by KEY_FIELD, using MAP {keyValue: newValue}. Reference values are resolved by display value in REF_TABLE (optional).
function backfill(TABLE, KEY_FIELD, FIELD, MAP, REF_TABLE, EXTRA_QUERY){
  var refCache = {};
  Object.keys(MAP).forEach(function(k){
    var v = MAP[k];
    if (REF_TABLE) { if (refCache[v] === undefined) { var r = new GlideRecord(REF_TABLE); refCache[v] = r.get(r.getDisplayName(), v) ? r.getUniqueValue() : null; } if (!refCache[v]) { STATS.skipped.push('reference not found for key ' + k); return; } v = refCache[v]; }
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); gr.addQuery(KEY_FIELD, k); if (EXTRA_QUERY) gr.addEncodedQuery(EXTRA_QUERY); gr.setLimit(MAX_ROWS); gr.query();
    while (gr.next()) { STATS.checked++; if (gr.getValue(FIELD) == v) continue; STATS.would_change++;
      if (!DRY_RUN) { gr.setValue(FIELD, v); gr.update(); STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(gr.getUniqueValue()); } }
  });
}
// Insert ROWS into TABLE when no record matches all MATCH_FIELDS.
function seed(TABLE, MATCH_FIELDS, ROWS){
  ROWS.forEach(function(row){
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); MATCH_FIELDS.forEach(function(f){ gr.addQuery(f, row[f]); }); gr.setLimit(1); gr.query();
    STATS.checked++; if (gr.hasNext()) return; STATS.would_change++;
    if (!DRY_RUN) { var n = new GlideRecord(TABLE); n.initialize(); Object.keys(row).forEach(function(f){ n.setValue(f, row[f]); }); var id = n.insert(); if (id) { STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(id); } }
  });
}
function report(name){ gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL ' + name + (DRY_RUN ? ' [DRY RUN]' : '') + ' ===\n' + JSON.stringify(STATS, null, 2)); }
var LAT = { /* 'Sydney Office': '-33.8688' */ };
var LON = { /* 'Sydney Office': '151.2093' */ };
backfill('cmn_location', 'name', 'latitude', LAT);
backfill('cmn_location', 'name', 'longitude', LON);
report('er-location-coords');</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Sets latitude and longitude on locations from an approved list.", "prereqs": "Sub-production first. Fill the map/list from the client-approved source. Review the dry-run counts before switching DRY_RUN off.", "rollback": "The output lists changed_ids; reverse from an XML export taken beforehand or by re-running with the previous values."}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>true</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Emergency outreach and workforce wellbeing (Safe Workplace)">feb9570f3df64d249bd135c8a0a1bfa2</pattern><seq>2</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:14</sys_created_on><sys_id>c31772f8b6254ef391788515a5674221</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:14</sys_updated_on><title>Set location coordinates for outreach targeting (DRY RUN by default)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

    if (REF_TABLE) { if (refCache[v] === undefined) { var r = new GlideRecord(REF_TABLE); refCache[v] = r.get(r.getDisplayName(), v) ? r.getUniqueValue() : null; } if (!refCache[v]) { STATS.skipped.push('reference not found for key ' + k); return; } v = refCache[v]; }
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); gr.addQuery(KEY_FIELD, k); if (EXTRA_QUERY) gr.addEncodedQuery(EXTRA_QUERY); gr.setLimit(MAX_ROWS); gr.query();
    while (gr.next()) { STATS.checked++; if (gr.getValue(FIELD) == v) continue; STATS.would_change++;
      if (!DRY_RUN) { gr.setValue(FIELD, v); gr.update(); STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(gr.getUniqueValue()); } }
  });
}
// Insert ROWS into TABLE when no record matches all MATCH_FIELDS.
function seed(TABLE, MATCH_FIELDS, ROWS){
  ROWS.forEach(function(row){
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); MATCH_FIELDS.forEach(function(f){ gr.addQuery(f, row[f]); }); gr.setLimit(1); gr.query();
    STATS.checked++; if (gr.hasNext()) return; STATS.would_change++;
    if (!DRY_RUN) { var n = new GlideRecord(TABLE); n.initialize(); Object.keys(row).forEach(function(f){ n.setValue(f, row[f]); }); var id = n.insert(); if (id) { STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(id); } }
  });
}
function report(name){ gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL ' + name + (DRY_RUN ? ' [DRY RUN]' : '') + ' ===\n' + JSON.stringify(STATS, null, 2)); }
var MAP = { /* '<category sys_id>': 'Facilities Team' */ };
backfill('sc_cat_item', 'category', 'group', MAP, 'sys_user_group', 'active=true^groupISEMPTY');   // <confirm> 'group' field on sc_cat_item
report('esm-item-group');</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Sets the fulfilment group on catalogue items in a department category where it is empty.", "prereqs": "Sub-production first. Fill the map/list from the client-approved source. Review the dry-run counts before switching DRY_RUN off.", "rollback": "The output lists changed_ids; reverse from an XML export taken beforehand or by re-running with the previous values."}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>true</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Enterprise service management: workplace, facilities, legal, finance">f57c6db779734f4ea34b1ec5d8dedf38</pattern><seq>2</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:15</sys_created_on><sys_id>c66cc266f387484bb4e4ebaee7d49c36</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:15</sys_updated_on><title>Set fulfilment group on department catalogue items (DRY RUN by default)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE em.services — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var out = {key:'em.services'};
out.application_services = count('cmdb_ci_service_auto');
out.application_services_by_class = groupCount('cmdb_ci_service_auto', 'sys_class_name');
out.service_ci_associations = count('svc_ci_assoc');
out.alert_cis_top_classes_30d = groupCount('em_alert', 'cmdb_ci.sys_class_name', 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@30', 20);
out.major_incidents_90d = hasField('incident','major_incident_state') ? count('incident', LAST90 + '^major_incident_state=accepted') : 'n/a';
out.p1_incidents_90d = count('incident', LAST90 + '^priority=1');
dsbPrint('em.services', out);</body><data>{"key": "em.services", "why": "Impact and correlation depend on the service model", "unblocks": "Service health scope"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="ITOM Health: event management, AIOps and observability">27017c1f692149c79a16726ca19e8c2b</pattern><seq>3</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:15</sys_created_on><sys_id>c713e13e3a7a48de981adc553c852414</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:15</sys_updated_on><title>Service model readiness for impact: application services, service CIs with alerts, major incidents</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB IMPLEMENTATION hc-recall-match — READ ONLY.
var MODEL = '';           // <confirm> cmdb_model sys_id
var SERIALS = [];         // explicit serial list from the recall notice, or leave empty and use PREFIX
var PREFIX = '';          // serial prefix if the notice gives a range
var out = [];
var a = new GlideRecord('alm_hardware'); a.addQuery('model', MODEL); a.addQuery('install_status', '!=', 7);
if (SERIALS.length) a.addQuery('serial_number', 'IN', SERIALS.join(',')); else if (PREFIX) a.addQuery('serial_number', 'STARTSWITH', PREFIX);
a.query();
while (a.next()) out.push({asset_tag: a.getValue('asset_tag'), serial: a.getValue('serial_number'), location: a.getDisplayValue('location'), department: a.getDisplayValue('department')});
gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL hc-recall-match ===\n' + JSON.stringify({count: out.length, devices: out}, null, 2));</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Lists active assets of a model within a serial range for a recall notice.", "prereqs": null, "rollback": null}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Healthcare clinical device and service operations">0e998cd6afca4efe958b07af4c028893</pattern><seq>0</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:15</sys_created_on><sys_id>cac497de20404a2dbfcc3ca4c2c00c23</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:15</sys_updated_on><title>Recall match report (READ ONLY)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE esm.demand — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var out = {key:'esm.demand'};
out.catalogs = groupCount('sc_catalog', 'title', 'active=true');

'' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }

function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }

function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE upg.hotspots — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var out = {key:'upg.hotspots'};
out.version_hotspots_top = groupCount('sys_update_version', 'name', 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@month@ago@24', 30);
var risky = [
  ['gs.sleep', 'sys_script'], ['gs.sleep', 'sys_script_include'], ['setWorkflow(false)', 'sys_script'],
  ['eval(', 'sys_script_include'], ['getXMLWait', 'sys_script_client'], ['sys_id=', 'sys_script']
];
out.risky_patterns = {};
risky.forEach(function(r){ out.risky_patterns[r[0] + ' in ' + r[1]] = count(r[1], 'active=true^scriptLIKE' + r[0]); });
dsbPrint('upg.hotspots', out);</body><data>{"key": "upg.hotspots", "why": "Identifies what to test and remediate first", "unblocks": "Remediation backlog"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Platform upgrade, customisation and technical-debt remediation">93dbb3f9c9374c8b88cbf9fbbc6dee11</pattern><seq>4</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:18</sys_created_on><sys_id>e84549f5cc9b424fadbab429b18319c9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:18</sys_updated_on><title>Most-customised records (update-version hotspots) and scripts with risky patterns</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB PVT verify esg — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
function appInventory(scopes, names, tablePrefixes){
  var o = {release: gs.getProperty('glide.buildname', '(not set)'), store_apps: [], tables: {}};
  var q = []; scopes.forEach(function(s){ q.push('scopeSTARTSWITH' + s); }); names.forEach(function(n){ q.push('nameLIKE' + n); });
  if (q.length) { var sa = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); sa.addEncodedQuery(q.join('^OR')); sa.query(); while (sa.next()) o.store_apps.push(sa.getValue('name') + ' ' + sa.getValue('version') + (sa.getValue('active') == '1' || sa.getValue('active') == 'true' ? '' : ' (inactive)')); }
  var tq = []; tablePrefixes.forEach(function(p){ tq.push('nameSTARTSWITH' + p); });
  if (tq.length) { var t = new GlideRecord('sys_db_object'); t.addEncodedQuery(tq.join('^OR')); t.orderBy('name'); t.setLimit(150); t.query();
    while (t.next()) { var n = t.getValue('name'); var c = count(n); if (c !== 0) o.tables[n] = c; } }
  return o;
}
var inv = appInventory(['sn_esg'], ['ESG'], ['sn_esg_']);
gs.print('=== DSB-PVT esg ===\n' + JSON.stringify({apps: inv.store_apps, tables_with_rows: inv.tables, locations_without_country: count('cmn_location', 'countryISEMPTY'), ran: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue()}, null, 2));</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Checks the ESG app is installed and reporting entities are complete.", "prereqs": null, "rollback": null}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="ESG and sustainability reporting">708c573d6514412a95254bedf01bfc4a</pattern><seq>2</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:16</sys_created_on><sys_id>da4bcb2841ea4c87b7e8c1b8b3bc1227</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:16</sys_updated_on><title>Post-implementation verification — ESG (READ ONLY)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE irm.apps — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var out = {key:'irm.apps', release: gs.getProperty('glide.buildname', '(not set)'), store_apps:[]};
var sa = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); sa.addEncodedQuery('scopeSTARTSWITHsn_grc^ORscopeSTARTSWITHsn_compliance^ORscopeSTARTSWITHsn_risk^ORscopeSTARTSWITHsn_audit^ORscopeSTARTSWITHsn_vdr^ORscopeSTARTSWITHsn_bcm^ORscopeSTARTSWITHsn_irm^ORnameLIKERisk^ORnameLIKECompliance'); sa.query();
while (sa.next()) out.store_apps.push({name: sa.getValue('name'), scope: sa.getValue('scope'), version: sa.getValue('version'), active: sa.getValue('active')});
out.roles_with_holders = {};
var r = new GlideRecord('sys_user_role'); r.addEncodedQuery('nameSTARTSWITHsn_grc^ORnameSTARTSWITHsn_compliance^ORnameSTARTSWITHsn_risk^ORnameSTARTSWITHsn_audit'); r.query();
while (r.next()) { var n = count('sys_user_has_role', 'role=' + r.getUniqueValue() + '^user.active=true'); if (n) out.roles_with_holders[r.getValue('name')] = n; }
dsbPrint('irm.apps', out);</body><data>{"key": "irm.apps", "why": "Confirms technical availability and version — not entitlement", "unblocks": "Licensing check, scope"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="IRM / GRC policy, risk and compliance foundation">4b16aa07c3c5429a93a6f33c5ef138c0</pattern><seq>0</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:16</sys_created_on><sys_id>dbcf49e7b2a74ace8640443af43b7503</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:16</sys_updated_on><title>IRM applications and versions installed (Policy & Compliance, Risk, Audit, VRM, BCM)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }

'' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
if (gs.tableExists('sn_sec_cmn_discovered_item')) {
  out.discovered_total = count('sn_sec_cmn_discovered_item');
  var st = new GlideAggregate('sn_sec_cmn_discovered_item'); st.addAggregate('COUNT'); st.groupBy('state'); st.query();

  out.by_lookup_rule = {}; while (rl.next()) out.by_lookup_rule[rl.getDisplayValue('ci_lookup_rule') || '(none)'] = parseInt(rl.getAggregate('COUNT'),10);
  // sample unmatched items: which fields does the scanner actually send?
  var gr = new GlideRecord('sn_sec_cmn_discovered_item'); gr.addNullQuery('cmdb_ci'); gr.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on'); gr.setLimit(15); gr.query();
  out.unmatched_sample = [];
  while (gr.next()) {
    var row = {source_id: gr.getValue('source_id')};

  out.ci_lookup_rules = rules;
} else out.notes.push('sn_sec_cmn_ci_lookup_rule not found');
if (gs.tableExists('sn_sec_cmn_src_cmdb_map')) { out.host_import_maps = count('sn_sec_cmn_src_cmdb_map'); }

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB PVT verify int — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var W = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@7';
var total = count('sys_outbound_http_log', W), err = count('sys_outbound_http_log', W + '^response_status>=400');

  outbound_7d: total, outbound_errors_7d: err, error_pct: (typeof total === 'number' && total) ? Math.round(1000 * err / total) / 10 : 0,
  import_runs_with_errors_7d: count('sys_import_set_run', W + '^errors>0'),
  flow_errors_7d: count('sys_flow_context', W + '^state=ERROR'),
  ran: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue()}, null, 2));</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Weekly error-rate check against the int.health baseline.", "prereqs": null, "rollback": null}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Enterprise integrations (IntegrationHub, SAP, Workday, Salesforce)">034d05e2e2bc499f95be7ad7aa17f020</pattern><seq>1</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:17</sys_created_on><sys_id>de0ea879d08048128363a9463d7ab8aa</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:17</sys_updated_on><title>Post-implementation verification — integrations (READ ONLY)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE priv.apps — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
function appInventory(scopes, names, tablePrefixes){
  var o = {release: gs.getProperty('glide.buildname', '(not set)'), store_apps: [], tables: {}};
  var q = []; scopes.forEach(function(s){ q.push('scopeSTARTSWITH' + s); }); names.forEach(function(n){ q.push('nameLIKE' + n); });
  if (q.length) { var sa = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); sa.addEncodedQuery(q.join('^OR')); sa.query(); while (sa.next()) o.store_apps.push(sa.getValue('name') + ' ' + sa.getValue('version') + (sa.getValue('active') == '1' || sa.getValue('active') == 'true' ? '' : ' (inactive)')); }
  var tq = []; tablePrefixes.forEach(function(p){ tq.push('nameSTARTSWITH' + p); });
  if (tq.length) { var t = new GlideRecord('sys_db_object'); t.addEncodedQuery(tq.join('^OR')); t.orderBy('name'); t.setLimit(150); t.query();
    while (t.next()) { var n = t.getValue('name'); var c = count(n); if (c !== 0) o.tables[n] = c; } }
  return o;
}
var out = appInventory(['sn_privacy','sn_dpr','sn_data_privacy','sn_irm_privacy','sn_data_class'], ['Privacy','Data Privacy','Data Classification','Data Discovery','Anonymization'], ['sn_privacy_','sn_dpr_','sys_data_privacy','sn_data_class']);
out.key = 'priv.apps';
dsbPrint('priv.apps', out);</body><data>{"key": "priv.apps", "why": "Confirms Privacy Management and platform privacy features present", "unblocks": "Licensing and scope"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Privacy management and data governance">a828e5429bda4f57b75d7e4a3331f23f</pattern><seq>0</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:17</sys_created_on><sys_id>e0ba919cd64a4964b1d2321d12d6bfee</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:17</sys_updated_on><title>Privacy Management and data protection apps/plugins and tables with data</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE hr.apps — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var out = {key:'hr.apps', store_apps:[], plugins:[], portals:[]};
var sa = new GlideRecord('sys_store_app'); sa.addEncodedQuery('scopeSTARTSWITHsn_hr^ORscopeSTARTSWITHsn_ex^ORscopeSTARTSWITHsn_jny^ORscopeSTARTSWITHsn_doc^ORnameLIKEEmployee'); sa.query();
while (sa.next()) out.store_apps.push({name: sa.getValue('name'), scope: sa.getValue('scope'), version: sa.getValue('version'), active: sa.getValue('active')});
var pl = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins'); pl.addEncodedQuery('active=true^idLIKEsn_hr^ORidLIKEemployee'); pl.query();
while (pl.next()) out.plugins.push({id: pl.getValue('id'), name: pl.getValue('name')});
var p = new GlideRecord('sp_portal'); p.query();
while (p.next()) out.portals.push({title: p.getValue('title'), url_suffix: p.getValue('url_suffix')});
out.release = gs.getProperty('glide.buildname', '(not set)');
dsbPrint('hr.apps', out);</body><data>{"key": "hr.apps", "why": "Confirms what is technically installed (not licensed) and the HRSD app versions", "unblocks": "Licensing check, release-specific design"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="HR Service Delivery foundation and employee lifecycle">1a261fc057734397b446de21b49dcf22</pattern><seq>0</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:18</sys_created_on><sys_id>e64eeddd14ae4027add34d0b80812333</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:18</sys_updated_on><title>HRSD applications, plugins and versions installed; Employee Center presence</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }

});

function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var DRY_RUN = true;   // set to false only after the dry-run output is approved
var STATS = {checked: 0, would_change: 0, changed: 0, skipped: [], changed_ids: []};
// Set FIELD on records in TABLE matched by KEY_FIELD, using MAP {keyValue: newValue}. Reference values are resolved by display value in REF_TABLE (optional).
function backfill(TABLE, KEY_FIELD, FIELD, MAP, REF_TABLE, EXTRA_QUERY){
  var refCache = {};
  Object.keys(MAP).forEach(function(k){
    var v = MAP[k];
    if (REF_TABLE) { if (refCache[v] === undefined) { var r = new GlideRecord(REF_TABLE); refCache[v] = r.get(r.getDisplayName(), v) ? r.getUniqueValue() : null; } if (!refCache[v]) { STATS.skipped.push('reference not found for key ' + k); return; } v = refCache[v]; }
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); gr.addQuery(KEY_FIELD, k); if (EXTRA_QUERY) gr.addEncodedQuery(EXTRA_QUERY); gr.setLimit(MAX_ROWS); gr.query();
    while (gr.next()) { STATS.checked++; if (gr.getValue(FIELD) == v) continue; STATS.would_change++;
      if (!DRY_RUN) { gr.setValue(FIELD, v); gr.update(); STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(gr.getUniqueValue()); } }
  });
}
// Insert ROWS into TABLE when no record matches all MATCH_FIELDS.
function seed(TABLE, MATCH_FIELDS, ROWS){
  ROWS.forEach(function(row){
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); MATCH_FIELDS.forEach(function(f){ gr.addQuery(f, row[f]); }); gr.setLimit(1); gr.query();
    STATS.checked++; if (gr.hasNext()) return; STATS.would_change++;
    if (!DRY_RUN) { var n = new GlideRecord(TABLE); n.initialize(); Object.keys(row).forEach(function(f){ n.setValue(f, row[f]); }); var id = n.insert(); if (id) { STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(id); } }
  });
}
function report(name){ gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL ' + name + (DRY_RUN ? ' [DRY RUN]' : '') + ' ===\n' + JSON.stringify(STATS, null, 2)); }
seed('data_classification', ['name'], [ {name: 'Personal'}, {name: 'Sensitive'}, {name: 'Public'} ]);   // <confirm> table name on this release
report('priv-seed-classes');</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Creates the agreed data classification records if missing.", "prereqs": "Sub-production first. Fill the map/list from the client-approved source. Review the dry-run counts before switching DRY_RUN off.", "rollback": "The output lists changed_ids; reverse from an XML export taken beforehand or by re-running with the previous values."}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>true</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Privacy management and data governance">a828e5429bda4f57b75d7e4a3331f23f</pattern><seq>2</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:18</sys_created_on><sys_id>ead70bf4c6b242d0a4ec3350010ba2d0</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:18</sys_updated_on><title>Seed data classification levels (DRY RUN by default)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

var DRY_RUN = true;
var DAYS = 180;
var KEEP = [ /* sys_ids of seasonal or regulatory items to keep */ ];
var stats = {checked: 0, would_deactivate: 0, deactivated: 0};
var ci = new GlideRecord('sc_cat_item'); ci.addQuery('active', true); ci.addQuery('sys_class_name', 'sc_cat_item'); ci.query();
while (ci.next()) {
  stats.checked++;
  if (KEEP.indexOf(ci.getUniqueValue()) > -1) continue;
  var r = new GlideAggregate('sc_req_item'); r.addQuery('cat_item', ci.getUniqueValue()); r.addEncodedQuery('sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@' + DAYS); r.addAggregate('COUNT'); r.query();
  var n = r.next() ? parseInt(r.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0;
  if (n > 0) continue;
  stats.would_deactivate++;
  gs.print((DRY_RUN ? '[DRY RUN] ' : '') + 'deactivate ' + ci.getValue('name') + ' (' + ci.getUniqueValue() + ')');
  if (!DRY_RUN) { ci.setValue('active', false); ci.update(); stats.deactivated++; }
}
gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL retire-catalog-items ===\n' + JSON.stringify(stats, null, 2));</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Deactivates standard catalogue items with no requested items in the look-back window and not on the keep list. <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB IMPLEMENTATION esg-location-country — DATA CHANGING. DRY RUN unless DRY_RUN = false. Prints counts and record sys_ids only.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }

var STATS = {checked: 0, would_change: 0, changed: 0, skipped: [], changed_ids: []};
// Set FIELD on records in TABLE matched by KEY_FIELD, using MAP {keyValue: newValue}. Reference values are resolved by display value in REF_TABLE (optional).
function backfill(TABLE, KEY_FIELD, FIELD, MAP, REF_TABLE, EXTRA_QUERY){
  var refCache = {};

    var v = MAP[k];
    if (REF_TABLE) { if (refCache[v] === undefined) { var r = new GlideRecord(REF_TABLE); refCache[v] = r.get(r.getDisplayName(), v) ? r.getUniqueValue() : null; } if (!refCache[v]) { STATS.skipped.push('reference not found for key ' + k); return; } v = refCache[v]; }

  });

  });
}

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB IMPLEMENTATION csm-case-account — DATA CHANGING. DRY RUN unless DRY_RUN = false. Prints counts and record sys_ids only.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var DRY_RUN = true;   // set to false only after the dry-run output is approved
var STATS = {checked: 0, would_change: 0, changed: 0, skipped: [], changed_ids: []};
// Set FIELD on records in TABLE matched by KEY_FIELD, using MAP {keyValue: newValue}. Reference values are resolved by display value in REF_TABLE (optional).
function backfill(TABLE, KEY_FIELD, FIELD, MAP, REF_TABLE, EXTRA_QUERY){
  var refCache = {};
  Object.keys(MAP).forEach(function(k){
    var v = MAP[k];
    if (REF_TABLE) { if (refCache[v] === undefined) { var r = new GlideRecord(REF_TABLE); refCache[v] = r.get(r.getDisplayName(), v) ? r.getUniqueValue() : null; } if (!refCache[v]) { STATS.skipped.push('reference not found for key ' + k); return; } v = refCache[v]; }
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); gr.addQuery(KEY_FIELD, k); if (EXTRA_QUERY) gr.addEncodedQuery(EXTRA_QUERY); gr.setLimit(MAX_ROWS); gr.query();
    while (gr.next()) { STATS.checked++; if (gr.getValue(FIELD) == v) continue; STATS.would_change++;
      if (!DRY_RUN) { gr.setValue(FIELD, v); gr.update(); STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(gr.getUniqueValue()); } }
  });
}
// Insert ROWS into TABLE when no record matches all MATCH_FIELDS.
function seed(TABLE, MATCH_FIELDS, ROWS){
  ROWS.forEach(function(row){
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); MATCH_FIELDS.forEach(function(f){ gr.addQuery(f, row[f]); }); gr.setLimit(1); gr.query();
    STATS.checked++; if (gr.hasNext()) return; STATS.would_change++;
    if (!DRY_RUN) { var n = new GlideRecord(TABLE); n.initialize(); Object.keys(row).forEach(function(f){ n.setValue(f, row[f]); }); var id = n.insert(); if (id) { STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(id); } }
  });
}
function report(name){ gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL ' + name + (DRY_RUN ? ' [DRY RUN]' : '') + ' ===\n' + JSON.stringify(STATS, null, 2)); }
var c = new GlideRecord('sn_customerservice_case'); c.addEncodedQuery('active=true^accountISEMPTY^contactISNOTEMPTY^contact.accountISNOTEMPTY'); c.setLimit(MAX_ROWS); c.query();
while (c.next()) { STATS.checked++; STATS.would_change++;
  if (!DRY_RUN) { c.setValue('account', c.contact.account + ''); c.update(); STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(c.getUniqueValue()); } }
report('csm-case-account');</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Fills the account on open cases that have a contact but no account.", "prereqs": "Sub-production first. Fill the map/list from the client-approved source. Review the dry-run counts before switching DRY_RUN off.", "rollback": "The output lists changed_ids; reverse from an XML export taken beforehand or by re-running with the previous values."}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>true</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Customer Service Management case and contact-centre foundation">4874dc995cad4b3cb3bda8c29e4e0be8</pattern><seq>3</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:19</sys_created_on><sys_id>f10f70b9e3894d93b4f8ba97dc6ed76f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:19</sys_updated_on><title>Link cases to the contact's account (DRY RUN by default)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>
sys_update_xml.target_name: Link cases to the contact's account (DRY RUN by default)

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB IMPLEMENTATION upg-stale-update-sets — DATA CHANGING. DRY RUN unless DRY_RUN = false. Prints counts and record sys_ids only.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var DRY_RUN = true;   // set to false only after the dry-run output is approved
var STATS = {checked: 0, would_change: 0, changed: 0, skipped: [], changed_ids: []};
// Set FIELD on records in TABLE matched by KEY_FIELD, using MAP {keyValue: newValue}. Reference values are resolved by display value in REF_TABLE (optional).
function backfill(TABLE, KEY_FIELD, FIELD, MAP, REF_TABLE, EXTRA_QUERY){
  var refCache = {};
  Object.keys(MAP).forEach(function(k){
    var v = MAP[k];
    if (REF_TABLE) { if (refCache[v] === undefined) { var r = new GlideRecord(REF_TABLE); refCache[v] = r.get(r.getDisplayName(), v) ? r.getUniqueValue() : null; } if (!refCache[v]) { STATS.skipped.push('reference not found for key ' + k); return; } v = refCache[v]; }
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); gr.addQuery(KEY_FIELD, k); if (EXTRA_QUERY) gr.addEncodedQuery(EXTRA_QUERY); gr.setLimit(MAX_ROWS); gr.query();
    while (gr.next()) { STATS.checked++; if (gr.getValue(FIELD) == v) continue; STATS.would_change++;
      if (!DRY_RUN) { gr.setValue(FIELD, v); gr.update(); STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(gr.getUniqueValue()); } }
  });
}
// Insert ROWS into TABLE when no record matches all MATCH_FIELDS.
function seed(TABLE, MATCH_FIELDS, ROWS){
  ROWS.forEach(function(row){
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); MATCH_FIELDS.forEach(function(f){ gr.addQuery(f, row[f]); }); gr.setLimit(1); gr.query();
    STATS.checked++; if (gr.hasNext()) return; STATS.would_change++;
    if (!DRY_RUN) { var n = new GlideRecord(TABLE); n.initialize(); Object.keys(row).forEach(function(f){ n.setValue(f, row[f]); }); var id = n.insert(); if (id) { STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(id); } }
  });
}
function report(name){ gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL ' + name + (DRY_RUN ? ' [DRY RUN]' : '') + ' ===\n' + JSON.stringify(STATS, null, 2)); }
var DAYS = 180;
var u = new GlideRecord('sys_update_set'); u.addEncodedQuery('state=in progress^nameNOT LIKEDefault^sys_updated_onRELATIVELT@dayofweek@ago@' + DAYS); u.setLimit(MAX_ROWS); u.query();
while (u.next()) { STATS.checked++; STATS.would_change++; gs.print((DRY_RUN ? '[DRY RUN] ' : '') + 'ignore ' + u.getValue('name'));
  if (!DRY_RUN) { u.setValue('state', 'ignore'); u.update(); STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(u.getUniqueValue()); } }
report('upg-stale-update-sets');</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Sets stale \"in progress\" update sets (no change for N days, not Default) to Ignore so they stop capturing work.", "prereqs": "Sub-production first. Fill the map/list from the client-approved source. Review the dry-run counts before switching DRY_RUN off.", "rollback": "The output lists changed_ids; reverse from an XML export taken beforehand or by re-running with the previous values."}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>true</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Platform upgrade, customisation and technical-debt remediation">93dbb3f9c9374c8b88cbf9fbbc6dee11</pattern><seq>3</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:19</sys_created_on><sys_id>f53fa30aba4b4ba59bfcbb232227c3af</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:19</sys_updated_on><title>Close abandoned in-progress update sets (DRY RUN by default)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>
