<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE irm.content — READ ONLY. Tables per Policy and Compliance Management; confirm on release.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var out = {key:'irm.content'};
out.authority_documents = groupCount('sn_compliance_authority_document', 'state', '', 20);
out.citations = count('sn_compliance_citation');
out.policies_by_state = groupCount('sn_compliance_policy', 'state');
out.policy_statements = count('sn_compliance_policy_statement');
out.statement_citation_links = count('sn_compliance_m2m_statement_citation');   // 'table not found' = confirm link table name on this release
out.policies_past_review = hasField('sn_compliance_policy','valid_to') ? count('sn_compliance_policy', 'valid_to<javascript:gs.daysAgoStart(0)') : 'n/a';
out.ucf_import_tables = gs.tableExists('sn_grc_ucf_authority_document') ? count('sn_grc_ucf_authority_document') : 'UCF not installed';
dsbPrint('irm.content', out);</body><data>{"key": "irm.content", "why": "Shows whether the compliance library exists and is connected", "unblocks": "Content load and policy design"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="IRM / GRC policy, risk and compliance foundation">4b16aa07c3c5429a93a6f33c5ef138c0</pattern><seq>1</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:19</sys_created_on><sys_id>f799f134f39244ec8d31ed724d8bc2f3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:19</sys_updated_on><title>Authority documents, citations, policies, statements and their linkage</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var DRY_RUN = true;   // set to false only after the dry-run output is approved
var STATS = {checked: 0, would_change: 0, changed: 0, skipped: [], changed_ids: []};
// Set FIELD on records in TABLE matched by KEY_FIELD, using MAP {keyValue: newValue}. Reference values are resolved by display value in REF_TABLE (optional).
function backfill(TABLE, KEY_FIELD, FIELD, MAP, REF_TABLE, EXTRA_QUERY){
  var refCache = {};
  Object.keys(MAP).forEach(function(k){
    var v = MAP[k];
    if (REF_TABLE) { if (refCache[v] === undefined) { var r = new GlideRecord(REF_TABLE); refCache[v] = r.get(r.getDisplayName(), v) ? r.getUniqueValue() : null; } if (!refCache[v]) { STATS.skipped.push('reference not found for key ' + k); return; } v = refCache[v]; }
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); gr.addQuery(KEY_FIELD, k); if (EXTRA_QUERY) gr.addEncodedQuery(EXTRA_QUERY); gr.setLimit(MAX_ROWS); gr.query();
    while (gr.next()) { STATS.checked++; if (gr.getValue(FIELD) == v) continue; STATS.would_change++;
      if (!DRY_RUN) { gr.setValue(FIELD, v); gr.update(); STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(gr.getUniqueValue()); } }
  });
}
// Insert ROWS into TABLE when no record matches all MATCH_FIELDS.
function seed(TABLE, MATCH_FIELDS, ROWS){
  ROWS.forEach(function(row){
    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE); MATCH_FIELDS.forEach(function(f){ gr.addQuery(f, row[f]); }); gr.setLimit(1); gr.query();
    STATS.checked++; if (gr.hasNext()) return; STATS.would_change++;
    if (!DRY_RUN) { var n = new GlideRecord(TABLE); n.initialize(); Object.keys(row).forEach(function(f){ n.setValue(f, row[f]); }); var id = n.insert(); if (id) { STATS.changed++; STATS.changed_ids.push(id); } }
  });
}
function report(name){ gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL ' + name + (DRY_RUN ? ' [DRY RUN]' : '') + ' ===\n' + JSON.stringify(STATS, null, 2)); }
var MAP = { /* 'phishing': 'SOC Tier 1' */ };   // category value : group name
backfill('sn_si_incident', 'category', 'assignment_group', MAP, 'sys_user_group', 'active=true^assignment_groupISEMPTY');
report('sir-assign-by-category');</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Sets the assignment group on open, unassigned security incidents from a category → group map.", "prereqs": "Sub-production first. Fill the map/list from the client-approved source. Review the dry-run counts before switching DRY_RUN off.", "rollback": "The output lists changed_ids; reverse from an XML export taken beforehand or by re-running with the previous values."}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>true</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Security Incident Response and SecOps foundation">9502ffca8cf0439989ddf6b7b57dddea</pattern><seq>3</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:20</sys_created_on><sys_id>f900ed87c9cd487f981a5b33eb69fb45</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:20</sys_updated_on><title>Route unassigned security incidents by category (DRY RUN by default)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item_fd6724942ec445c394b2422cbc69bd11
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB IMPLEMENTATION platform-health-check — DATA CHANGING (creates incidents) unless DRY_RUN = true.
var DRY_RUN = true;
var GROUP = 'ServiceNow Platform Support';   // <confirm>
var T = {errors_24h: 500, event_ready: 5000, ecc_ready: 1000, triggers_overdue: 20, import_run_errors_24h: 1, send_failed_24h: 50};
function count(t, q){ var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
var D1 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@hour@ago@24';
var M = {
  errors_24h: count('syslog', D1 + '^level=2'),
  event_ready: count('sysevent', 'state=ready'),
  ecc_ready: count('ecc_queue', 'state=ready'),
  triggers_overdue: count('sys_trigger', 'next_action<javascript:gs.hoursAgoStart(1)^state=0'),
  import_run_errors_24h: count('sys_import_set_run', D1 + '^errors>0'),
  send_failed_24h: count('sys_email', D1 + '^type=send-failed')
};
var g = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group'); var gid = g.get('name', GROUP) ? g.getUniqueValue() : '';
Object.keys(T).forEach(function(k){
  if (M[k] < T[k]) return;
  var sd = 'DSB-HEALTH ' + k + ' breached: ' + M[k] + ' >= ' + T[k];
  var dup = new GlideRecord('incident'); dup.addActiveQuery(); dup.addQuery('short_description', 'STARTSWITH', 'DSB-HEALTH ' + k); dup.addEncodedQuery('sys_created_onONToday@javascript:gs.beginningOfToday()@javascript:gs.endOfToday()'); dup.setLimit(1); dup.query();
  if (dup.hasNext()) return;
  gs.print((DRY_RUN ? '[DRY RUN] ' : '') + sd);
  if (DRY_RUN) return;
  var inc = new GlideRecord('incident'); inc.initialize(); inc.setValue('short_description', sd); inc.setValue('description', JSON.stringify(M, null, 2)); if (gid) inc.setValue('assignment_group', gid); inc.setValue('impact', 2); inc.setValue('urgency', 2); inc.insert();
});
gs.print('=== DSB-IMPL platform-health-check ===\n' + JSON.stringify({metrics: M, thresholds: T, dry_run: DRY_RUN}, null, 2));</body><data>{"kind": "script", "purpose": "Evaluates health thresholds and raises one incident per breach per day to the platform group. With DRY_RUN it only prints the evaluation.", "prereqs": "Create the platform support group and thresholds; tune for two weeks in DRY_RUN before enabling.", "rollback": "Deactivate the scheduled job; incidents created carry the tag \"DSB-HEALTH\" in short description."}</data><kind>implementation</kind><modifies_data>true</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Platform managed service and continual improvement">8d97fa25f5114eb4b6ee61ef9fdc7882</pattern><seq>1</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:20</sys_created_on><sys_id>fd6724942ec445c394b2422cbc69bd11</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:20</sys_updated_on><title>Scheduled platform health check (DRY RUN by default — creates incidents only when enabled)</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item"><x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><body>// DSB EVIDENCE ai.knowledge — READ ONLY.
// --- DSB helper prelude (read only; no personal information is printed) ---
var DSB_NOTES = [];
function _tbl(t){ return gs.tableExists(t); }
function _fieldOk(t, path){ var gr = new GlideRecord(t); var parts = path.split('.'); for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false; if (i < parts.length - 1) { var ref = gr.getElement(parts[i]).getReferenceTable(); if (!ref) return false; gr = new GlideRecord(ref); } } return true; }
function _badField(t, q){ if (!q) return ''; var conds = String(q).split(/\^NQ|\^OR|\^/); for (var i = 0; i < conds.length; i++) { var m = conds[i].match(/^([a-z0-9_.]+)/); if (!m) continue; var f = m[1].replace(/\.$/, ''); if (f === 'sys_id') continue; if (!_fieldOk(t, f)) return f; } return ''; }
function count(t, q){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.query(); return ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0; }
function groupCount(t, f, q, lim){ if (!_tbl(t)) return 'table not found'; var bad = _badField(t, q) || (_fieldOk(t, f) ? '' : f); if (bad) { DSB_NOTES.push(t + ': field not found ' + bad); return 'field not found: ' + bad; } var rows = []; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); var guard = 0; while (ga.next() && guard++ < 5000) rows.push([ga.getDisplayValue(f) || '(empty)', parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10)]); rows.sort(function(a, b){ return b[1] - a[1]; }); var o = {}; rows.slice(0, lim || 50).forEach(function(r){ o[r[0]] = r[1]; }); if (rows.length > (lim || 50)) o['(other groups)'] = rows.length - (lim || 50); return o; }
function groupSet(t, f, q){ var o = {}; if (!_tbl(t) || !_fieldOk(t, f) || _badField(t, q)) return o; var ga = new GlideAggregate(t); if (q) ga.addEncodedQuery(q); ga.addAggregate('COUNT'); ga.groupBy(f); ga.query(); while (ga.next()) o[ga.getValue(f)] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10); return o; }
function isNum(x){ return typeof x === 'number' && !isNaN(x); }
function diff(a, b){ return (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) ? a - b : 'n/a'; }
function pct(t, q, base){ var b = count(t, base); if (!isNum(b) || !b) return isNum(b) ? 0 : b; var c = count(t, base ? base + '^' + q : q); return isNum(c) ? Math.round(100 * c / b) : c; }
function hasField(t, f){ return _tbl(t) && _fieldOk(t, f); }
function dsbPrint(key, out){ if (DSB_NOTES.length) out.dsb_notes = DSB_NOTES; var LIM = 60000; var s = JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); if (s.length > LIM) s = JSON.stringify(out); var cut = [], loops = 0; while (s.length > LIM && loops++ < 60) { var bigK = null, bigL = 0; for (var k in out) { if (k === 'key' || k === 'dsb_truncated' || !out[k] || typeof out[k] !== 'object') continue; var l = JSON.stringify(out[k]).length; if (l > bigL) { bigL = l; bigK = k; } } if (!bigK) break; var v = out[bigK]; if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' && v.length > 10) { out[bigK] = v.slice(0, Math.floor(v.length / 2)); cut.push(bigK + ' kept ' + out[bigK].length + ' of ' + v.length); } else { out[bigK] = 'omitted: ' + bigL + ' characters'; cut.push(bigK + ' omitted'); } out.dsb_truncated = cut; s = JSON.stringify(out); } gs.print('=== DSB-EVIDENCE ' + key + ' ===\n' + s); }
var MAX_ROWS = 5000;
var LAST90 = 'sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@90';
var pub = 'workflow_state=published';
var out = {key:'ai.knowledge', published: count('kb_knowledge', pub), by_kb: groupCount('kb_knowledge', 'kb_knowledge_base', pub),
  published_not_updated_365d: count('kb_knowledge', pub + '^sys_updated_onRELATIVELT@dayofweek@ago@365'),
  published_past_valid_to: count('kb_knowledge', pub + '^valid_to<javascript:gs.daysAgoStart(0)'),
  views_90d: count('kb_use', LAST90), drafts: count('kb_knowledge', 'workflow_state=draft')};
var d = new GlideAggregate('kb_knowledge'); d.addEncodedQuery(pub); d.addAggregate('COUNT'); d.groupBy('short_description'); d.addHaving('COUNT', '>', 1); d.query();
out.duplicate_titles = 0; while (d.next()) out.duplicate_titles++;   // counts only; titles are not printed
out.incidents_90d = count('incident', LAST90);
out.incidents_90d_with_kb_link = count('m2m_kb_task', LAST90);
out.top_viewed_90d = groupCount('kb_use', 'article', LAST90, 15);
dsbPrint('ai.knowledge', out);</body><data>{"key": "ai.knowledge", "why": "AI answers are only as good as the knowledge behind them", "unblocks": "Knowledge remediation plan, AI Search scope"}</data><kind>evidence_script</kind><modifies_data>false</modifies_data><pattern display_value="Now Assist, Virtual Agent and AI-assisted service delivery">0516e578c5dd4dfda26e406e0d0f601d</pattern><seq>1</seq><share_key/><sys_created_by>emile.bennetts</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-27 17:22:20</sys_created_on><sys_id>fe077cd7c6d8490797e0e33a3fab2b65</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>emile.bennetts</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 17:22:20</sys_updated_on><title>Knowledge base health: published, stale, duplicate titles, usage and ticket linkage</title></x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item></record_update>
